english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever recites the Qur'an and acts upon what is in it, his parents will be crowned on the Day of Resurrection with a crown whose light is brighter than the light of the sun in the dwellings of this world if it were among you. What then do you think of the one who himself acted upon this?
benefits_en: Raising children upon the Qur'an brings unparalleled celestial honor to parents on the Day of Resurrection.

topic_en: The Qur'an Was Revealed in Seven Dialects (Ahruf)
arabic_matn: عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ هِشَامَ بْنَ حَكِيمِ بْنِ حِزَامٍ يَقْرَأُ سُورَةَ الْفُرْقَانِ فِي حَيَاةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ... فَانْطَلَقْتُ بِهِ أَقُودُهُ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ... فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«اقْرَأْ يَا هِشَامُ»** فَقَرَأَ عَلَيْهِ الْقِرَاءَةَ الَّتِي سَمِعْتُهُ يَقْرَأُ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«كَذَلِكَ أُنْزِلَتْ»**، ثُمَّ قَالَ: **«اقْرَأْ يَا عُمَرُ»** فَقَرَأْتُ الْقِرَاءَةَ الَّتِي أَقْرَأَنِي، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«كَذَلِكَ أُنْزِلَتْ؛ إِنَّ هَذَا الْقُرْآنَ أُنْزِلَ عَلَى سَبْعَةِ أَحْرُفٍ، فَاقْرَءُوا مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنْهُ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Umar ibn al-Khattab (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: Umar ibn al-Khattab said: I heard Hisham ibn Hakim reciting Surah Al-Furqan differently from how I had learned it from the Prophet ﷺ... So I led him to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. The Prophet ﷺ said: "Recite, O Hisham." He recited as he had before, and the Prophet ﷺ said: "Thus was it revealed." Then he said: "Recite, O 'Umar." I recited, and he said: "Thus was it revealed. Indeed, this Qur'an was revealed in seven modes of recitation (Ahruf); so recite whatever of it is easy for you.
benefits_en: The revelation of the Qur'an in seven authentic dialects accommodated regional linguistic variations, showcasing Allah's immense mercy and facilitation for the Ummah.

topic_en: Completing the Qur'an Periodically
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا قَالَ: قَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«اقْرَأِ الْقُرْآنَ فِي شَهْرٍ»**، قُلْتُ: إِنِّي أَجِدُ قُوَّةً، قَالَ: **«فَاقْرَأْهُ فِي عِشْرِينَ لَيْلَةً»**، قُلْتُ: إِنِّي أَجِدُ قُوَّةً، قَالَ: **«فَاقْرَأْهُ فِي سَبْعٍ وَلَا تَزِدْ عَلَى ذَلِكَ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn 'Amr (رضي الله عنهما).
english_translation: Abdullah ibn 'Amr reported that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to him: "Recite the whole Qur'an in a month." I said: "I have the energy to do more." He said: "Then recite it in twenty nights." I said: "I have the energy to do more." He said: "Then recite it in seven days, and do not exceed that.
benefits_en: The ideal balance in completing the Qur'an regularly is between once a month for moderate pace and once a week for intensive devotion.

topic_ar: لَا يَفْقَهُ مَنْ قَرَأَ الْقُرْآنَ فِي أَقَلَّ مِنْ ثَلَاثٍ
topic_en: Prohibition of Hastening Without Understanding
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: **«لَا يَفْقَهُ مَنْ قَرَأَ الْقُرْآنَ فِي أَقَلَّ مِنْ ثَلَاثٍ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn 'Amr (رضي الله عنهما).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Whoever recites the Qur'an in less than three days does not properly understand it.
benefits_en: The objective of recitation is comprehension, reflection, and spiritual internalization, which is compromised by excessive speed.

topic_en: Description of the Prophet's Recitation
arabic_matn: عَنْ قَتَادَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ عَنْ قِرَاءَةِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ، فَقَالَ: **«كَانَتْ مَدًّا»**، ثُمَّ قَرَأَ: ﴿بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ﴾، يَمُدُّ بِبِسْمِ اللَّهِ، وَيَمُدُّ بِالرَّحْمَنِ، وَيَمُدُّ بِالرَّحِيمِ.
narrator_en: Narrated by Anas ibn Malik (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: Qatadah narrated: I asked Anas ibn Malik about the recitation of the Prophet ﷺ. He said: "It was characterized by elongation (Madd)." Then he recited: ﴿Bismi Allāhi ar-Raḥmāni ar-Raḥīm﴾, elongating 'Bismi Allāh', elongating 'ar-Raḥmān', and elongating 'ar-Raḥīm'.
benefits_en: Reciting the Qur'an according to proper Tajwid rules with elongated vowels conveys tranquility and reverent beauty.

topic_en: Pausing at the End of Every Verse
arabic_matn: عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا: أَنَّهَا ذَكَرَتْ قِرَاءَةَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«﴿بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ * الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ * الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ * مَالِكِ يَوْمِ الدِّينِ﴾، يُقَطِّعُ قِرَاءَتَهُ آيَةً آيَةً»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Umm Salamah (رضي الله عنها).
english_translation: Umm Salamah (رضي الله عنها) described the recitation of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: "﴿In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful * All praise is due to Allah, Lord of the worlds * The Most Gracious, the Most Merciful * Sovereign of the Day of Recompense﴾, pausing at each verse.
benefits_en: The Sunnah manner of recitation is pausing distinctly at the completion of each ayah to facilitate reflection.

topic_en: Satan Weeps When the Reciter Prostrates
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«إِذَا قَرَأَ ابْنُ آدَمَ السَّجْدَةَ فَسَجَدَ، اعْتَزَلَ الشَّيْطَانُ يَبْكِي، يَقُولُ: يَا وَيْلَهُ - وَفِي رِوَايَةِ أَبِي كُرَيْبٍ: يَا وَيْلِي - أُمِرَ ابْنُ آدَمَ بِالسُّجُودِ فَسَجَدَ فَلَهُ الْجَنَّةُ، وَأُمِرْتُ بِالسُّجُودِ فَأَبَيْتُ فَلِيَ النَّارُ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When the son of Adam recites a verse of prostration and prostrates, Satan withdraws weeping, saying: 'Woe to me! The son of Adam was commanded to prostrate and he prostrated, so Paradise is his; whereas I was commanded to prostrate and I refused, so the Fire is mine.
benefits_en: Performing the Prostration of Recitation (Sujud at-Tilawah) affirms humility before Allah and humbles the arrogance of Iblis.

topic_en: Prostration in Surah Sad
arabic_matn: عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا قَالَ: **«لَيْسَتْ (ص) مِنْ عَزَائِمِ السُّجُودِ، وَقَدْ رَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ يَسْجُدُ فِيهَا»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn 'Abbas (رضي الله عنهما).
english_translation: Ibn 'Abbas (رضي الله عنهما) said: "The prostration in Surah Sad is not an obligatory one, yet I saw the Prophet ﷺ prostrating in it.
benefits_en: Prostrating upon reciting the repentance of Prophet Dawud (عليه السلام) in Surah Sad is an established Sunnah of gratitude and repentance.

topic_en: Prostration in Surah An-Najm
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: **«قَرَأَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ النَّجْمَ بِمَكَّةَ فَسَجَدَ فِيهَا، وَسَجَدَ مَنْ مَعَهُ غَيْرَ شَيْخٍ أَخَذَ كَفًّا مِنْ حَصًى أَوْ تُرَابٍ، فَرَفَعَهُ إِلَى جَبْهَتِهِ وَقَالَ: يَكْفِينِي هَذَا، فَرَأَيْتُهُ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ قُتِلَ كَافِرًا»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn Mas'ud (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: Abdullah ibn Mas'ud narrated: "The Prophet ﷺ recited Surah An-Najm in Makkah and prostrated during it, and all those with him prostrated, except an old man who took a handful of pebbles or dirt, lifted it to his forehead, and said: 'This suffices me.' I later saw him killed as a disbeliever.
benefits_en: Surah An-Najm concludes with a commanding verse of prostration (53:62) requiring sincere submission before Allah's majesty.

topic_en: Prostrations in the Mufassal Surahs
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: **«سَجَدْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي ﴿إِذَا السَّمَاءُ انْشَقَّتْ﴾ وَ﴿اقْرَأْ بِاسْمِ رَبِّكَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ﴾»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه) said: "We prostrated with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ during the recitation of: ﴿When the sky has split open﴾ (Surah Al-Inshiqaq) and ﴿Recite in the name of your Lord who created﴾ (Surah Al-'Alaq).
benefits_en: The Sujud at-Tilawah in the short Surahs of the Mufassal remains an authentic Sunnah practiced by the Prophet ﷺ and his Companions.

topic_ar: مُدَارَسَةُ جِبْرِيلَ لِلنَّبِيِّ ﷺ الْقُرْآنَ فِي رَمَضَانَ
topic_en: Reviewing the Qur'an with Jibril Every Ramadan
arabic_matn: عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا قَالَ: **«كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَجْوَدَ النَّاسِ، وَكَانَ أَجْوَدُ مَا يَكُونُ فِي رَمَضَانَ حِينَ يَلْقَاهُ جِبْرِيلُ، وَكَانَ يَلْقَاهُ فِي كُلِّ لَيْلَةٍ مِنْ رَمَضَانَ فَيُدَارِسُهُ الْقُرْآنَ، فَلَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَجْوَدُ بِالْخَيْرِ مِنَ الرِّيحِ الْمُرْسَلَةِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn 'Abbas (رضي الله عنهما).
english_translation: Ibn 'Abbas (رضي الله عنهما) said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was the most generous of all people, and he was even more generous during Ramadan when Jibril met him. Jibril used to meet him every night of Ramadan to review the Qur'an with him. Truly, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was more generous in doing good than the blowing wind.
benefits_en: Intensive mutual review and recitation of the Qur'an in Ramadan elevates generous character and spiritual vitality.

topic_ar: قِرَاءَةُ سُورَتَيِ الْإِسْرَاءِ وَالزُّمَرِ قَبْلَ النَّوْمِ
topic_en: Reciting Surah Al-Isra' and Az-Zumar Before Sleeping
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا قَالَتْ: **«كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ لَا يَنَامُ حَتَّى يَقْرَأَ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ (الْإِسْرَاءَ) وَالزُّمَرَ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'A'ishah (رضي الله عنها).
english_translation: A'ishah (رضي الله عنها) narrated: "The Prophet ﷺ would not go to sleep until he had recited Bani Isra'il (Surah Al-Isra') and Az-Zumar.
benefits_en: Concluding the day by reciting Surahs containing profound themes of monotheism, accountability, and the Day of Judgment prepares the soul for peaceful sleep.

topic_en: Reciting the Musabbihat Surahs Before Sleeping
arabic_matn: عَنِ الْعِرْبَاضِ بْنِ سَارِيَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: **«أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ كَانَ يَقْرَأُ الْمُسَبِّحَاتِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَرْقُدَ، وَيَقُولُ: إِنَّ فِيهِنَّ آيَةً أَفْضَلُ مِنْ أَلْفِ آيَةٍ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Al-'Irbad ibn Sariyah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: Al-'Irbad ibn Sariyah narrated: "The Prophet ﷺ used to recite the Musabbihat (the Surahs beginning with the glorification of Allah: Al-Hadid, Al-Hashr, As-Saff, Al-Jumu'ah, At-Taghabun, and Al-A'la) before going to sleep, and he said: 'Indeed, among them is a verse superior to a thousand verses.
benefits_en: Glorifying Allah through the Musabbihat chapters before sleep instills supreme reverence and divine protection.

topic_en: Seeking Refuge (Al-Isti'adhah) Before Reciting the Qur'an
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِذَا قَامَ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ اسْتَفْتَحَ صَلَاتَهُ... ثُمَّ يَقُولُ: **«أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ السَّمِيعِ الْعَلِيمِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ: مِنْ هَمْزِهِ، وَنَفْخِهِ، وَنَفْثِهِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ stood to pray at night, he would begin his prayer... and then say: "I seek refuge in Allah, the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing, from Satan the outcast: from his madness (hamz), his arrogance (nafkhihi), and his witchcraft/poetry (nafthihi).
benefits_en: Seeking refuge in Allah prior to recitation clears the mind from satanic whispers, enabling pristine contemplation.

topic_en: Surah Al-Kafirun as Disavowal of Polytheism
arabic_matn: عَنْ فَرْوَةَ بْنِ نَوْفَلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ لِنَوْفَلٍ: **«اقْرَأْ: ﴿قُلْ يَا أَيُّهَا الْكَافِرُونَ﴾ ثُمَّ نَمْ عَلَى خَاتِمَتِهَا؛ فَإِنَّهَا بَرَاءَةٌ مِنَ الشِّرْكِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Nawfal al-Ashja'i (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said to Nawfal: "Recite: ﴿Say: O disbelievers﴾ (Surah Al-Kafirun) and then go to sleep at its end; for it is an absolute disavowal of polytheism (Shirk).
benefits_en: Reciting Surat al-Kafirun before sleeping ensures that one ends their waking hours upon pure Monotheism and complete renunciation of idolatry.

topic_ar: تَعَلُّمُ آيَتَيْنِ خَيْرٌ مِنْ نَاقَتَيْنِ كَوْمَاوَيْنِ
topic_en: Learning Two Verses from the Book of Allah in the Mosque
arabic_matn: عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: خَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَنَحْنُ فِي الصُّفَّةِ، فَقَالَ: **«أَيُّكُمْ يُحِبُّ أَنْ يَغْدُوَ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ إِلَى بُطْحَانَ أَوْ إِلَى الْعَقِيقِ، فَيَأْتِيَ مِنْهُ بِنَاقَتَيْنِ كَوْمَاوَيْنِ فِي غَيْرِ إِثْمٍ وَلَا قَطْعِ رَحِمٍ؟»** فَقُلْنَا: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، نُحِبُّ ذَلِكَ، قَالَ: **«أَفَلَا يَغْدُو أَحَدُكُمْ إِلَى الْمَسْجِدِ فَيَعْلَمُ، أَوْ يَقْرَأُ آيَتَيْنِ مِنْ كِتَابِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ، خَيْرٌ لَهُ مِنْ نَاقَتَيْنِ، وَثَلَاثٌ خَيْرٌ لَهُ مِنْ ثَلَاثٍ، وَأَرْبَعٌ خَيْرٌ لَهُ مِنْ أَرْبَعٍ، وَمِنْ أَعْدَادِهِنَّ مِنَ الْإِبِلِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Uqbah ibn 'Amir (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ came out while we were at the Suffah and asked: "Which of you would love to go every morning to Buthan or Al-'Aqiq and bring back two large she-camels without committing any sin or severing ties of kinship?" We said: "O Messenger of Allah, we would love that." He said: "Why does not one of you go to the mosque in the morning and learn or recite two verses from the Book of Allah, Mighty and Majestic? That is better for him than two she-camels, and three verses are better than three, and four are better than four, and so on for their numbers in camels.
benefits_en: The enduring spiritual value of learning even a couple of verses from Allah's Book vastly outweighs the greatest material wealth in the world.

topic_en: The Qur'an is an Argument For You or Against You
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي مَالِكٍ الْأَشْعَرِيِّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«...وَالْقُرْآنُ حُجَّةٌ لَكَ أَوْ عَلَيْكَ، كُلُّ النَّاسِ يَغْدُو؛ فَبَائِعٌ نَفْسَهُ، فَمُعْتِقُهَا أَوْ مُوبِقُهَا»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Malik al-Ash'ari (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "...And the Qur'an is either an argument in your favor or an argument against you. Every person goes out in the morning and trades his soul: either setting it free or destroying it.
benefits_en: Reading the Qur'an without acting upon its commandments transforms it from a source of salvation into a witness of evidence against the negligent.

topic_ar: إِنَّ الَّذِي لَيْسَ فِي جَوْفِهِ شَيْءٌ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ كَالْبَيْتِ الْخَرِبِ
topic_en: The Heart Devoid of Qur'an is Like a Ruined House
arabic_matn: عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«إِنَّ الَّذِي لَيْسَ فِي جَوْفِهِ شَيْءٌ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ كَالْبَيْتِ الْخَرِبِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn 'Abbas (رضي الله عنهما).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Indeed, the one in whose interior (heart) there is nothing of the Qur'an is like a ruined house.
benefits_en: Memorizing and harboring verses of the Qur'an inside one's heart builds an impenetrable fortress of spiritual life, light, and protection.

topic_en: Reciting the Qur'an Aloud and in Secret
arabic_matn: عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: **«الْجَاهِرُ بِالْقُرْآنِ كَالْجَاهِرِ بِالصَّدَقَةِ، وَالْمُسِرُّ بِالْقُرْآنِ كَالْمُسِرِّ بِالصَّدَقَةِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Uqbah ibn 'Amir (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "The one who recites the Qur'an aloud is like the one who gives charity openly, and the one who recites the Qur'an quietly is like the one who gives charity in secret.
benefits_en: Secret recitation preserves sincerity from ostentation, while reciting aloud when appropriate inspires others and illuminates the surrounding environment.

topic_en: Weeping Out of Fear of Allah Upon Listening to the Qur'an
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«اقْرَأْ عَلَيَّ»**، قُلْتُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أَقْرَأُ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَيْكَ أُنْزِلَ؟ قَالَ: **«نَعَمْ، إِنِّي أُحِبُّ أَنْ أَسْمَعَهُ مِنْ غَيْرِي»**، فَقَرَأْتُ عَلَيْهِ سُورَةَ النِّسَاءِ، حَتَّى أَتَيْتُ إِلَى هَذِهِ الْآيَةِ: ﴿فَكَيْفَ إِذَا جِئْنَا مِنْ كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ بِشَهِيدٍ وَجِئْنَا بِكَ عَلَى هَؤُلَاءِ شَهِيدًا﴾، قَالَ: **«حَسْبُكَ الْآنَ»**، فَالْتَفَتُّ إِلَيْهِ، فَإِذَا عَيْنَاهُ تَذْرِفَانِ.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn Mas'ud (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: Abdullah ibn Mas'ud reported: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to me: "Recite to me." I said: "O Messenger of Allah, shall I recite to you while it was revealed to you?" He said: "Yes, I love to hear it from someone other than myself." So I recited Surah An-Nisa' until I reached this verse: ﴿So how will it be when We bring from every nation a witness and We bring you [O Muhammad] as a witness against these people?﴾ (4:41). He said: "That is enough for now." I turned to look at him, and behold, his tears were flowing.
benefits_en: Deep emotional response and shedding tears out of reverence and realization of the Day of Judgment is the hallmark of genuine faith upon hearing the Qur'an.

topic_en: The Qur'an is the Firm Rope of Allah
arabic_matn: عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَرْقَمَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَوْمًا فِينَا خَطِيبًا بِمَاءٍ يُدْعَى خُمًّا... فَحَمِدَ اللَّهَ وَأَثْنَى عَلَيْهِ، وَوَعَظَ وَذَكَّرَ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: **«أَمَّا بَعْدُ، أَلَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ، فَإِنَّمَا أَنَا بَشَرٌ يُوشِكُ أَنْ يَأْتِيَ رَسُولُ رَبِّي فَأُجِيبَ، وَأَنَا تَارِكٌ فِيكُمْ ثَقَلَيْنِ: أَوَّلُهُمَا كِتَابُ اللَّهِ، فِيهِ الْهُدَى وَالنُّورُ، فَخُذُوا بِكِتَابِ اللَّهِ وَاسْتَمْسِكُوا بِهِ»**، فَحَثَّ عَلَى كِتَابِ اللَّهِ وَرَغَّبَ فِيهِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: **«وَأَهْلُ بَيْتِي؛ أُذَكِّرُكُمُ اللَّهَ فِي أَهْلِ بَيْتِي»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Zayd ibn Arqam (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: Zayd ibn Arqam (رضي الله عنه) reported: One day the Messenger of Allah ﷺ stood up to deliver a sermon at a spring of water called Khumm... He praised and glorified Allah, exhorted and reminded us, and then said: "Now to proceed: Behold, O people! I am only a human being, and it is near that the messenger of my Lord (the Angel of Death) comes and I answer the call. I am leaving among you two weighty matters: the first is the Book of Allah, in which there is guidance and light; so hold fast to the Book of Allah and adhere strictly to it." He encouraged adherence to the Book of Allah and inspired love for it, and then said: "And my household; I remind you of Allah concerning my household.
benefits_en: The Book of Allah is the infallible, everlasting source of guidance and light; holding firmly to it ensures eternal salvation and protection against misguidance.

topic_ar: مَثَلُ الَّذِي يَذْكُرُ رَبَّهُ وَالَّذِي لَا يَذْكُرُ رَبَّهُ
topic_en: Parable of the One Who Remembers Allah and the One Who Does Not
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى الْأَشْعَرِيِّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ: **«مَثَلُ الَّذِي يَذْكُرُ رَبَّهُ وَالَّذِي لَا يَذْكُرُ رَبَّهُ، مَثَلُ الْحَيِّ وَالْمَيِّتِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Musa al-Ash'ari (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "The example of the one who remembers his Lord and the one who does not remember his Lord is like that of the living and the dead.
benefits_en: Remembrance of Allah (Dhikr) is the true life and heartbeat of the human soul; a heart void of Dhikr is spiritually lifeless, no matter how active the physical body is.

topic_ar: سَبَقَ الْمُفَرِّدُونَ: الذَّاكِرُونَ اللَّهَ كَثِيرًا وَالذَّاكِرَاتُ
topic_en: The Distinction of the Mufarridun
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَسِيرُ فِي طَرِيقِ مَكَّةَ فَمَرَّ عَلَى جَبَلٍ يُقَالُ لَهُ جُمْدَانُ، فَقَالَ: **«سِيرُوا هَذَا جُمْدَانُ، سَبَقَ الْمُفَرِّدُونَ»** قَالُوا: وَمَا الْمُفَرِّدُونَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ؟ قَالَ: **«الذَّاكِرُونَ اللَّهَ كَثِيرًا، وَالذَّاكِرَاتُ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was travelling along the path to Makkah and passed by a mountain called Jumdan. He said: "Proceed, this is Jumdan; the singular forerunners (al-Mufarridun) have outpaced the rest." They asked: "Who are the Mufarridun, O Messenger of Allah?" He replied: "The men and women who remember Allah abundantly.
benefits_en: Those who consistently keep their tongues and minds engaged in the remembrance of Allah outstrip others in spiritual elevation and heavenly ranks.

topic_ar: فَضْلُ ذِكْرِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى عَلَى الْإِنْفَاقِ وَالْجِهَادِ
topic_en: Dhikr is Better Than Spending Gold and Silver
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ: **«أَلَا أُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِخَيْرِ أَعْمَالِكُمْ، وَأَزْكَاهَا عِنْدَ مَلِيكِكُمْ، وَأَرْفَعِهَا فِي دَرَجَاتِكُمْ، وَخَيْرٍ لَكُمْ مِنْ إِنْفَاقِ الذَّهَبِ وَالْوَرِقِ، وَخَيْرٍ لَكُمْ مِنْ أَنْ تَلْقَوْا عَدُوَّكُمْ فَتَضْرِبُوا أَعْنَاقَهُمْ وَيَضْرِبُوا أَعْنَاقَكُمْ؟»** قَالُوا: بَلَى، قَالَ: **«ذِكْرُ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu al-Darda' (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Shall I not inform you of the best of your deeds, the purest in the sight of your Sovereign Lord, the highest in your ranks, better for you than spending gold and silver, and better for you than meeting your enemy and striking their necks and they striking yours?" They said: "Yes, indeed!" He said: "The remembrance of Allah Almighty.
benefits_en: Continuous, heartfelt remembrance of Allah is the most sublime, accessible, and rewarded act of worship in Islam.

topic_ar: لَا يَزَالُ لِسَانُكَ رَطْبًا مِنْ ذِكْرِ اللَّهِ
topic_en: Keeping the Tongue Moist with the Remembrance of Allah
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ بُسْرٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، أَنَّ رَجُلًا قَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنَّ شَرَائِعَ الْإِسْلَامِ قَدْ كَثُرَتْ عَلَيَّ، فَأَخْبِرْنِي بِشَيْءٍ أَتَشَبَّثُ بِهِ، قَالَ: **«لَا يَزَالُ لِسَانُكَ رَطْبًا مِنْ ذِكْرِ اللَّهِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn Busr (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: A man said: "O Messenger of Allah, the voluntary duties of Islam have become abundant for me, so inform me of something comprehensive I may cling to." The Prophet ﷺ replied: "Let your tongue remain perpetually moist with the remembrance of Allah.
benefits_en: Continual Dhikr provides an effortless yet immensely potent anchor that preserves the believer upon righteousness throughout all daily routines.

topic_ar: مَنْ قَالَ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ حُطَّتْ خَطَايَاهُ
topic_en: Forgiveness of Sins Through "Subhan Allah wa bihamdihi"
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ: **«مَنْ قَالَ: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، فِي يَوْمٍ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ، حُطَّتْ خَطَايَاهُ، وَإِنْ كَانَتْ مِثْلَ زَبَدِ الْبَحْرِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever says: 'Subhan Allahi wa bihamdihi' (Glory be to Allah and His is the praise) one hundred times a day, his sins will be forgiven even if they were like the foam of the sea.
benefits_en: Daily repetition of this simple tasbih wipes away minor sins completely, demonstrating the vastness of Allah's divine grace.

topic_en: Two Words Beloved to the Most Merciful
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«كَلِمَتَانِ خَفِيفَتَانِ عَلَى اللِّسَانِ، ثَقِيلَتَانِ فِي الْمِيزَانِ، حَبِيبَتَانِ إِلَى الرَّحْمَنِ: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Two words are light on the tongue, heavy on the scales, and beloved to the Most Merciful: 'Subhan Allahi wa bihamdihi' (Glory be to Allah and His is the praise), 'Subhan Allahil-'Azim' (Glory be to Allah the Almighty).
benefits_en: This phrase combines glorification and praise, representing the ultimate concluding balance of good deeds on the Day of Judgment.

topic_en: The Four Most Beloved Words to Allah
arabic_matn: عَنْ سَمُرَةَ بْنِ جُنْدُبٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«أَحَبُّ الْكَلَامِ إِلَى اللَّهِ أَرْبَعٌ: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، لَا يَضُرُّكَ بِأَيِّهِنَّ بَدَأْتَ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Samurah ibn Jundub (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The dearest words to Allah are four: 'Subhan Allah' (Glory be to Allah), 'Al-Hamdu lillah' (Praise be to Allah), 'La ilaha illallah' (There is no true deity except Allah), and 'Allahu Akbar' (Allah is the Greatest). It does not matter with which of them you begin.
benefits_en: These four phrases encompass the essence of glorification, gratitude, monotheism, and magnification of Allah.

topic_en: The Reward of the Four Phrases Over All Wordly Possessions
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«لَأَنْ أَقُولَ: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِمَّا طَلَعَتْ عَلَيْهِ الشَّمْسُ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "That I should say: 'Subhan Allah, wal-Hamdu lillah, wa la ilaha illallah, wallahu Akbar' is dearer to me than everything over which the sun rises.
benefits_en: Eternal spiritual treasures far surpass temporary worldly wealth and royal sovereignty.

topic_ar: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ كَنْزٌ مِنْ كُنُوزِ الْجَنَّةِ
topic_en: "La Hawla wa La Quwwata illa Billah" is a Treasure of Paradise
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى الْأَشْعَرِيِّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«أَلَا أَدُلُّكَ عَلَى كَلِمَةٍ مِنْ كُنُوزِ الْجَنَّةِ؟»** قُلْتُ: بَلَى يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: **«لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Musa al-Ash'ari (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: Abu Musa al-Ash'ari reported: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to me: "Shall I not guide you to a phrase which is one of the treasures of Paradise?" I said: "Yes, O Messenger of Allah!" He said: "La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah (There is no power and no strength except with Allah).
benefits_en: Uttering this statement acknowledges absolute reliance upon Allah and total detachment from self-reliance or personal power.

topic_en: The Master Supplication for Seeking Forgiveness (Sayyid al-Istighfar)
arabic_matn: عَنْ شَدَّادِ بْنِ أَوْسٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: **«سَيِّدُ الِاسْتِغْفَارِ أَنْ تَقُولَ: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ لَكَ بِذَنْبِي، فَاغْفِرْ لِي؛ فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ. مَنْ قَالَهَا مِنَ النَّهَارِ مُوقِنًا بِهَا فَمَاتَ مِنْ يَوْمِهِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُمْسِيَ فَهُوَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ، وَمَنْ قَالَهَا مِنَ اللَّيْلِ وَهُوَ مُوقِنٌ بِهَا فَمَاتَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُصْبِحَ فَهُوَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Shaddad ibn Aws (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "The supreme prayer for seeking forgiveness (Sayyid al-Istighfar) is to say: 'O Allah, You are my Lord; there is no true deity except You. You created me and I am Your servant, and I abide by Your covenant and promise as best as I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your favor upon me and I confess my sin to You; so forgive me, for none forgives sins except You.' Whoever says this during the day with firm conviction and dies before evening will be among the people of Paradise; and whoever says it at night with firm conviction and dies before morning will be among the people of Paradise.
benefits_en: Sayyid al-Istighfar encapsulates perfect Tawhid, servitude, gratitude, and humble confession, guaranteeing Paradise to the believer who recites it faithfully.

topic_en: Post-Prayer Remembrance (33 Tasbih, Tahmid, Takbir)
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ: **«مَنْ سَبَّحَ اللَّهَ فِي دُبُرِ كُلِّ صَلَاةٍ ثَلَاثًا وَثَلَاثِينَ، وَحَمِدَ اللَّهَ ثَلَاثًا وَثَلَاثِينَ، وَكَبَّرَ اللَّهَ ثَلَاثًا وَثَلَاثِينَ، فَتِلْكَ تِسْعَةٌ وَتِسْعُونَ، وَقَالَ تَمَامَ الْمِائَةِ: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، غُفِرَتْ خَطَايَاهُ وَإِنْ كَانَتْ مِثْلَ زَبَدِ الْبَحْرِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever glorifies Allah (says Subhan Allah) thirty-three times after every prayer, praises Allah (says Al-Hamdu lillah) thirty-three times, and magnifies Allah (says Allahu Akbar) thirty-three times—making ninety-nine—and completes the hundred with: 'La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir,' his sins will be forgiven even if they were as abundant as the foam of the sea.
benefits_en: Concluding every prescribed prayer with these hundred phrases purges minor sins and seals the prayer with comprehensive praise.

topic_ar: التَّسْبِيحُ عِنْدَ النَّوْمِ خَيْرٌ مِنْ خَادِمٍ
topic_en: Bedtime Tasbih for Physical and Spiritual Strength
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: أَنَّ فَاطِمَةَ عَلَيْهَا السَّلَامُ أَتَتِ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ تَسْأَلُهُ خَادِمًا... فَقَالَ: **«أَلَا أَدُلُّكُمَا عَلَى مَا هُوَ خَيْرٌ لَكُمَا مِنْ خَادِمٍ؟ إِذَا أَوَيْتُمَا إِلَى فِرَاشِكُمَا - أَوْ أَخَذْتُمَا مَضَاجِعَكُمَا - فَكَبِّرَا ثَلَاثًا وَثَلَاثِينَ، وَسَبِّحَا ثَلَاثًا وَثَلَاثِينَ، وَاحْمَدَا ثَلَاثًا وَثَلَاثِينَ، فَهَذَا خَيْرٌ لَكُمَا مِنْ خَادِمٍ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Ali ibn Abi Talib (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: Ali ibn Abi Talib reported that Fatimah (may Allah be pleased with her) came to the Prophet ﷺ asking for a servant... He said: "Shall I not guide you both to that which is better for you than a servant? When you go to your bed, say 'Allahu Akbar' thirty-three times (or thirty-four), 'Subhan Allah' thirty-three times, and 'Al-Hamdu lillah' thirty-three times. That is better for you than a servant.
benefits_en: Bedtime Dhikr grants miraculous divine strength and inner tranquility to endure physical exhaustion and heavy daily burdens.

topic_en: Morning and Evening Satisfaction with Allah
arabic_matn: عَنْ ثَوْبَانَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«مَنْ قَالَ حِينَ يُمْسِي وَحِينَ يُصْبِحُ: رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا، وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ نَبِيًّا، كَانَ حَقًّا عَلَى اللَّهِ أَنْ يُرْضِيَهُ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Thawban (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever says in the evening and in the morning: 'Raditu billahi Rabba, wa bil-Islami dina, wa bi-Muhammadin ﷺ Nabiyya' (I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, with Islam as my religion, and with Muhammad ﷺ as my Prophet), it is a duty upon Allah to please him on the Day of Resurrection.
benefits_en: Affirming heartfelt contentment with Allah's Lordship, His Deen, and His Messenger guarantees reciprocal divine contentment and reward on the Last Day.

topic_en: Protection Against Harm Through Allah's Name
arabic_matn: عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عَفَّانَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«مَا مِنْ عَبْدٍ يَقُولُ فِي صَبَاحِ كُلِّ يَوْمٍ وَمَسَاءِ كُلِّ لَيْلَةٍ: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ، ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ، لَمْ يَضُرَّهُ شَيْءٌ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Uthman ibn 'Affan (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "There is no servant who says in the morning of every day and the evening of every night: 'Bismillāhilladhī lā yaḍurru ma'asmihi shay'un fīl-arḍi wa lā fīs-samā'i wa Huwas-Samī'ul-'Alīm' (In the name of Allah, with whose Name nothing on earth or in the heavens can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing) three times, except that nothing will harm him.
benefits_en: Reciting this three times every morning and evening serves as an impenetrable divine shield against unexpected affliction, poisoning, and injury.

topic_en: Seeking Refuge in the Perfect Words of Allah
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَقَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، مَا لَقِيتُ مِنْ عَقْرَبٍ لَدَغَتْنِي الْبَارِحَةَ! قَالَ: **«أَمَا لَوْ قُلْتَ حِينَ أَمْسَيْتَ: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ، لَمْ تَضُرَّكَ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: A man came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: "O Messenger of Allah, what severe pain I suffered from a scorpion that stung me last night!" He replied: "Had you said in the evening: 'A'ūdhu bi-kalimātillāhit-tāmmāti min sharri mā khalaq' (I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created), it would not have harmed you.
benefits_en: Taking refuge in Allah's complete and unassailable Words neutralizes the venom and malice of venomous creatures and hidden dangers.

topic_en: Morning and Evening Supplication of Surrender
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ إِذَا أَصْبَحَ: **«اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ»**، وَإِذَا أَمْسَى قَالَ: **«اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ»** .
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: In the morning, the Prophet ﷺ used to say: "O Allah, by You we enter the morning, by You we enter the evening, by You we live, by You we die, and unto You is the resurrection." And in the evening he would say: "O Allah, by You we enter the evening, by You we enter the morning, by You we live, by You we die, and unto You is the final return.
benefits_en: Beginning and ending the day acknowledging Allah's sole sovereignty over life, death, and resurrection anchors consciousness in the Hereafter.

topic_en: Supplication for the Evening Dominion Belonging to Allah
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: كَانَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِذَا أَمْسَى قَالَ: **«أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهَا، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn Mas'ud (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: When evening came, the Prophet ﷺ would say: "We have reached the evening and the entire dominion belongs to Allah; all praise is due to Allah. There is no true deity except Allah alone, without partner. To Him belongs the dominion and to Him belongs praise, and He is over all things competent. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this night and the good of what follows it, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this night and the evil of what follows it. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from laziness and the hardships of old age. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from punishment in the Fire and punishment in the grave.
benefits_en: This comprehensive evening dhikr requests total goodness for the night ahead while seeking refuge from lethargy, eternal ruin, and grave torment.

topic_en: Supplication Upon Waking Up
arabic_matn: عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ بْنِ الْيَمَانِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ إِذَا اسْتَيْقَظَ مِنْ نَوْمِهِ قَالَ: **«الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Hudhayfah ibn al-Yaman (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: When the Prophet ﷺ woke up from sleep, he would say: "Al-ḥamdu lillāhilladhī aḥyānā ba'da mā amātanā wa ilayhin-nushūr" (All praise is due to Allah who gave us life after causing us to die [sleep], and unto Him is the final resurrection).
benefits_en: The first thought and speech upon awakening should be praising Allah for the gift of renewed life and conscious preparation for resurrection.

topic_en: Supplication When Lying Down to Sleep
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ: **«إِذَا أَوَى أَحَدُكُمْ إِلَى فِرَاشِهِ فَلْيَنْفُضْ فِرَاشَهُ بِدَاخِلَةِ إِزَارِهِ؛ فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَدْرِي مَا خَلَفَهُ عَلَيْهِ، ثُمَّ يَقُولُ: بِاسْمِكَ رَبِّ وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي، وَبِكَ أَرْفَعُهُ، إِنْ أَمْسَكْتَ نَفْسِي فَارْحَمْهَا، وَإِنْ أَرْسَلْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا بِمَا تَحْفَظُ بِهِ عِبَادَكَ الصَّالِحِينَ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "When one of you goes to bed, let him dust his bed with the inner edge of his garment, for he does not know what came onto it after him. Then let him say: 'Bismika Rabbī waḍa'tu janbī, wa bika arfa'uh, in amsakta nafsī farḥamhā, wa in arsaltahā faḥfaẓhā bimā taḥfaẓu bihi 'ibādakaṣ-ṣāliḥīn' (In Your name, my Lord, I lay down my side, and in Your name I raise it. If You take my soul, have mercy upon it, and if You release it, protect it as You protect Your righteous servants).
benefits_en: Combines physical cleanliness and safety with spiritual entrustment of one's soul into Allah's merciful custody during sleep.

topic_ar: فَضْلُ مَنْ تَعَارَّ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَدَعَا
topic_en: Supplication Upon Awakening at Night (At-Ta'arrur)
arabic_matn: عَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: **«مَنْ تَعَارَّ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ، فَقَالَ: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي، أَوْ دَعَا، اسْتُجِيبَ لَهُ، فَإِنْ تَوَضَّأَ وَصَلَّى قُبِلَتْ صَلَاتُهُ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Ubadah ibn as-Samit (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Whoever wakes up at night and says: 'La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu, wa Huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir. Al-hamdu lillah, wa Subhan Allah, wa la ilaha illallah, wallahu Akbar, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah,' and then says: 'O Allah, forgive me,' or makes supplication, it will be answered. And if he performs ablution and prays, his prayer will be accepted.
benefits_en: Waking during the night and immediately uttering these words of monotheism unlocks guaranteed acceptance of supplication and night prayers.

topic_en: Remembrance When Entering the House
arabic_matn: عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ يَقُولُ: **«إِذَا دَخَلَ الرَّجُلُ بَيْتَهُ، فَذَكَرَ اللَّهَ عِنْدَ دُخُولِهِ وَعِنْدَ طَعَامِهِ، قَالَ الشَّيْطَانُ: لَا مَبِيتَ لَكُمْ وَلَا عَشَاءَ، وَإِذَا دَخَلَ فَلَمْ يَذْكُرِ اللَّهَ عِنْدَ دُخُولِهِ، قَالَ الشَّيْطَانُ: أَدْرَكْتُمُ الْمَبِيتَ، وَإِذَا لَمْ يَذْكُرِ اللَّهَ عِنْدَ طَعَامِهِ، قَالَ: أَدْرَكْتُمُ الْمَبِيتَ وَالْعَشَاءَ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Jabir ibn 'Abdullah (رضي الله عنهما).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "When a man enters his house and mentions Allah upon entering and upon eating his food, Satan says to his companions: 'You have no place to spend the night and no dinner.' But if he enters without mentioning Allah upon entering, Satan says: 'You have found a place to spend the night.' And if he does not mention Allah upon eating, Satan says: 'You have found both a place to spend the night and dinner.
benefits_en: Uttering the Name of Allah when entering home and partaking in food bars Satan and his hosts from residence and sustenance in one's home.

topic_en: Supplication When Leaving the House
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ: **«إِذَا خَرَجَ الرَّجُلُ مِنْ بَيْتِهِ فَقَالَ: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ، لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ، يُقَالُ لَهُ حِينَئِذٍ: هُدِيتَ، وَكُفِيتَ، وَوُقِيتَ، فَتَتَنَحَّى لَهُ الشَّيَاطِينُ، فَيَقُولُ لَهُ شَيْطَانٌ آخَرُ: كَيْفَ لَكَ بِرَجُلٍ قَدْ هُدِيَ وَكُفِيَ وَوُقِيَ؟»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Anas ibn Malik (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "When a man steps out of his house and says: 'Bismillāh, tawakkaltu 'alallāh, lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā billāh' (In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah; there is no power and no strength except with Allah), it is said to him at that moment: 'You have been guided, sufficed, and protected.' Devils move away from him, and another devil says: 'How can you reach a man who has been guided, sufficed, and protected?
benefits_en: Uttering this simple phrase upon exiting one's doorstep grants threefold divine assurance: spiritual guidance, material sufficiency, and absolute shielding from demonic deception.

topic_en: Supplication Upon Entering the Mosque
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي أُسَيْدٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«إِذَا دَخَلَ أَحَدُكُمُ الْمَسْجِدَ فَلْيَقُلْ: اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Usayd (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When one of you enters the mosque, let him say: 'Allāhumma-ftaḥ lī abwāba raḥmatik' (O Allah, open for me the gates of Your mercy).
benefits_en: The mosque is the sacred abode of divine mercy; invoking Allah to unlock His mercy prepares the heart for accepted worship.

topic_en: Supplication Upon Exiting the Mosque
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي أُسَيْدٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«وَإِذَا خَرَجَ فَلْيَقُلْ: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Usayd (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "...And when he leaves (the mosque), let him say: 'Allāhumma innī as'aluka min faḍlik' (O Allah, I ask You from Your bounty).
benefits_en: After completing worship in the mosque, asking for Allah's bounty invites halal worldly provision and blessed livelihood in outer affairs.

topic_en: Supplication Entering the Restroom
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ إِذَا دَخَلَ الْخَلَاءَ قَالَ: **«اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبُثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Anas ibn Malik (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: Anas ibn Malik reported: When the Prophet ﷺ entered the privy (restroom), he would say: "Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika minal-khubuthi wal-khabā'ith" (O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the male and female foul spirits/devils).
benefits_en: Seeking Allah's protection before entering impurity-laden places shields one from the spiritual filth and mischief of unseen evil entities.

topic_en: Supplication Upon Exiting the Restroom
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا قَالَتْ: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ إِذَا خَرَجَ مِنَ الْخَلَاءِ قَالَ: **«غُفْرَانَكَ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'A'ishah (رضي الله عنها).
english_translation: A'ishah (رضي الله عنها) narrated: When the Prophet ﷺ came out of the restroom, he would say: "Ghufrānak" (I seek Your forgiveness).
benefits_en: Seeking forgiveness immediately upon relief expresses humility for temporary suspension of verbal dhikr and gratitude for the relief of bodily burdens.

topic_en: Supplication After Finishing a Meal
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ كَانَ إِذَا رَفَعَ مَائِدَتَهُ قَالَ: **«الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ كَثِيرًا طَيِّبًا مُبَارَكًا فِيهِ، غَيْرَ مَكْفِيٍّ وَلَا مُوَدَّعٍ وَلَا مُسْتَغْنًى عَنْهُ رَبَّنَا»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Umamah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: When the table was cleared before the Prophet ﷺ, he would say: "Al-ḥamdu lillāhi kathīran ṭayyiban mubārakan fīh, ghayra makfiyyin wa lā muwadda'in wa lā mustaghnan 'anhu Rabbanā" (Praise be to Allah, abundant, wholesome, and blessed praise, unceasing, indispensable, and never forsaken by us, our Lord).
benefits_en: Recognizing that humanity is perpetually dependent upon Allah's sustenance at every meal seals physical nourishment with deep spiritual gratitude.

topic_en: Supplication Upon Wearing New Clothes
arabic_matn: عَنْ مُعَاذِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ: **«مَنْ لَبِسَ ثَوْبًا فَقَالَ: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي كَسَانِي هَذَا الثَّوْبَ وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ، غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Mu'adh ibn Anas (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever puts on a garment and says: 'Al-ḥamdu lillāhilladhī kasānī hādhāth-thawba wa razaqanīhi min ghayri ḥawlin minnī wa lā quwwah' (Praise be to Allah who has clothed me with this garment and provided it for me without any power or strength on my part), his past sins will be forgiven.
benefits_en: Acknowledging Allah as the sole provider of clothing and dignity erases past shortcomings and fosters humility in appearance.

topic_en: Supplication for Mounting a Riding Animal or Vehicle
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ قَالَ: شَهِدْتُ عَلِيَّ بْنَ أَبِي طَالِبٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ أُتِيَ بِدَابَّةٍ لِيَرْكَبَهَا... فَلَمَّا اسْتَوَى عَلَى ظَهْرِهَا قَالَ: **«﴿سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ * وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ﴾»**، ثُمَّ قَالَ: **«الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ»** ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ، وَ**«اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ»** ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: **«سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي، فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ»**، ثُمَّ ضَحِكَ... فَقَالَ: رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَعَلَ كَمَا فَعَلْتُ.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Ali ibn Abi Talib (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: When 'Ali ibn Abi Talib mounted his riding beast, he said: "﴿Glory to Him who has subjected this to us, and we could never have done it by ourselves. And indeed, to our Lord we will surely return﴾ (43:13-14)." Then he said: 'Al-Hamdu lillah' three times, and 'Allahu Akbar' three times, then said: "Subḥānaka innī ẓalamtu nafsī faghfir lī, fa-innahu lā yaghfirudh-dhunūba illā Ant" (Glory be to You! Indeed I have wronged myself, so forgive me; for none forgives sins except You). Then he smiled and said: "I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ do just as I have done.
benefits_en: Boarding any means of transportation serves as a vivid reminder of human vulnerability, divine subjugation of nature, and our ultimate journey back to Allah.

topic_en: Supplication for Travel
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَانَ إِذَا اسْتَوَى عَلَى بَعِيرِهِ خَارِجًا إِلَى سَفَرٍ كَبَّرَ ثَلَاثًا، ثُمَّ قَالَ: **«﴿سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ * وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ﴾، اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا الْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَى، وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى، اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَذَا وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ، اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ، وَالْخَلِيفَةُ فِي الْأَهْلِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ، وَكَآبَةِ الْمَنْظَرِ، وَسُوءِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ فِي الْمَالِ وَالْأَهْلِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn 'Umar (رضي الله عنهما).
english_translation: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ mounted his camel for travel, he would say 'Allahu Akbar' three times and then say: "﴿Glory to Him who has subjected this to us, and we could never have done it by ourselves. And to our Lord we will return﴾. O Allah, we ask You in this journey of ours for righteousness, piety, and actions pleasing to You. O Allah, make this journey easy for us and fold up its distance. O Allah, You are the Companion in travel and the Caretaker of our families. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the hardships of travel, distressing sights, and an unfortunate return concerning wealth and family.
benefits_en: The travel supplication places the traveler, their safety, and their left-behind family and property into Allah's infallible divine care.

topic_en: Supplication Upon Returning from Travel
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: أَقْبَلْنَا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ حَتَّى إِذَا كُنَّا بِظَهْرِ الْمَدِينَةِ، قَالَ: **«آيِبُونَ، تَائِبُونَ، عَابِدُونَ، لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ»**، فَلَمْ يَزَلْ يَقُولُ ذَلِكَ حَتَّى دَخَلْنَا الْمَدِينَةَ.
narrator_en: Narrated by Anas ibn Malik (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: Anas ibn Malik reported: We returned with the Prophet ﷺ until we approached the outskirts of Madinah, whereupon he continuously said: "Āyibūna, tā'ibūna, 'ābidūna, li-Rabbinā ḥāmidūn" (We return repenting, worshiping, and praising our Lord), repeating it until we entered Madinah.
benefits_en: Completing travels with continuous repentance and praise crowns successful journeys with humility and gratitude.

topic_en: Immense Reward for Dhikr in the Marketplace
arabic_matn: عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ: **«مَنْ دَخَلَ السُّوقَ فَقَالَ: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لَا يَمُوتُ، بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، كَتَبَ اللَّهُ لَهُ أَلْفَ أَلْفِ حَسَنَةٍ، وَمَحَا عَنْهُ أَلْفَ أَلْفِ سَيِّئَةٍ، وَرَفَعَ لَهُ أَلْفَ أَلْفِ دَرَجَةٍ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Umar ibn al-Khattab (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever enters the marketplace and says: 'La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu, yuhyi wa yumitu wa Huwa Hayyun la yamut, biyadihil-khayru wa Huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir' (There is no true deity except Allah alone, without partner; to Him belongs the dominion and all praise; He gives life and causes death, and He is Ever-Living and never dies; in His Hand is all good, and He is over all things competent), Allah records for him a million good deeds, erases a million sins from him, and elevates him a million ranks.
benefits_en: Remembering Allah in commercial hubs filled with distraction and heedlessness earns extraordinary multiplied celestial rewards.

topic_en: Supplication Upon Seeing an Afflicted Person
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«مَنْ رَأَى مُبْتَلًى فَقَالَ: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي مِمَّا ابْتَلَاكَ بِهِ، وَفَضَّلَنِي عَلَى كَثِيرٍ مِمَّنْ خَلَقَ تَفْضِيلًا، لَمْ يُصِبْهُ ذَلِكَ الْبَلَاءُ كَائِنًا مَا كَانَ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn 'Umar (رضي الله عنهما).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever sees an afflicted person and says (quietly): 'Al-ḥamdu lillāhilladhī 'āfānī mimmabtālaka bih, wa faḍḍalanī 'alā kathīrin mimman khalaqa tafḍīlā' (Praise be to Allah who has spared me from that with which He has tested you and favored me over many of those He created), that affliction will never touch him, whatever it may be.
benefits_en: Uttering this gratitude silently preserves the believer from similar trials while demonstrating empathy and avoiding hurting the feelings of the afflicted.

topic_en: Supplication Upon Breaking the Fast
arabic_matn: عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا قَالَ: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِذَا أَفْطَرَ قَالَ: **«ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ، وَابْتَلَّتِ الْعُرُوقُ، وَثَبَتَ الْأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn 'Umar (رضي الله عنهما).
english_translation: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ broke his fast, he would say: "Dhahabadh-dhama'u wabtallatil-'urūqu wa thabatal-ajru in shā' Allāh" (The thirst has gone, the veins are moistened, and the reward is confirmed, if Allah wills).
benefits_en: Acknowledging the departure of physical hunger and rejoicing in the enduring spiritual compensation promised by Allah at the moment of Iftar.

topic_en: Supplication for the Host When Dining
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ جَاءَ إِلَى سَعْدِ بْنِ عُبَادَةَ، فَجَاءَ بِخُبْزٍ وَزَيْتٍ، فَأَكَلَ، ثُمَّ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ: **«أَفْطَرَ عِنْدَكُمُ الصَّائِمُونَ، وَأَكَلَ طَعَامَكُمُ الْأَبْرَارُ، وَصَلَّتْ عَلَيْكُمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Anas ibn Malik (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ visited Sa'd ibn 'Ubadah, who served him bread and oil. The Prophet ﷺ ate and then supplicated: "Afṭara 'indakumuṣ-ṣā'imūn, wa akala ṭa'āmakumul-abrār, wa ṣallat 'alaykumul-malā'ikah" (May the fasting break their fast with you, may the righteous eat your food, and may the angels invoke blessings upon you).
benefits_en: Returning the hospitality of a generous host with heartfelt invocations for righteous companionship and angelic prayers.

topic_en: Expiation of the Gathering (Kaffarat al-Majlis)
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«مَنْ جَلَسَ فِي مَجْلِسٍ فَكَثُرَ فِيهِ لَغَطُهُ، فَقَالَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَقُومَ مِنْ مَجْلِسِهِ ذَلِكَ: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ، إِلَّا غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا كَانَ فِي مَجْلِسِهِ ذَلِكَ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever sits in a gathering where much idle and noisy talk occurs, and before standing up says: 'Subḥānakallāhumma wa biḥamdika, ash-hadu allā ilāha illā Anta, astaghfiruka wa atūbu ilayk' (Glory be to You, O Allah, and praise. I bear witness that there is no true deity except You; I seek Your forgiveness and repent to You), all that took place in that gathering will be forgiven for him.
benefits_en: Concluding every social assembly with this supplication expunges all inadvertent lapse into gossip, vain speech, and minor shortcomings.

topic_ar: عِنْدَ سَمَاعِ صِيَاحِ الدِّيَكَةِ وَنَهِيقِ الْحَمِيرِ
topic_en: Supplication Upon Hearing the Crowing of Roosters and Braying of Donkeys
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ: **«إِذَا سَمِعْتُمْ صِيَاحَ الدِّيَكَةِ فَاسْأَلُوا اللَّهَ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ؛ فَإِنَّهَا رَأَتْ مَلَكًا، وَإِذَا سَمِعْتُمْ نَهِيقَ الْحِمَارِ فَتَعَوَّذُوا بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ؛ فَإِنَّهُ رَأَى شَيْطَانًا»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "When you hear the crowing of roosters, ask Allah for His bounty, for they have seen an angel. And when you hear the braying of a donkey, seek refuge in Allah from Satan, for it has seen a devil.
benefits_en: Natural animal behaviors often perceive unseen realities; tuning our immediate reactions to ask for divine favor or seek refuge maintains constant spiritual awareness.

topic_en: Supplication When Fierce Winds Blow
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا قَالَتْ: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ إِذَا عَصَفَتِ الرِّيحُ قَالَ: **«اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا فِيهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا أُرْسِلَتْ بِهِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا أُرْسِلَتْ بِهِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'A'ishah (رضي الله عنها).
english_translation: A'ishah (رضي الله عنها) reported: When a fierce wind blew, the Prophet ﷺ would say: "Allāhumma innī as'aluka khayrahā, wa khayra mā fīhā, wa khayra mā ursilat bih, wa a'ūdhu bika min sharrihā, wa sharri mā fīhā, wa sharri mā ursilat bih" (O Allah, I ask You for its good, the good within it, and the good with which it was sent; and I seek refuge in You from its evil, the evil within it, and the evil with which it was sent).
benefits_en: Weather phenomenons are direct instruments of divine will; asking for their goodness avoids curses and turns fear into constructive supplication.

topic_en: Supplication Upon Hearing Thunder
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: أَنَّهُ كَانَ إِذَا سَمِعَ الرَّعْدَ تَرَكَ الْحَدِيثَ وَقَالَ: **«سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي يُسَبِّحُ الرَّعْدُ بِحَمْدِهِ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ مِنْ خِيفَتِهِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn az-Zubayr (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: When 'Abdullah ibn az-Zubayr (رضي الله عنه) heard thunder, he would abandon conversation and say: "Subḥānalladhī yusabbiḥur-ra'du biḥamdihi wal-malā'ikatu min khīfatih" (Glory be to Him whom the thunder glorifies with His praise, as do the angels in awe of Him [13:13]).
benefits_en: The mighty sound of thunder prompts pause and reverence, uniting human worship with the cosmic glorification of the heavens.

topic_en: Supplication When Rainfall Descends
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَانَ إِذَا رَأَى الْمَطَرَ قَالَ: **«اللَّهُمَّ صَيِّبًا نَافِعًا»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'A'ishah (رضي الله عنها).
english_translation: A'ishah (رضي الله عنها) narrated: Whenever the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saw rain, he would say: "Allāhumma ṣayyiban nāfi'an" (O Allah, make it a beneficial downpour).
benefits_en: Rainfall is a time of divine mercy and answering prayers; asking for it to be beneficial ensures it brings life rather than destruction.

topic_en: Supplication Upon Sighting the Crescent Moon
arabic_matn: عَنْ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ كَانَ إِذَا رَأَى الْهِلَالَ قَالَ: **«اللَّهُمَّ أَهْلِلْهُ عَلَيْنَا بِالْيُمْنِ وَالْإِيمَانِ، وَالسَّلَامَةِ وَالْإِسْلَامِ، رَبِّي وَرَبُّكَ اللَّهُ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Talhah ibn 'Ubaydillah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: When the Prophet ﷺ saw the new crescent moon, he would say: "Allāhumma ahlilhu 'alaynā bil-yumni wal-īmān, was-salāmati wal-Islām, Rabbī wa Rabbukallāh" (O Allah, bring it over us with blessings and faith, with security and Islam. [O crescent], my Lord and your Lord is Allah).
benefits_en: Beginning each lunar month by addressing the cosmos with monotheism and praying for spiritual steadfastness and communal security.

topic_en: Supplication and Response for Sneezing
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: **«إِذَا عَطَسَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيَقُلْ: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلْيَقُلْ لَهُ أَخُوهُ أَوْ صَاحِبُهُ: يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ، فَإِذَا قَالَ لَهُ: يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ، فَلْيَقُلْ: يَهْدِيكُمُ اللَّهُ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَكُمْ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "When one of you sneezes, let him say: 'Al-ḥamdu lillāh' (Praise be to Allah). And let his brother or companion say to him: 'Yarḥamukallāh' (May Allah have mercy on you). And when he says 'Yarhamukallah', let him reply: 'Yahdīkumullāhu wa yuṣliḥu bālakum' (May Allah guide you and set right your state).
benefits_en: Sneezing brings physiological relief; sanctifying it with mutual praise and prayers strengthens fraternal love among believers.

topic_en: Supplication Upon Visiting the Graveyard
arabic_matn: عَنْ بُرَيْدَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يُعَلِّمُهُمْ إِذَا خَرَجُوا إِلَى الْمَقَابِرِ أَنْ يَقُولُوا: **«السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ الدِّيَارِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ لَلَاحِقُونَ، أَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ لَنَا وَلَكُمُ الْعَافِيَةَ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Buraydah ibn al-Husayb (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to teach them, when visiting graveyards, to say: "As-salāmu 'alaykum ahlad-diyāri minal-mu'minīna wal-muslimīn, wa innā in shā' Allāhu lallāḥiqūn, as'alullāha lanā wa lakumul-'āfiyah" (Peace be upon you, O inhabitants of these dwellings from among the believers and Muslims! Indeed, if Allah wills, we shall join you. I ask Allah for well-being for us and for you).
benefits_en: Visiting graves awakens remembrance of mortality and offers sincere peace and supplications of well-being for departed souls.

topic_en: Supplication in Severe Distress and Anguish
arabic_matn: عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَانَ يَقُولُ عِنْدَ الْكَرْبِ: **«لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَرَبُّ الْأَرْضِ، وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn 'Abbas (رضي الله عنهما).
english_translation: In moments of intense distress and sorrow, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ would say: "Lā ilāha illallāhul-'Aẓīmul-Ḥalīm, lā ilāha illallāhu Rabbul-'Arshil-'Aẓīm, lā ilāha illallāhu Rabbus-samāwāti wa Rabbul-arḍi wa Rabbul-'Arshil-Karīm" (There is no true deity except Allah, the Magnificent, the Forbearing. There is no true deity except Allah, Lord of the Magnificent Throne. There is no true deity except Allah, Lord of the heavens, Lord of the earth, and Lord of the Noble Throne).
benefits_en: Praising Allah's majestic power and forbearance dispels overwhelming anxieties and calms distressed souls.

topic_ar: دَعْوَةُ ذِي النُّونِ فِي بَطْنِ الْحُوتِ
topic_en: Supplication of Dhun-Nun (Prophet Yunus) in Calamity
arabic_matn: عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«دَعْوَةُ ذِي النُّونِ إِذْ دَعَا وَهُوَ فِي بَطْنِ الْحُوتِ: ﴿لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ﴾، فَإِنَّهُ لَمْ يَدْعُ بِهَا رَجُلٌ مُسْلِمٌ فِي شَيْءٍ قَطُّ إِلَّا اسْتَجَابَ اللَّهُ لَهُ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The supplication of Dhun-Nun (Prophet Yunus) when he called upon Allah from the belly of the whale was: ﴿There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers﴾ (21:87). No Muslim man ever supplicates with this concerning anything except that Allah answers him.
benefits_en: This prayer contains monotheism, absolute glorification, and heartfelt admission of guilt—a guaranteed catalyst for divine rescue from all despair.

topic_ar: مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيَّ صَلَاةً صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ بِهَا عَشْرًا
topic_en: Tenfold Blessings for Sending Salawat upon the Prophet ﷺ
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ: **«مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيَّ وَاحِدَةً صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ عَشْرًا»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever sends blessings (Salah) upon me once, Allah will send blessings upon him tenfold.
benefits_en: Sending prayers upon the Prophet ﷺ brings tenfold divine mercy, forgiveness, and elevated status directly from the Lord of the worlds.

topic_ar: الْبَخِيلُ مَنْ ذُكِرْتُ عِنْدَهُ فَلَمْ يُصَلِّ عَلَيَّ
topic_en: The Real Miser Neglects Sending Salawat
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«الْبَخِيلُ الَّذِي مَنْ ذُكِرْتُ عِنْدَهُ فَلَمْ يُصَلِّ عَلَيَّ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Ali ibn Abi Talib (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The miser is the one in whose presence I am mentioned and he does not send blessings upon me.
benefits_en: Sending peace and blessings whenever the Prophet's name is heard is an essential expression of love, respect, and spiritual gratitude.

topic_en: Seeking Forgiveness One Hundred Times Daily
arabic_matn: عَنِ الْأَغَرِّ الْمُزَنِيِّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ: **«إِنَّهُ لَيُغَانُ عَلَى قَلْبِي، وَإِنِّي لَأَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ فِي الْيَوْمِ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Al-Agharr al-Muzani (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Indeed, a momentary cloud comes over my heart, and I surely seek forgiveness from Allah one hundred times every day.
benefits_en: If the sinless Messenger of Allah ﷺ sought forgiveness a hundred times daily, how much more urgently do ordinary servants require constant repentance?

topic_ar: كَثْرَةُ الصَّلَاةِ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ
topic_en: Multiplying Salawat on Friday
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَوْسِ بْنِ أَوْسٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«إِنَّ مِنْ أَفْضَلِ أَيَّامِكُمْ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ؛ فِيهِ خُلِقَ آدَمُ، وَفِيهِ قُبِضَ، وَفِيهِ النَّفْخَةُ، وَفِيهِ الصَّعْقَةُ، فَأَكْثِرُوا عَلَيَّ مِنَ الصَّلَاةِ فِيهِ؛ فَإِنَّ صَلَاتَكُمْ مَعْرُوضَةٌ عَلَيَّ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Aws ibn Aws (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Indeed, among the most virtuous of your days is Friday: on it Adam was created, on it he passed away, on it the Trumpet will be blown, and on it all creation will fall swooning. So increase your sending of blessings upon me on it, for your blessings are presented to me.
benefits_en: Friday is the master of days, and adorning it with prolific sending of Salawat upon the Prophet ﷺ connects the believer directly to the Prophet ﷺ in Barzakh.

topic_en: Supplication When Fearing the Deceit of Oppressors
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى الْأَشْعَرِيِّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ كَانَ إِذَا خَافَ قَوْمًا قَالَ: **«اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَجْعَلُكَ فِي نُحُورِهِمْ، وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شُرُورِهِمْ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Musa al-Ash'ari (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: When the Prophet ﷺ feared malice or oppression from any people, he would say: "Allāhumma innā naj'aluka fī nuḥūrihim, wa na'ūdhu bika min shurūrihim" (O Allah, we place You against their throats [to thwart their aggression] and we seek refuge in You from their evils).
benefits_en: Entrusting defense against hostile human machinations directly to Allah provides complete psychological serenity and spiritual fortitude.

topic_en: Supplication is Worship Itself
arabic_matn: عَنِ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: **«الدُّعَاءُ هُوَ الْعِبَادَةُ»**، ثُمَّ قَرَأَ: ﴿وَقَالَ رَبُّكُمُ ادْعُونِي أَسْتَجِبْ لَكُمْ إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ عَنْ عِبَادَتِي سَيَدْخُلُونَ جَهَنَّمَ دَاخِرِينَ﴾.
narrator_en: Narrated by An-Nu'man ibn Bashir (رضي الله عنهما).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Supplication (Du'a) is worship itself." Then he recited: ﴿And your Lord says, 'Call upon Me; I will respond to you.' Indeed, those who disdain My worship will enter Hell in humiliation﴾ (40:60).
benefits_en: Supplication embodies the very core of servitude because it manifests complete human helplessness and absolute reliance upon Allah's infinite power and grace.

topic_ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ حَيِيٌّ كَرِيمٌ يَسْتَحْيِي أَنْ يَرُدَّ يَدَيْ عَبْدِهِ صِفْرًا
topic_en: Allah is Shy and Generous Towards the Supplicant
arabic_matn: عَنْ سَلْمَانَ الْفَارِسِيِّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: **«إِنَّ اللَّهَ حَيِيٌّ كَرِيمٌ، يَسْتَحْيِي إِذَا رَفَعَ الرَّجُلُ إِلَيْهِ يَدَيْهِ أَنْ يَرُدَّهُمَا صِفْرًا خَائِبَتَيْنِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Salman al-Farsi (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Indeed, Allah is Modest and Generous; He feels shy, when a man raises his hands to Him in prayer, to return them empty and disappointed.
benefits_en: Raising the hands with humility and sincere conviction triggers Allah's boundless generosity and guarantees a divine response.

topic_ar: أَقْرَبُ مَا يَكُونُ الْعَبْدُ مِنْ رَبِّهِ وَهُوَ سَاجِدٌ
topic_en: The Servant is Closest to Allah in Prostration
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ: **«أَقْرَبُ مَا يَكُونُ الْعَبْدُ مِنْ رَبِّهِ وَهُوَ سَاجِدٌ، فَأَكْثِرُوا الدُّعَاءَ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The closest that a servant comes to his Lord is while he is in prostration (Sujud); so increase your supplications therein.
benefits_en: Physical prostration on the earth places the human ego at its lowest point, bringing the soul into the closest spiritual intimacy with the Most High.

topic_en: The Special Hour of Response on Friday
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ ذَكَرَ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ، فَقَالَ: **«فِيهِ سَاعَةٌ، لَا يُوَافِقُهَا عَبْدٌ مُسْلِمٌ، وَهُوَ قَائِمٌ يُصَلِّي، يَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ تَعَالَى شَيْئًا، إِلَّا أَعْطَاهُ إِيَّاهُ»** وَأَشَارَ بِيَدِهِ يُقَلِّلُهَا.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ mentioned Friday and said: "On it there is an hour; no Muslim servant happens to be standing in prayer and asking Allah Almighty for anything at that moment except that He grants it to him," and he indicated with his hand how brief it is.
benefits_en: Devoting Friday—particularly the final moments before sunset—to sincere prayer ensures catching the precious window of answered supplications.

topic_ar: الدُّعَاءُ بَيْنَ الْأَذَانِ وَالْإِقَامَةِ لَا يُرَدُّ
topic_en: Supplication Between the Adhan and Iqamah
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«الدُّعَاءُ لَا يُرَدُّ بَيْنَ الْأَذَانِ وَالْإِقَامَةِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Anas ibn Malik (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Supplication made between the call to prayer (Adhan) and the call to commence prayer (Iqamah) is never rejected.
benefits_en: The interval awaiting the congregational prayer is a sacred opportunity where the gates of divine acceptance remain wide open.

topic_en: Three Invocations That Are Never Rejected
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«ثَلَاثَةٌ لَا تُرَدُّ دَعْوَتُهُمْ: الصَّائِمُ حَتَّى يُفْطِرَ، وَالْإِمَامُ الْعَادِلُ، وَدَعْوَةُ الْمَظْلُومِ يَرْفَعُهَا اللَّهُ فَوْقَ الْغَمَامِ وَيَفْتَحُ لَهَا أَبْوَابَ السَّمَاءِ، وَيَقُولُ الرَّبُّ: وَعِزَّتِي لَأَنْصُرَنَّكِ وَلَوْ بَعْدَ حِينٍ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Three persons' supplications are never turned back: the fasting person until he breaks his fast, the just ruler, and the supplication of the oppressed person; Allah raises it above the clouds, opens the gates of the heavens for it, and the Lord says: 'By My Honor and Majesty, I shall surely aid you, even if it be after a while.
benefits_en: Injustice is spiritually catastrophic; the cry of the wronged bypasses all celestial veils directly to the Divine Court of absolute justice.

topic_ar: دَعْوَةُ الْمَرْءِ الْمُسْلِمِ لِأَخِيهِ بِظَهْرِ الْغَيْبِ
topic_en: Supplicating for a Brother in His Absence
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«دَعْوَةُ الْمَرْءِ الْمُسْلِمِ لِأَخِيهِ بِظَهْرِ الْغَيْبِ مُسْتَجَابَةٌ، عِنْدَ رَأْسِهِ مَلَكٌ مُوَكَّلٌ كُلَّمَا دَعَا لِأَخِيهِ بِخَيْرٍ، قَالَ الْمَلَكُ الْمُوَكَّلُ بِهِ: آمِينَ وَلَكَ بِمِثْلٍ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu al-Darda' (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The supplication of a Muslim person for his brother in his absence is answered. At his head there is an appointed angel; whenever he prays for goodness for his brother, the appointed angel says: 'Amin, and may you receive the same!
benefits_en: Praying sincerely for others without their knowledge proves purity of heart and guarantees the prayers of noble angels on your own behalf.

topic_ar: كَانَ أَكْثَرُ دُعَاءِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً
topic_en: The Most Frequent Supplication of the Prophet ﷺ
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: كَانَ أَكْثَرُ دُعَاءِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ: **«اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً، وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً، وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Anas ibn Malik (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: Anas ibn Malik reported that the supplication the Prophet ﷺ made most frequently was: "Allāhumma Rabbanā ātinā fid-dunyā ḥasanatan, wa fīl-ākhirati ḥasanatan, wa qinā 'adhāban-nār" (O Allah, our Lord, grant us good in this world, good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the torment of the Fire [2:201]).
benefits_en: This Qur'anic prayer combines every conceivable worldly blessing (health, provision, righteous family) with eternal salvation and safety from Hellfire.

topic_ar: يَا مُقَلِّبَ الْقُلُوبِ ثَبِّتْ قَلْبِي عَلَى دِينِكَ
topic_en: Supplication for Steadfastness of the Heart
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يُكْثِرُ أَنْ يَقُولَ: **«يَا مُقَلِّبَ الْقُلُوبِ ثَبِّتْ قَلْبِي عَلَى دِينِكَ»**، فَقُلْتُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، آمَنَّا بِكَ وَبِمَا جِئْتَ بِهِ فَهَلْ تَخَافُ عَلَيْنَا؟ قَالَ: **«نَعَمْ، إِنَّ الْقُلُوبَ بَيْنَ أُصْبُعَيْنِ مِنْ أَصَابِعِ اللَّهِ يُقَلِّبُهَا كَيْفَ يَشَاءُ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Anas ibn Malik (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: Anas ibn Malik reported: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to say frequently: "Yā Muqallibal-qulūbi thabbit qalbī 'alā dīnik" (O Turner of the hearts, keep my heart firm upon Your religion). I said: "O Messenger of Allah, we have believed in you and in what you brought; do you still fear for us?" He replied: "Yes, indeed the hearts are between two fingers of the fingers of Allah; He turns them as He wills.
benefits_en: Human hearts are ever-fluctuating; constant petitioning for divine steadfastness protects faith from corrupting temptations and doubts.

topic_ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْهُدَى وَالتُّقَى وَالْعَفَافَ وَالْغِنَى
topic_en: Asking for Guidance, Piety, Chastity, and Self-Sufficiency
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ: **«اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْهُدَى، وَالتُّقَى، وَالْعَفَافَ، وَالْغِنَى»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn Mas'ud (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ used to supplicate: "Allāhumma innī as'alukal-hudā, wat-tuqā, wal-'afāfa, wal-ghinā" (O Allah, I ask You for guidance, piety, chastity, and self-sufficiency/contentment of heart).
benefits_en: These four requests summarize complete spiritual rectitude and independence from dependency upon people.

topic_ar: التَّعَوُّذُ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَالْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ
topic_en: Seeking Refuge from Inability, Laziness, Cowardice, and Miserliness
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ يَقُولُ: **«اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْجُبْنِ وَالْهَرَمِ وَالْبُخْلِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، وَمِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Anas ibn Malik (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ used to say: "Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika minal-'ajzi wal-kasal, wal-jubni wal-harami wal-bukhl, wa a'ūdhu bika min 'adhābil-qabr, wa min fitnatil-maḥyā wal-mamāt" (O Allah, I seek refuge in You from incapacity and laziness, cowardice, debilitating senility, and miserliness; and I seek refuge in You from the torment of the grave and the trials of life and death).
benefits_en: Laziness and cowardice paralyze beneficial action; seeking divine shielding preserves vitality, generosity, and spiritual resilience.

topic_ar: التَّعَوُّذُ مِنْ زَوَالِ النِّعْمَةِ وَفُجَاءَةِ النِّقْمَةِ
topic_en: Seeking Refuge from the Cessation of Divine Favors
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا قَالَ: كَانَ مِنْ دُعَاءِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ زَوَالِ نِعْمَتِكَ، وَتَحَوُّلِ عَافِيَتِكَ، وَفُجَاءَةِ نِقْمَتِكَ، وَجَمِيعِ سَخَطِكَ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn 'Umar (رضي الله عنهما).
english_translation: Among the supplications of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was: "Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika min zawāli ni'matik, wa taḥawwuli 'āfiyatik, wa fujā'ati niqmatik, wa jamī'i sakhaṭik" (O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the cessation of Your favor, the transformation of the well-being You granted, the suddenness of Your vengeance, and all of Your wrath).
benefits_en: Praying for the preservation of faith, health, peace of mind, and divine protection against unexpected disasters.

topic_en: Comprehensive Supplication Encompassing All Prophetic Du'as
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: دَعَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِدُعَاءٍ كَثِيرٍ لَمْ نَحْفَظْ مِنْهُ شَيْئًا، قُلْنَا: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ دَعَوْتَ بِدُعَاءٍ كَثِيرٍ لَمْ نَحْفَظْ مِنْهُ شَيْئًا، فَقَالَ: **«أَلَا أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَى مَا يَجْمَعُ ذَلِكَ كُلَّهُ؟ تَقُولُ: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِ مَا سَأَلَكَ مِنْهُ نَبِيُّكَ مُحَمَّدٌ ﷺ، وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا اسْتَعَاذَ مِنْهُ نَبِيُّكَ مُحَمَّدٌ ﷺ، وَأَنْتَ الْمُسْتَعَانُ وَعَلَيْكَ الْبَلَاغُ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Umamah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: Abu Umamah reported: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ made many supplications that we could not memorize. We said: "O Messenger of Allah, you made many prayers we couldn't memorize!" He said: "Shall I not guide you to that which gathers all of that together? You say: 'Allāhumma innā nas'aluka min khayri mā sa'alaka minhu Nabiyyuka Muḥammadun ﷺ, wa na'ūdhu bika min sharri masta'ādha minhu Nabiyyuka Muḥammadun ﷺ, wa Antal-musta'ānu wa 'alaykal-balāgh, wa lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā billāh' (O Allah, we ask You for all the good that Your Prophet Muhammad ﷺ asked You for, and we seek refuge in You from all the evil that Your Prophet Muhammad ﷺ sought refuge from. You are the One whose help is sought, and upon You rests fulfillment; and there is no power and no strength except with Allah).
benefits_en: This concise invocation automatically incorporates every single noble request and protection ever uttered by the Prophet ﷺ.

topic_en: Supplication for Settling Mountains of Debt
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَلِيٍّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، أَنَّ مُكَاتَبًا جَاءَهُ فَقَالَ: إِنِّي قَدْ عَجَزْتُ عَنْ كِتَابَتِي فَأَعِنِّي، قَالَ: أَلَا أُعَلِّمُكَ كَلِمَاتٍ عَلَّمَنِيهِنَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ لَوْ كَانَ عَلَيْكَ مِثْلُ جَبَلِ صِيرٍ دَيْنًا أَدَّاهُ اللَّهُ عَنْكَ؟ قَالَ: **«قُلْ: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ، وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ»** .
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Ali ibn Abi Talib (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: Ali (رضي الله عنه) said to an indentured slave who could not pay his contract: "Shall I not teach you words which the Messenger of Allah ﷺ taught me, such that even if you had a debt like Mount Seer, Allah would pay it off for you? Say: 'Allāhummak-finī bi-ḥalālika 'an ḥarāmik, wa aghninī bi-faḍlika 'amman siwāk' (O Allah, suffice me with Your lawful provision away from Your unlawful, and enrich me with Your bounty so that I am independent of anyone besides You).
benefits_en: Sincere devotion to earning exclusively Halal combined with this supplication brings miraculous divine solutions to crushing financial liabilities.

topic_ar: دُعَاءُ التَّوَسُّلِ بِأَسْمَاءِ اللَّهِ لِقَضَاءِ الدَّيْنِ
topic_en: Supplication for Alleviating Poverty and Fulfilling Debts
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَأْمُرُنَا إِذَا أَخَذْنَا مَضْجَعَنَا أَنْ نَقُولَ: **«اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَرَبَّ الْأَرْضِ وَرَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، رَبَّنَا وَرَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ، فَالِقَ الْحَبِّ وَالنَّوَى، وَمُنْزِلَ التَّوْرَاةِ وَالْإِنْجِيلِ وَالْفُرْقَانِ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ أَنْتَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهِ، اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الْأَوَّلُ فَلَيْسَ قَبْلَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الْآخِرُ فَلَيْسَ بَعْدَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الظَّاهِرُ فَلَيْسَ فَوْقَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الْبَاطِنُ فَلَيْسَ دُونَكَ شَيْءٌ، اقْضِ عَنَّا الدَّيْنَ وَأَغْنِنَا مِنَ الْفَقْرِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
