english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Indeed, among the worst of people is the two-faced person who approaches one group with one face and another group with another face.
benefits_en: Duplicity and hypocrisy in interpersonal relations represent vile character traits despised by Allah and His Messenger.

topic_en: Seeking Refuge from Severing Kinship
arabic_matn: عَنْ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ مُطْعِمٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: **«لَا يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ قَاطِعٌ»** يَعْنِي قَاطِعَ رَحِمٍ.
narrator_en: Narrated by Jubayr ibn Mut'im (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "The one who severs (ties of kinship) will not enter Paradise.
benefits_en: Upholding ties with relatives is sacred; severing blood relations is a major sin barring entrance into Paradise.

topic_en: Seeking Refuge from Harboring Grudges and Rancor
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ: **«تُفْتَحُ أَبْوَابُ الْجَنَّةِ يَوْمَ الِاثْنَيْنِ وَيَوْمَ الْخَمِيسِ، فَيُغْفَرُ لِكُلِّ عَبْدٍ لَا يُشْرِكُ بِاللَّهِ شَيْئًا، إِلَّا رَجُلًا كَانَتْ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ أَخِيهِ شَحْنَاءُ، فَيُقَالُ: أَنْظِرُوا هَذَيْنِ حَتَّى يَصْطَلِحَا، أَنْظِرُوا هَذَيْنِ حَتَّى يَصْطَلِحَا»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The gates of Paradise are opened on Monday and Thursday, and every servant who does not associate anything with Allah is forgiven, except a man between whom and his brother there is mutual enmity and grudge. It is said: 'Delay these two until they reconcile; delay these two until they reconcile!
benefits_en: Holding grudges and malice against fellow Muslims suspends divine forgiveness twice every week until reconciliation is achieved.

topic_ar: التَّعَوُّذُ مِنَ الْقُنُوطِ مِنْ رَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ
topic_en: Seeking Refuge from Despair and Losing Hope in Allah's Mercy
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ: **«إِنَّ اللَّهَ خَلَقَ الرَّحْمَةَ يَوْمَ خَلَقَهَا مِائَةَ رَحْمَةٍ، فَأَمْسَكَ عِنْدَهُ تِسْعًا وَتِسْعِينَ رَحْمَةً، وَأَرْسَلَ فِي خَلْقِهِ كُلِّهِمْ رَحْمَةً وَاحِدَةً، فَلَوْ يَعْلَمُ الْكَافِرُ بِكُلِّ الَّذِي عِنْدَ اللَّهِ مِنَ الرَّحْمَةِ، لَمْ يَيْئَسْ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ، وَلَوْ يَعْلَمُ الْمُؤْمِنُ بِالَّذِي عِنْدَ اللَّهِ مِنَ الْعَذَابِ، لَمْ يَأْمَنْ مِنَ النَّارِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When Allah created mercy, He created a hundred parts of mercy. He retained with Himself ninety-nine parts and sent down to all His creation a single part... If the disbeliever knew of all the mercy that is with Allah, he would never despair of Paradise; and if the believer knew of all the punishment that is with Allah, he would never feel completely secure from the Fire.
benefits_en: Maintaining equilibrium between reverent fear of Allah's justice and boundless hope in His ninety-nine parts of mercy.

topic_en: Seeking Refuge from Blind Fanaticism (Asabiyyah)
arabic_matn: عَنْ جُنْدَبِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْبَجَلِيِّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«مَنْ قُتِلَ تَحْتَ رَايَةٍ عِمِّيَّةٍ، يَدْعُو عَصَبِيَّةً، أَوْ يَنْصُرُ عَصَبِيَّةً، فَقِتْلَةٌ جَاهِلِيَّةٌ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Jundab ibn 'Abdullah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever is killed fighting under a blind banner, calling to tribalism/nationalism ('Asabiyyah) or supporting tribalism, his death is a death of the days of ignorance (Jahiliyyah).
benefits_en: Islam categorically rejects tribalism, racism, and blind chauvinism; all allegiance must be centered upon truth and justice.

topic_ar: التَّعَوُّذُ مِنَ التَّشَبُّعِ بِمَا لَمْ يُعْطَ
topic_en: Seeking Refuge from False Claims and Deceptive Pretense
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا: أَنَّ امْرَأَةً قَالَتْ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أَقُولُ إِنَّ زَوْجِي أَعْطَانِي مَا لَمْ يُعْطِنِي؟ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«الْمُتَشَبِّعُ بِمَا لَمْ يُعْطَ كَلَابِسِ ثَوْبَيْ زُورٍ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'A'ishah (رضي الله عنها).
english_translation: A woman asked: "O Messenger of Allah, may I claim that my husband gave me something which he did not give me (to boast)?" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ replied: "The one who pretends to possess that which he was not given is like one who wears two garments of falsehood/forgery.
benefits_en: Boasting of unearned merits or non-existent wealth is an act of blatant deception and fraudulent posturing.

topic_en: Seeking Refuge from False Praise (Al-Maddahun)
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: أَثْنَى رَجُلٌ عَلَى رَجُلٍ عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ، فَقَالَ: **«وَيْلَكَ! قَطَعْتَ عُنُقَ صَاحِبِكَ - مِرَارًا -، إِذَا كَانَ أَحَدُكُمْ مَادِحًا صَاحِبَهُ لَا مَحَالَةَ، فَلْيَقُلْ: أَحْسِبُ فُلَانًا وَاللَّهُ حَسِيبُهُ، وَلَا أُزَكِّي عَلَى اللَّهِ أَحَدًا»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Bakrah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: A man praised another man in the presence of the Prophet ﷺ. The Prophet ﷺ said: "Woe to you! You have severed the neck of your companion (repeating it several times). If one of you must praise his companion, let him say: 'I reckon such-and-such person to be so, and Allah is his Reckoner, and I do not sanctify anyone before Allah.
benefits_en: Excessive flattery induces vanity and self-admiration; modest, conditional praise preserves the spiritual humility of the praised.

topic_en: Seeking Refuge from Eating Haram and Accepting Bribes
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا قَالَ: **«لَعَنَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ الرَّاشِي وَالْمُرْتَشِي»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn 'Amr (رضي الله عنهما).
english_translation: Abdullah ibn 'Amr (رضي الله عنهما) said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ cursed the one who offers a bribe and the one who accepts a bribe.
benefits_en: Bribery subverts justice and corrupts society; seeking refuge from illicit earnings protects one from divine expulsion.

topic_en: Seeking Refuge from Envy That Consumes Good Deeds
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ: **«إِيَّاكُمْ وَالظَّنَّ؛ فَإِنَّ الظَّنَّ أَكْذَبُ الْحَدِيثِ، وَلَا تَحَسَّسُوا، وَلَا تَجَسَّسُوا، وَلَا تَنَافَسُوا، وَلَا تَحَاسَدُوا، وَلَا تَبَاغَضُوا، وَلَا تَدَابَرُوا، وَكُونُوا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ إِخْوَانًا»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Beware of suspicion, for suspicion is the most false of speech. Do not eavesdrop, do not spy upon one another, do not outbid one another falsely, do not envy one another, do not hate one another, and do not turn your backs upon one another; and be, O servants of Allah, brothers!
benefits_en: Eradicating the spiritual diseases of suspicion, envy, and espionage establishes pure, unbreakable fraternal bonds within the community.

topic_en: Ultimate Refuge in Allah's Might from Misguidance
arabic_matn: عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَانَ يَقُولُ: **«اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ أَسْلَمْتُ، وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ، وَعَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ أَنَبْتُ، وَبِكَ خَاصَمْتُ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِعِزَّتِكَ؛ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ أَنْ تُضِلَّنِي، أَنْتَ الْحَيُّ الَّذِي لَا يَمُوتُ، وَالْجِنُّ وَالْإِنْسُ يَمُوتُونَ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn 'Abbas (رضي الله عنهما).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to say: "O Allah, to You I have submitted, in You I have believed, upon You I have relied, to You I have repented, and for You I have disputed. O Allah, I seek refuge in Your Might—there is no true deity except You—lest You lead me astray. You are the Ever-Living who never dies, while jinn and humans perish.
benefits_en: Absolute surrender to the Ever-Living Sovereign is the unbreakable fortress that permanently protects the human heart from spiritual misguidance.

topic_ar: اسْتِغْفَارُ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فِي الْيَوْمِ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ
topic_en: The Prophet's Daily Hundredfold Repentance
arabic_matn: عَنِ الْأَغَرِّ الْمُزَنِيِّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ: **«يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ، تُوبُوا إِلَى اللَّهِ؛ فَإِنِّي أَتُوبُ فِي الْيَوْمِ إِلَيْهِ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Al-Agharr al-Muzani (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "O people, repent to Allah; for indeed, I repent to Him one hundred times every day.
benefits_en: Continuous repentance (Tawbah) is not merely an atonement for sin, but an exalted station of gratitude, humility, and ongoing spiritual elevation.

topic_en: Allah's Immense Joy Over the Repentant Servant
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«لَلَّهُ أَشَدُّ فَرَحًا بِتَوْبَةِ عَبْدِهِ حِينَ يَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ، مِنْ أَحَدِكُمْ كَانَ عَلَى رَاحِلَتِهِ بِأَرْضِ فَلَاةٍ، فَانْفَلَتَتْ مِنْهُ وَعَلَيْهَا طَعَامُهُ وَشَرَابُهُ، فَأَيِسَ مِنْهَا، فَأَتَى شَجَرَةً فَاضْطَجَعَ فِي ظِلِّهَا، قَدْ أَيِسَ مِنْ رَاحِلَتِهِ، فَبَيْنَا هُوَ كَذَلِكَ إِذَا هُوَ بِهَا قَائِمَةً عِنْدَهُ، فَأَخَذَ بِخِطَامِهَا، ثُمَّ قَالَ مِنْ شِدَّةِ الْفَرَحِ: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ عَبْدِي وَأَنَا رَبُّكَ، أَخْطَأَ مِنْ شِدَّةِ الْفَرَحِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Anas ibn Malik (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Allah is more intensely pleased with the repentance of His servant when he turns to Him in repentance than one of you who was riding his camel in a barren desert, and it escaped from him carrying his food and drink. Having lost all hope, he came to a tree and lay down in its shade, despondent over his camel. While in that state, behold! He sees it standing right beside him. He grabs its halter and cries out in extreme ecstasy: 'O Allah, You are my servant and I am Your Lord!'—erring out of sheer overwhelming joy.
benefits_en: Allah's boundless love and delight when a wandering servant returns home in repentance far surpasses the wildest earthly joy.

topic_ar: بَسْطُ يَدِ اللَّهِ بِاللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ لِلتَّوْبَةِ
topic_en: Allah's Hand Stretched Open Day and Night for Repentance
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى الْأَشْعَرِيِّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: **«إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ يَبْسُطُ يَدَهُ بِاللَّيْلِ لِيَتُوبَ مُسِيءُ النَّهَارِ، وَيَبْسُطُ يَدَهُ بِالنَّهَارِ لِيَتُوبَ مُسِيءُ اللَّيْلِ، حَتَّى تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ مِنْ مَغْرِبِهَا»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Musa al-Ash'ari (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Indeed, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, stretches out His Hand by night so that the sinner of the day may repent, and He stretches out His Hand by day so that the sinner of the night may repent, until the sun rises from the west.
benefits_en: The door to divine reconciliation is perpetually open 24 hours a day; no sinner should ever delay repentance or deem their transgressions unforgivable.

topic_en: Acceptance of Repentance Before the Death Rattle
arabic_matn: عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: **«إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَقْبَلُ تَوْبَةَ الْعَبْدِ مَا لَمْ يُغَرْغِرْ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn 'Umar (رضي الله عنهما).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Indeed, Allah accepts the repentance of a servant as long as he does not reach the death rattle (the final dying breath / Ghargharah).
benefits_en: Repentance remains valid and fully accepted until the moment the soul reaches the throat and the unseen realm is unveiled.

topic_en: The Man Who Murdered One Hundred Souls and Repented
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، أَنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ: **«كَانَ فِيمَنْ كَانَ قَبْلَكُمْ رَجُلٌ قَتَلَ تِسْعَةً وَتِسْعِينَ نَفْسًا، فَسَأَلَ عَنْ أَعْلَمِ أَهْلِ الْأَرْضِ فَدُلَّ عَلَى رَاهِبٍ، فَأَتَاهُ فَقَالَ: إِنَّهُ قَتَلَ تِسْعَةً وَتِسْعِينَ نَفْسًا، فَهَلْ لَهُ مِنْ تَوْبَةٍ؟ فَقَالَ: لَا، فَقَتَلَهُ فَكَمَّلَ بِهِ مِائَةً، ثُمَّ سَأَلَ عَنْ أَعْلَمِ أَهْلِ الْأَرْضِ فَدُلَّ عَلَى رَجُلٍ عَالِمٍ، فَقَالَ: إِنَّهُ قَتَلَ مِائَةَ نَفْسٍ، فَهَلْ لَهُ مِنْ تَوْبَةٍ؟ فَقَالَ: نَعَمْ، وَمَنْ يَحُولُ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ التَّوْبَةِ؟ انْطَلِقْ إِلَى أَرْضِ كَذَا وَكَذَا؛ فَإِنَّ بِهَا أُنَاسًا يَعْبُدُونَ اللَّهَ فَاعْبُدِ اللَّهَ مَعَهُمْ، وَلَا تَرْجِعْ إِلَى أَرْضِكَ؛ فَإِنَّهَا أَرْضُ سَوْءٍ... فَتَوَفَّاهُ اللَّهُ فِي الطَّرِيقِ، فَاخْتَصَمَتْ فِيهِ مَلَائِكَةُ الرَّحْمَةِ وَمَلَائِكَةُ الْعَذَابِ... فَأَوْحَى اللَّهُ إِلَى هَذِهِ أَنْ تَبَاعَدِي، وَإِلَى هَذِهِ أَنْ تَقَرَّبِي، وَقَالَ: قِيسُوا مَا بَيْنَهُمَا، فَوُجِدَ إِلَى هَذِهِ أَقْرَبَ بِشِبْرٍ، فَغُفِرَ لَهُ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Among those before you was a man who murdered ninety-nine people. He asked about the most knowledgeable person on earth and was directed to a monk. He came to him and said: 'He has killed ninety-nine people; is there any repentance for him?' The monk said: 'No.' So he killed him, completing a hundred. Then he asked for the most knowledgeable person on earth and was directed to a scholar. He said: 'He has killed a hundred people; is there any repentance for him?' The scholar said: 'Yes! Who can possibly stand between you and repentance? Go to such-and-such land, for in it are people who worship Allah; worship Allah with them and do not return to your land, for it is an evil land.' ... He set out, but death overtook him halfway. The angels of mercy and angels of punishment disputed over him... Allah commanded the good land to draw closer and the evil land to move farther away, and said: 'Measure the distance between the two.' He was found closer to the righteous land by a single handspan, so he was forgiven.
benefits_en: No quantity of past sins can ever exhaust Allah's forgiveness for a sincere seeker who severs ties with toxic environments and journeys toward righteousness.

topic_ar: كُلُّ ابْنِ آدَمَ خَطَّاءٌ وَخَيْرُ الْخَطَّائِينَ التَّوَّابُونَ
topic_en: Every Son of Adam Errs, and the Best are Those Who Repent
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«كُلُّ ابْنِ آدَمَ خَطَّاءٌ، وَخَيْرُ الْخَطَّائِينَ التَّوَّابُونَ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Anas ibn Malik (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Every son of Adam makes mistakes, and the best of those who make mistakes are those who constantly repent.
benefits_en: Imperfection is intrinsic to human nature; moral excellence is measured not by flawless infallibility, but by swift, continuous repentance following mistakes.

topic_ar: لَوْ لَمْ تُذْنِبُوا لَذَهَبَ اللَّهُ بِكُمْ
topic_en: The Divine Wisdom Behind Human Propensity to Seek Forgiveness
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ، لَوْ لَمْ تُذْنِبُوا لَذَهَبَ اللَّهُ بِكُمْ، وَلَجَاءَ بِقَوْمٍ يُذْنِبُونَ، فَيَسْتَغْفِرُونَ اللَّهَ، فَيَغْفِرُ لَهُمْ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "By the One in Whose Hand is my soul, if you did not commit sins, Allah would replace you with a people who commit sins and then seek forgiveness from Allah, and He would forgive them.
benefits_en: Allah loves to manifest His sublime attributes of the All-Forgiving (Al-Ghafur) and the Most Merciful (Ar-Rahim) upon humble, remorseful servants.

topic_ar: يَا ابْنَ آدَمَ لَوْ بَلَغَتْ ذُنُوبُكَ عَنَانَ السَّمَاءِ
topic_en: Hadith Qudsi: Forgiving Sins as Boundless as the Earth
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ: **«قَالَ اللَّهُ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى: يَا ابْنَ آدَمَ، إِنَّكَ مَا دَعَوْتَنِي وَرَجَوْتَنِي غَفَرْتُ لَكَ عَلَى مَا كَانَ فِيكَ وَلَا أُبَالِي، يَا ابْنَ آدَمَ، لَوْ بَلَغَتْ ذُنُوبُكَ عَنَانَ السَّمَاءِ ثُمَّ اسْتَغْفَرْتَنِي غَفَرْتُ لَكَ وَلَا أُبَالِي، يَا ابْنَ آدَمَ، إِنَّكَ لَوْ أَتَيْتَنِي بِقُرَابِ الْأَرْضِ خَطَايَا ثُمَّ لَقِيتَنِي لَا تُشْرِكُ بِي شَيْئًا لَأَتَيْتُكَ بِقُرَابِهَا مَغْفِرَةً»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Anas ibn Malik (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Allah the Blessed and Exalted said: 'O son of Adam, as long as you call upon Me and put your hope in Me, I will forgive you for what you have done, and I do not mind. O son of Adam, if your sins were to reach the clouds of the sky and then you sought My forgiveness, I would forgive you, and I do not mind. O son of Adam, if you were to come to Me with an earth full of sins and then meet Me without associating any partners with Me, I would bring you an earth full of forgiveness!
benefits_en: Uncompromising pure Monotheism (Tawhid) coupled with sincere Istighfar can dissolve mountains of sins.

topic_ar: يَا عِبَادِي إِنَّكُمْ تُخْطِئُونَ بِاللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ
topic_en: Hadith Qudsi: Sins by Night and Day Forgiven
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فِيمَا يَرْوِي عَنِ اللَّهِ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى أَنَّهُ قَالَ: **«...يَا عِبَادِي، إِنَّكُمْ تُخْطِئُونَ بِاللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ، وَأَنَا أَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعًا، فَاسْتَغْفِرُونِي أَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ...»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Dharr al-Ghifari (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ reported that Allah, Blessed and Exalted, said: "...O My servants, indeed you commit errors by night and by day, and I forgive all sins; so seek My forgiveness, and I will forgive you...
benefits_en: Seeking forgiveness is an explicit divine invitation; the Creator actively calls upon His fallible servants to ask for His total pardon.

topic_en: Islam and Repentance Erase All Previous Sins
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: لَمَّا جَعَلَ اللَّهُ الْإِسْلَامَ فِي قَلْبِي أَتَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ فَقُلْتُ: ابْسُطْ يَمِينَكَ فَلْأُبَايِعْكَ، فَبَسَطَ يَمِينَهُ قَالَ فَقَبَضْتُ يَدِي، قَالَ: **«مَا لَكَ يَا عَمْرُو؟»** قَالَ: قُلْتُ: أَرَدْتُ أَنْ أَشْتَرِطَ، قَالَ: **«تَشْتَرِطُ بِمَاذَا؟»** قُلْتُ: أَنْ يُغْفَرَ لِي، قَالَ: **«أَمَا عَلِمْتَ أَنَّ الْإِسْلَامَ يَهْدِمُ مَا كَانَ قَبْلَهُ، وَأَنَّ الْهِجْرَةَ تَهْدِمُ مَا كَانَ قَبْلَهَا، وَأَنَّ الْحَجَّ يَهْدِمُ مَا كَانَ قَبْلَهُ؟»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Amr ibn al-'As (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: Amr ibn al-'As reported: When Allah placed Islam in my heart, I came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: "Extend your right hand so I may pledge allegiance to you." He extended his right hand, but I pulled my hand back. He asked: "What is the matter, O 'Amr?" I said: "I wish to stipulate a condition." He asked: "What do you stipulate?" I said: "That I be forgiven." He said: "Did you not know that Islam demolishes whatever sins came before it, that Hijrah (migration for Allah) demolishes whatever came before it, and that Hajj demolishes whatever came before it?
benefits_en: Embracing Islam, migrating for Allah's sake, and performing accepted Hajj completely wipe the slate clean of all prior transgressions.

topic_ar: التَّائِبُ مِنَ الذَّنْبِ كَمَنْ لَا ذَنْبَ لَهُ
topic_en: The Repentant is Like One Who Never Sinned
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«التَّائِبُ مِنَ الذَّنْبِ، كَمَنْ لَا ذَنْبَ لَهُ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn Mas'ud (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The one who repents from sin is like the one who has no sin at all.
benefits_en: Sincere Tawbah restores the soul to its pristine state of spiritual purity as though the transgression had never taken place.

topic_en: Remorse is the Essence of Repentance
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: **«النَّدَمُ تَوْبَةٌ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn Mas'ud (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Remorse is repentance.
benefits_en: True repentance begins with a broken heart and genuine sorrow over violating the sacred boundaries of Allah.

topic_en: The Prayer of Repentance (Salat at-Tawbah)
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ: **«مَا مِنْ عَبْدٍ يُذْنِبُ ذَنْبًا، فَيُحْسِنُ الطُّهُورَ، ثُمَّ يَقُومُ فَيُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ يَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ، إِلَّا غَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ»**، ثُمَّ قَرَأَ هَذِهِ الْآيَةَ: ﴿وَالَّذِينَ إِذَا فَعَلُوا فَاحِشَةً أَوْ ظَلَمُوا أَنْفُسَهُمْ ذَكَرُوا اللَّهَ فَاسْتَغْفَرُوا لِذُنُوبِهِمْ﴾.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Bakr as-Siddiq (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: Abu Bakr as-Siddiq reported: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "There is no servant who commits a sin, then purifies himself properly (makes Wudu), stands and prays two Rak'ahs, and then asks Allah for forgiveness, except that Allah forgives him." Then he recited this verse: ﴿And those who, when they commit an immorality or wrong themselves, remember Allah and seek forgiveness for their sins...﴾ (3:135).
benefits_en: Performing two sincere voluntary units of prayer specifically dedicated to seeking forgiveness is an established Sunnah that seals divine pardon.

topic_ar: أَذْنَبَ عَبْدٌ ذَنْبًا فَقَالَ: أَيْ رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي
topic_en: "My Servant Knows He Has a Lord Who Forgives Sins"
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فِيمَا يَحْكِي عَنْ رَبِّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ قَالَ: **«أَذْنَبَ عَبْدٌ ذَنْبًا، فَقَالَ: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذَنْبِي، فَقَالَ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى: أَذْنَبَ عَبْدِي ذَنْبًا، فَعَلِمَ أَنَّ لَهُ رَبًّا يَغْفِرُ الذَّنْبَ، وَيَأْخُذُ بِالذَّنْبِ... ثُمَّ عَادَ فَأَذْنَبَ فَقَالَ: أَيْ رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذَنْبِي، فَقَالَ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى: أَذْنَبَ عَبْدِي ذَنْبًا، فَعَلِمَ أَنَّ لَهُ رَبًّا يَغْفِرُ الذَّنْبَ، وَيَأْخُذُ بِالذَّنْبِ، قَدْ غَفَرْتُ لِعَبْدِي فَلْيَعْمَلْ مَا شَاءَ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ reported that his Lord, Blessed and Exalted, said: "A servant committed a sin and said: 'O Allah, forgive my sin.' Allah, Blessed and Exalted, said: 'My servant committed a sin and recognized that he has a Lord Who forgives sins and holds accountable for sins.' Then he committed a sin again and said: 'O my Lord, forgive my sin.' Allah said: 'My servant committed a sin and recognized that he has a Lord Who forgives sins and holds accountable for sins. I have forgiven My servant, so let him do as he wills (as long as he continually repents with sincerity).
benefits_en: Repeated slips do not nullify divine forgiveness as long as the servant perpetually returns to Allah with sincere remorse and renewed commitment.

topic_ar: مَنْ قَالَ: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الَّذِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيَّ الْقَيُّومَ
topic_en: Forgiveness Even When Fleeing from the Battlefield
arabic_matn: عَنْ زَيْدٍ مَوْلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ: أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ: **«مَنْ قَالَ: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الَّذِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيَّ الْقَيُّومَ، وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ، غُفِرَ لَهُ، وَإِنْ كَانَ فَرَّ مِنَ الزَّحْفِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Zayd, the freed slave of the Prophet ﷺ.
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever says: 'Astaghfirullāhalladhī lā ilāha illā Huwal-Ḥayyul-Qayyūm, wa atūbu ilayh' (I seek forgiveness from Allah, besides Whom there is no true deity, the Ever-Living, the Self-Sustaining, and I repent to Him), his sins will be forgiven even if he had fled from the battlefield.
benefits_en: Fleeing the battlefield is one of the seven gravest mortal sins; uttering this formula with genuine conviction expiates even catastrophic major transgressions.

topic_ar: عَدُّ مِائَةِ اسْتِغْفَارٍ فِي الْمَجْلِسِ الْوَاحِدِ
topic_en: One Hundred Prayers for Forgiveness in a Single Sitting
arabic_matn: عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا قَالَ: إِنْ كُنَّا لَنَعُدُّ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي الْمَجْلِسِ الْوَاحِدِ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ: **«رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي، وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ، إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn 'Umar (رضي الله عنهما).
english_translation: Ibn 'Umar reported: "We used to count the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying one hundred times in a single gathering: 'Rabbigh-fir lī, wa tub 'alayya, innaka Antat-Tawwābur-Raḥīm' (My Lord, forgive me and accept my repentance; indeed, You are the Accepter of repentance, the Most Merciful).
benefits_en: Emulating the Prophet's regular habit of repeating Istighfar during ordinary conversations and daily gatherings.

topic_ar: نَكْتُ النُّكْتَةِ السَّوْدَاءِ فِي الْقَلْبِ وَجَلَاؤُهَا
topic_en: The Staining and Polishing of the Heart by Sins and Repentance
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ: **«إِنَّ الْعَبْدَ إِذَا أَخْطَأَ خَطِيئَةً نُكِتَتْ فِي قَلْبِهِ نُكْتَةٌ سَوْدَاءُ، فَإِذَا هُوَ نَزَعَ وَاسْتَغْفَرَ وَتَابَ سُقِلَ قَلْبُهُ، وَإِنْ عَادَ زِيدَ فِيهَا حَتَّى تَعْلُوَ قَلْبَهُ، وَهُوَ الرَّانُ الَّذِي ذَكَرَ اللَّهُ: ﴿كَلَّا بَلْ رَانَ عَلَى قُلُوبِهِمْ مَا كَانُوا يَكْسِبُونَ﴾»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When a servant commits a sin, a black spot is stamped upon his heart. If he desists, seeks forgiveness, and repents, his heart is polished clean. But if he returns to sin, it increases until it covers his entire heart; and that is the rust (Ar-Ran) which Allah mentioned: ﴿Nay! But on their hearts is the rust of what they used to earn﴾ (83:14).
benefits_en: Unrepented sins accumulate like rust over the soul, blinding it to truth; immediate Istighfar acts as a divine polish keeping spiritual vision crystalline.

topic_ar: مَنْ لَزِمَ الِاسْتِغْفَارَ جَعَلَ اللَّهُ لَهُ مِنْ كُلِّ ضِيقٍ مَخْرَجًا
topic_en: Relief from Every Grief and Way Out from Every Distress Through Istighfar
arabic_matn: عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«مَنْ لَزِمَ الِاسْتِغْفَارَ، جَعَلَ اللَّهُ لَهُ مِنْ كُلِّ ضِيقٍ مَخْرَجًا، وَمِنْ كُلِّ هَمٍّ فَرَجًا، وَرَزَقَهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَحْتَسِبُ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn 'Abbas (رضي الله عنهما).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever adheres strictly to seeking forgiveness (Istighfar), Allah will make for him a way out from every constriction, a relief from every anxiety, and will provide for him from where he never imagined.
benefits_en: Persistent Istighfar unlocks miraculous pathways through impossible dead-ends, dissipates mental stress, and generates unforeseen livelihood.

topic_ar: طُوبَى لِمَنْ وَجَدَ فِي صَحِيفَتِهِ اسْتِغْفَارًا كَثِيرًا
topic_en: Glad Tidings to Whoever Finds Abundant Istighfar in His Record
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ بُسْرٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«طُوبَى لِمَنْ وَجَدَ فِي صَحِيفَتِهِ اسْتِغْفَارًا كَثِيرًا»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn Busr (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Glad tidings (Tuba / bliss in Paradise) to the one who finds abundant seeking of forgiveness (Istighfar) recorded in his scroll of deeds!
benefits_en: Seeing abundant records of Istighfar on the Day of Judgment transforms the terrifying accounting into an occasion of immense delight.

topic_en: Follow Up a Bad Deed with a Good Deed to Erase It
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ وَمُعَاذِ بْنِ جَبَلٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ: **«اتَّقِ اللَّهَ حَيْثُمَا كُنْتَ، وَأَتْبِعِ السَّيِّئَةَ الْحَسَنَةَ تَمْحُهَا، وَخَالِقِ النَّاسَ بِخُلُقٍ حَسَنٍ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Dharr al-Ghifari and Mu'adh ibn Jabal (رضي الله عنهما).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Fear Allah wherever you may be, follow up a bad deed with a good deed and it will wipe it out, and treat people with good moral character.
benefits_en: Active righteousness (charity, voluntary prayers, kindness) neutralizes the negative spiritual impact of past misdeeds.

topic_en: The Prescribed Prayers Expiate Minor Sins
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ: **«الصَّلَوَاتُ الْخَمْسُ، وَالْجُمُعَةُ إِلَى الْجُمُعَةِ، وَرَمَضَانُ إِلَى رَمَضَانَ، مُكَفِّرَاتٌ مَا بَيْنَهُنَّ إِذَا اجْتَنَبَ الْكَبَائِرَ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The five daily prayers, Friday to Friday, and Ramadan to Ramadan, are expiations for whatever sins occur between them, as long as major sins are avoided.
benefits_en: Consistent adherence to the pillars of worship acts as a recurring divine cleanser washing away daily minor errors.

topic_ar: خُرُوجُ الْخَطَايَا مَعَ قَطْرِ مَاءِ الْوُضُوءِ
topic_en: Sins Falling Away with the Drops of Ablution Water
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ: **«إِذَا تَوَضَّأَ الْعَبْدُ الْمُسْلِمُ - أَوِ الْمُؤْمِنُ - فَغَسَلَ وَجْهَهُ خَرَجَ مِنْ وَجْهِهِ كُلُّ خَطِيئَةٍ نَظَرَ إِلَيْهَا بِعَيْنَيْهِ مَعَ الْمَاءِ - أَوْ مَعَ آخِرِ قَطْرِ الْمَاءِ - فَإِذَا غَسَلَ يَدَيْهِ خَرَجَ مِنْ يَدَيْهِ كُلُّ خَطِيئَةٍ كَانَ بَطَشَتْهَا يَدَاهُ مَعَ الْمَاءِ - أَوْ مَعَ آخِرِ قَطْرِ الْمَاءِ - فَإِذَا غَسَلَ رِجْلَيْهِ خَرَجَتْ كُلُّ خَطِيئَةٍ مَشَتْهَا رِجْلَاهُ مَعَ الْمَاءِ - أَوْ مَعَ آخِرِ قَطْرِ الْمَاءِ - حَتَّى يَخْرُجَ نَقِيًّا مِنَ الذُّنُوبِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When a Muslim—or believer—performs ablution and washes his face, every sin he looked at with his eyes departs from his face with the water—or with the last drop of water. When he washes his hands, every sin his hands struck out at departs with the water. When he washes his feet, every sin toward which his feet walked departs with the water—until he emerges purified of all sins.
benefits_en: Performing Wudu with spiritual awareness purges sensory sins and readies the worshiper for pristine communion with Allah.

topic_en: Reconciling Injustices Before the Day of Reckoning
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«مَنْ كَانَتْ لَهُ مَظْلَمَةٌ لِأَخِيهِ مِنْ عِرْضِهِ أَوْ شَيْءٍ، فَلْيَتَحَلَّلْهُ مِنْهُ الْيَوْمَ، قَبْلَ أَنْ لَا يَكُونَ دِينَارٌ وَلَا دِرْهَمٌ، إِنْ كَانَ لَهُ عَمَلٌ صَالِحٌ أُخِذَ مِنْهُ بِقَدْرِ مَظْلَمَتِهِ، وَإِنْ لَمْ تَكُنْ لَهُ حَسَنَاتٌ أُخِذَ مِنْ سَيِّئَاتِ صَاحِبِهِ فَحُمِلَ عَلَيْهِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever has wronged his brother concerning his honor or anything else, let him seek his pardon today, before a Day comes when there will be neither Dinar nor Dirham. If he has righteous deeds, they will be taken from him in proportion to his wrongdoing; and if he has no good deeds left, the sins of the victim will be loaded onto him and he will be cast into the Fire.
benefits_en: Repentance for interpersonal violations requires seeking worldly forgiveness and returning stolen rights before currency becomes good deeds.

topic_en: The Truly Bankrupt Person on the Day of Judgment
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ: **«أَتَدْرُونَ مَا الْمُفْلِسُ؟»** قَالُوا: الْمُفْلِسُ فِينَا مَنْ لَا دِرْهَمَ لَهُ وَلَا مَتَاعَ، فَقَالَ: **«إِنَّ الْمُفْلِسَ مِنْ أُمَّتِي يَأْتِي يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ بِصَلَاةٍ، وَصِيَامٍ، وَزَكَاةٍ، وَيَأْتِي قَدْ شَتَمَ هَذَا، وَقَذَفَ هَذَا، وَأَكَلَ مَالَ هَذَا، وَسَفَكَ دَمَ هَذَا، وَضَرَبَ هَذَا، فَيُعْطَى هَذَا مِنْ حَسَنَاتِهِ، وَهَذَا مِنْ حَسَنَاتِهِ، فَإِنْ فَنِيَتْ حَسَنَاتُهُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُقْضَى مَا عَلَيْهِ، أُخِذَ مِنْ خَطَايَاهُمْ فَطُرِحَتْ عَلَيْهِ، ثُمَّ طُرِحَ فِي النَّارِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ asked: "Do you know who the bankrupt person is?" They replied: "The bankrupt among us is one who has no money and no property." He said: "The bankrupt of my Ummah is one who comes on the Day of Resurrection with prayers, fasting, and Zakah, but he comes having reviled this one, slandered that one, consumed the wealth of this one, shed the blood of that one, and beaten this one. So this victim will be given from his good deeds and that victim from his good deeds. If his good deeds run out before his dues are settled, their sins will be taken and cast upon him, and then he will be hurled into the Fire.
benefits_en: Ritual piety is completely undone by abusing human rights; true spiritual solvency demands moral integrity and swift amends.

topic_en: The Believer Views His Sin Like a Looming Mountain
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: **«إِنَّ الْمُؤْمِنَ يَرَى ذُنُوبَهُ كَأَنَّهُ قَاعِدٌ تَحْتَ جَبَلٍ يَخَافُ أَنْ يَقَعَ عَلَيْهِ، وَإِنَّ الْفَاجِرَ يَرَى ذُنُوبَهُ كَذُبَابٍ مَرَّ عَلَى أَنْفِهِ فَقَالَ بِهِ هَكَذَا»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn Mas'ud (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: Abdullah ibn Mas'ud said: "The believer views his sins as if he were sitting at the foot of a mountain fearing it might collapse upon him, while the wicked person views his sins like a fly that passed over his nose and he swatted it away like this.
benefits_en: A living heart trembles at the slightest offense against the Almighty, whereas spiritual apathy trivializes major sins.

topic_en: Converting Bad Deeds into Good Deeds Through Sincere Repentance
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«إِنِّي لَأَعْلَمُ آخِرَ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ دُخُولًا الْجَنَّةَ، وَآخِرَ أَهْلِ النَّارِ خُرُوجًا مِنْهَا... يُؤْتَى بِالرَّجُلِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ، فَيُقَالُ: اعْرِضُوا عَلَيْهِ صِغَارَ ذُنُوبِهِ، وَارْفَعُوا عَنْهُ كِبَارَهَا، فَتُعْرَضُ عَلَيْهِ صِغَارُ ذُنُوبِهِ، فَيُقَالُ: عَمِلْتَ يَوْمَ كَذَا وَكَذَا كَذَا وَكَذَا... فَيُقَالُ لَهُ: فَإِنَّ لَكَ مَكَانَ كُلِّ سَيِّئَةٍ حَسَنَةً، فَيَقُولُ: رَبِّ، إِنِّي عَمِلْتُ أَشْيَاءَ لَا أَرَاهَا هَاهُنَا!»** فَلَقَدْ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ ضَحِكَ حَتَّى بَدَتْ نَوَاجِذُهُ.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Dharr al-Ghifari (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "I know the last person to enter Paradise and the last person to come out of the Fire... A man will be brought on the Day of Resurrection and it will be said: 'Present his minor sins to him and conceal his major ones.' His minor sins will be presented and it will be said: 'You did such-and-such on such-and-such day...' Then it will be said to him: 'In place of every bad deed, you are granted a good deed!' The man will then say: 'My Lord, I committed things which I do not see mentioned here!'" The narrator said: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ laugh until his molar teeth were visible.
benefits_en: Allah's infinite grace transforms repented sins into recorded good deeds for sincere believers (25:70).

topic_ar: دُعَاءُ مَغْفِرَةِ الذُّنُوبِ كُلِّهَا فِي السُّجُودِ
topic_en: Supplication for the Forgiveness of All Sins in Sujud
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَانَ يَقُولُ فِي سُجُودِهِ: **«اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذَنْبِي كُلَّهُ: دِقَّهُ وَجِلَّهُ، وَأَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ، وَعَلَانِيَتَهُ وَسِرَّهُ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to say in his prostration: "Allāhummagh-fir lī dhanbī kullah: diqqahu wa jillah, wa awwalahu wa ākhirah, wa 'alāniyatahu wa sirrah" (O Allah, forgive all my sins: the minor and the major, the first and the last, the open and the secret).
benefits_en: Comprehensive Istighfar during prostration covers every category of sin without leaving any lingering guilt unaddressed.

topic_ar: كَانَ يُكْثِرُ أَنْ يَقُولَ: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
topic_en: Supplication of the Prophet ﷺ in His Final Days
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا قَالَتْ: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يُكْثِرُ أَنْ يَقُولَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَمُوتَ: **«سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'A'ishah (رضي الله عنها).
english_translation: A'ishah narrated: Before his passing, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to frequently say: "Subḥānallāhi wa biḥamdih, astaghfirullāha wa atūbu ilayh" (Glory be to Allah and His is the praise; I seek forgiveness from Allah and I repent to Him).
benefits_en: Concluding life's journey with intense glorification and repentance fulfills Surat an-Nasr and seals earthly existence upon ultimate humility.

topic_en: Supplication Between the Two Prostrations
arabic_matn: عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ بْنِ الْيَمَانِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ كَانَ يَقُولُ بَيْنَ السَّجْدَتَيْنِ: **«رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي، رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Hudhayfah ibn al-Yaman (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ used to say while sitting between the two prostrations: "Rabbigh-fir lī, Rabbigh-fir lī" (My Lord, forgive me; my Lord, forgive me).
benefits_en: Repeating the plea for forgiveness while sitting calmly between prostrations infuses the prayer with conscious contrition.

topic_en: Supplication for the Entire Body of Believers
arabic_matn: عَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«مَنِ اسْتَغْفَرَ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ، كَتَبَ اللَّهُ لَهُ بِكُلِّ مُؤْمِنٍ وَمُؤْمِنَةٍ حَسَنَةً»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Ubadah ibn as-Samit (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever seeks forgiveness for the believing men and believing women, Allah records for him a good deed for every believing man and believing woman.
benefits_en: Seeking forgiveness for the entire Ummah earns billions of good deeds and reflects sincere fraternal love for all believers across history.

topic_ar: كَفَّارَةُ مَنْ أَصَابَ ذَنْبًا ثُمَّ نَدِمَ
topic_en: The Atonement for the Man Who Inadvertently Sinned
arabic_matn: عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: أَنَّ رَجُلًا أَصَابَ مِنَ امْرَأَةٍ قُبْلَةً، فَأَتَى النَّبِيَّ ﷺ فَأَخْبَرَهُ، فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى: ﴿وَأَقِمِ الصَّلَاةَ طَرَفَيِ النَّهَارِ وَزُلَفًا مِنَ اللَّيْلِ إِنَّ الْحَسَنَاتِ يُذْهِبْنَ السَّيِّئَاتِ﴾، فَقَالَ الرَّجُلُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أَلِيَ هَذَا؟ قَالَ: **«لِجَمِيعِ أُمَّتِي كُلِّهِمْ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn Mas'ud (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: A man kissed a woman (unlawfully), so he came to the Prophet ﷺ and informed him. Thereupon Allah revealed: ﴿And establish prayer at the two ends of the day and at the approach of the night. Indeed, good deeds remove bad deeds﴾ (11:114). The man asked: "O Messenger of Allah, is this for me specifically?" The Prophet ﷺ replied: "It is for all of my Ummah entirely.
benefits_en: Prescribed prayers and righteous acts eliminate minor indiscretions and open doors to divine restoration for the entire Ummah.

topic_en: Sincere Repentance from Public Confession (Story of the Ghamidiyyah)
arabic_matn: عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ حُصَيْنٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: أَنَّ امْرَأَةً مِنْ غَامِدٍ أَتَتِ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ فَقَالَتْ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ طَهِّرْنِي... فَلَمَّا رُجِمَتْ صَلَّى عَلَيْهَا النَّبِيُّ ﷺ، فَقَالَ لَهُ عُمَرُ: تُصَلِّي عَلَيْهَا يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ وَقَدْ زَنَتْ؟ فَقَالَ: **«لَقَدْ تَابَتْ تَوْبَةً لَوْ قُسِمَتْ بَيْنَ سَبْعِينَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْمَدِينَةِ لَوَسِعَتْهُمْ، وَهَلْ وَجَدْتَ تَوْبَةً أَفْضَلَ مِنْ أَنْ جَادَتْ بِنَفْسِهَا لِلَّهِ تَعَالَى؟»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Imran ibn Husayn (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: A woman from Ghamid came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: "O Messenger of Allah, purify me..." After the legal prescribed punishment was carried out, the Prophet ﷺ prayed the funeral prayer over her. 'Umar said: "Do you pray over her, O Prophet of Allah, when she committed adultery?" The Prophet ﷺ replied: "She has repented with such a profound repentance that if it were distributed among seventy of the people of Madinah, it would have encompassed them all! Have you found any repentance more sublime than that she surrendered her very soul to Allah Almighty?
benefits_en: Sincere contrition and willingness to submit to divine purification wipes away the stain of mortal sin and elevates the soul to heroic spiritual heights.

topic_en: Seeking Forgiveness When Hearing Thunder or Weather Phenomena
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى الْأَشْعَرِيِّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: خَسَفَتِ الشَّمْسُ فَقَامَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ فَزِعًا يَخْشَى أَنْ تَكُونَ السَّاعَةُ... فَقَالَ: **«إِنَّ هَذِهِ الْآيَاتِ الَّتِي يُرْسِلُ اللَّهُ لَا تَكُونُ لِمَوْتِ أَحَدٍ وَلَا لِحَيَاتِهِ، وَلَكِنْ يُخَوِّفُ اللَّهُ بِهِ عِبَادَهُ، فَإِذَا رَأَيْتُمْ شَيْئًا مِنْ ذَلِكَ فَافْزَعُوا إِلَى ذِكْرِهِ وَدُعَائِهِ وَاسْتِغْفَارِهِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Musa al-Ash'ari (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The sun eclipsed, so the Prophet ﷺ stood up in alarm, fearing it might be the Hour... He said: "These signs that Allah sends do not occur for the death or life of anyone, but Allah frightens His servants with them. So when you see anything of that nature, hasten to His remembrance, supplication, and seeking His forgiveness.
benefits_en: Celestial signs should awaken immediate repentance and remembrance of ultimate accountability before Allah.

topic_en: Seeking Forgiveness for the Living and Deceased Parents
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«إِنَّ الرَّجُلَ لَتُرْفَعُ دَرَجَتُهُ فِي الْجَنَّةِ فَيَقُولُ: أَنَّى هَذَا؟ فَيُقَالُ: بِاسْتِغْفَارِ وَلَدِكَ لَكَ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "A man's rank in Paradise will be elevated and he will ask: 'From where did this come?' It will be said: 'Through your child seeking forgiveness for you.
benefits_en: Continuous Istighfar on behalf of parents continues to yield divine rewards and heavenly promotions long after their demise.

topic_en: Expiation of Social Assemblies
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا قَالَتْ: مَا جَلَسَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ مَجْلِسًا قَطُّ، وَلَا تَلَا قُرْآنًا، وَلَا صَلَّى صَلَاةً، إِلَّا خَتَمَ ذَلِكَ بِكَلِمَاتٍ: **«سُبْحَانَكَ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'A'ishah (رضي الله عنها).
english_translation: A'ishah narrated: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ never sat in any gathering, recited the Qur'an, or prayed a prayer, except that he concluded it with these words: "Subḥānaka wa biḥamdik, lā ilāha illā Ant, astaghfiruka wa atūbu ilayk" (Glory be to You and praise; there is no true deity except You; I seek Your forgiveness and repent to You).
benefits_en: Sealing every virtuous gathering with Istighfar confirms sincerity and cleanses inadvertent slips of the tongue.

topic_en: Divine Clemency and Vastness of Pardon
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: **«لَمَّا قَضَى اللَّهُ الْخَلْقَ كَتَبَ فِي كِتَابِهِ فَهُوَ عِنْدَهُ فَوْقَ الْعَرْشِ: إِنَّ رَحْمَتِي غَلَبَتْ غَضَبِي»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "When Allah decreed creation, He inscribed in His Book which is with Him above the Throne: 'Indeed, My Mercy overcomes My Wrath.
benefits_en: Divine mercy is the governing principle of existence; approaching Allah with sincere repentance always meets an ocean of overwhelming clemency.

topic_en: Supplication of Sincere Repentance After Wudu
arabic_matn: عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«مَنْ تَوَضَّأَ فَأَحْسَنَ الْوُضُوءَ ثُمَّ قَالَ: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ، اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي مِنَ التَّوَّابِينَ، وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنَ الْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ، فُتِحَتْ لَهُ أَبْوَابُ الْجَنَّةِ الثَّمَانِيَةُ يَدْخُلُ مِنْ أَيِّهَا شَاءَ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Umar ibn al-Khattab (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever performs ablution thoroughly and then says: 'Ash-hadu allā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, wa ash-hadu anna Muḥammadan 'abduhu wa Rasūluh; Allāhummaj-'alnī minat-tawwābīna waj-'alnī minal-mutaṭahhirīn' (I bear witness that there is no true deity except Allah alone, without partner, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger; O Allah, make me among those who constantly repent, and make me among those who purify themselves), the eight gates of Paradise will be opened for him to enter through whichever he wishes.
benefits_en: Uniting inward purification (repentance) with outward physical cleanliness (Wudu) unlocks all eight gates of eternal Paradise.

topic_en: Sincere Repentance of the Three Companions Who Remained Behind in Tabuk
arabic_matn: عَنْ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: ...فَلَمَّا بَلَغَتْ خَمْسُونَ لَيْلَةً مِنَ الْمُقَاطَعَةِ... أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَوْبَتَنَا عَلَى نَبِيِّهِ ﷺ... فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَوَجْهُهُ يَسْتَنِيرُ كَأَنَّهُ قِطْعَةُ قَمَرٍ: **«أَبْشِرْ بِخَيْرِ يَوْمٍ مَرَّ عَلَيْكَ مُنْذُ وَلَدَتْكَ أُمُّكَ!»** قُلْتُ: أَمِنْ عِنْدِكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَمْ مِنْ عِنْدِ اللَّهِ؟ قَالَ: **«لَا، بَلْ مِنْ عِنْدِ اللَّهِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Ka'b ibn Malik (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: Ka'b ibn Malik narrated the story of remaining behind from the Battle of Tabuk: "...When fifty nights of boycott were completed, Allah revealed our repentance to His Prophet ﷺ... The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to me, his face glowing like a piece of the full moon: 'Rejoice with the best day that has ever passed over you since your mother gave birth to you!' I asked: 'Is it from you, O Messenger of Allah, or from Allah?' He replied: 'No, rather it is directly from Allah!
benefits_en: Unflinching honesty and enduring social boycott out of submission to Allah culminated in eternal divine exoneration immortalized in the Qur'an (9:118).

topic_en: Sins Committed Openly Versus Protected Concealment
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ: **«كُلُّ أُمَّتِي مُعَافًى إِلَّا الْمُجَاهِرِينَ، وَإِنَّ مِنَ الْمُجَاهَرَةِ أَنْ يَعْمَلَ الرَّجُلُ بِاللَّيْلِ عَمَلًا، ثُمَّ يُصْبِحَ وَقَدْ سَتَرَهُ اللَّهُ فَيَقُولَ: يَا فُلَانُ، عَمِلْتُ الْبَارِحَةَ كَذَا وَكَذَا، وَقَدْ بَاتَ يَسْتُرُهُ رَبُّهُ، وَيُصْبِحُ يَكْشِفُ سِتْرَ اللَّهِ عَنْهُ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "All of my Ummah will be forgiven except those who publicize their sins (Al-Mujahirun). Indeed, it is a form of open publicity that a man commits a sin at night, and in the morning—while Allah has kept it concealed—he says: 'O so-and-so, last night I did such-and-such!' He spent the night concealed by his Lord, yet in the morning he tears away the protective veil of Allah from himself.
benefits_en: Boasting of sins or revealing them publicly strips away divine concealment and blocks forgiveness; sins must be privately repented between the soul and Allah.

topic_ar: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي مَا قَدَّمْتُ وَمَا أَخَّرْتُ
topic_en: Supplication for the Forgiveness of Past and Future Errors
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَنَّهُ كَانَ إِذَا قَامَ إِلَى الصَّلَاةِ قَالَ فِي آخِرِ مَا يَقُولُ بَيْنَ التَّشَهُّدِ وَالتَّسْلِيمِ: **«اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي مَا قَدَّمْتُ وَمَا أَخَّرْتُ، وَمَا أَسْرَرْتُ وَمَا أَعْلَنْتُ، وَمَا أَسْرَفْتُ، وَمَا أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنِّي، أَنْتَ الْمُقَدِّمُ وَأَنْتَ الْمُؤَخِّرُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Ali ibn Abi Talib (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: Ali reported that at the end of his prayer before Taslim, the Prophet ﷺ would supplicate: "Allāhummagh-fir lī mā qaddamtu wa mā akh-khart, wa mā asrartu wa mā a'lant, wa mā asraft, wa mā Anta a'lamu bihi minnī; Antal-Muqaddimu wa Antal-Mu'akh-khir, lā ilāha illā Ant" (O Allah, forgive for me what I have sent forward and what I have held back, what I have concealed and what I have declared, what I have exceeded in, and what You know better than I. You are the Advancer and You are the Delayer; there is no true deity except You).
benefits_en: This profound supplication seals prayer by placing all actions, intentions, and extravagances before Allah's boundless mercy.

topic_en: Seeking Forgiveness When Arising from Bed at Night
arabic_matn: عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا قَالَ: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ إِذَا تَهَجَّدَ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ قَالَ: **«اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ نُورُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ... اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ أَسْلَمْتُ، وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ، وَعَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ أَنَبْتُ، وَبِكَ خَاصَمْتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ حَاكَمْتُ، فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَا قَدَّمْتُ وَمَا أَخَّرْتُ، وَمَا أَسْرَرْتُ وَمَا أَعْلَنْتُ، أَنْتَ الْمُقَدِّمُ وَأَنْتَ الْمُؤَخِّرُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn 'Abbas (رضي الله عنهما).
english_translation: Ibn 'Abbas reported: When the Prophet ﷺ stood to pray Tahajjud at night, he would say: "All praise is due to You, You are the Light of the heavens and the earth and all therein... O Allah, to You I have submitted, in You I have believed, upon You I have relied, to You I have repented, for You I have disputed, and to You I have referred for judgment. So forgive me what I have sent forward and what I have kept back, what I have concealed and what I have declared; You are the Advancer and You are the Delayer, there is no true deity except You.
benefits_en: Night prayers (Tahajjud) combined with humble Istighfar illuminate the soul with celestial light and spiritual proximity.

topic_en: Istighfar During Clouded States of the Heart
arabic_matn: عَنِ الْأَغَرِّ الْمُزَنِيِّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ: **«إِنَّهُ لَيُغَانُ عَلَى قَلْبِي، وَإِنِّي لَأَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Al-Agharr al-Muzani (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Indeed, a momentary veil/cloud comes over my heart, and I seek forgiveness from Allah one hundred times every day.
benefits_en: Whenever worldly interactions temporarily distract the mind, continuous Istighfar instantly restores pristine spiritual focus.

topic_ar: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي خَطِيئَتِي وَجَهْلِي وَإِسْرَافِي فِي أَمْرِي
topic_en: Asking Forgiveness for Ignorance, Extravagance, and Inadvertent Slips
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى الْأَشْعَرِيِّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَدْعُو: **«اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي خَطِيئَتِي وَجَهْلِي، وَإِسْرَافِي فِي أَمْرِي، وَمَا أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنِّي، اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي هَزْلِي وَجِدِّي، وَخَطَايَايَ وَعَمْدِي، وَكُلُّ ذَلِكَ عِنْدِي»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Musa al-Ash'ari (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ used to supplicate: "Allāhummagh-fir lī khaṭī'atī wa jahlī, wa isrāfī fī amrī, wa mā Anta a'lamu bihi minnī. Allāhummagh-fir lī hazlī wa jiddī, wa khaṭāyāya wa 'amdī, wa kullu dhālika 'indī" (O Allah, forgive my fault and my ignorance, my extravagance in my affairs, and what You know better than I. O Allah, forgive my jest and my seriousness, my accidental errors and my deliberate sins—and all of those are present within me).
benefits_en: Acknowledging human imperfection across every spectrum of behavior (humor, seriousness, intent, and error) with total humility.

topic_ar: التَّوْبَةُ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ مِنْ مَغْرِبِهَا
topic_en: The Sincere Repentance of the Believer Before Sun Rises from the West
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«مَنْ تَابَ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ مِنْ مَغْرِبِهَا، تَابَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever repents before the sun rises from the west, Allah will accept his repentance.
benefits_en: Universal cosmic repentance closes only when the final major sign of the Hour occurs: the rising of the sun from the west.

topic_en: Three Qualities of Sincere Repentance
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَقْبَلُ التَّوْبَةَ عَنْ عِبَادِهِ، وَيَعْفُو عَنِ السَّيِّئَاتِ»**، وَفِي رِوَايَةِ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ فِي تَفْسِيرِ التَّوْبَةِ النَّصُوحِ: **«التَّوْبَةُ النَّصُوحُ: أَنْ يَتُوبَ الرَّجُلُ مِنَ الْعَمَلِ السَّيِّئِ ثُمَّ لَا يَعُودَ إِلَيْهِ أَبَدًا»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Umar ibn al-Khattab (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: In explaining Sincere Repentance (At-Tawbah an-Nasuh, 66:8), 'Umar ibn al-Khattab (رضي الله عنه) said: "Sincere repentance is that a person repents from the evil deed with immediate cessation, deep remorse, and resolves never to return to it ever again.
benefits_en: The three foundational pillars of accepted personal repentance are immediate cessation of sin, genuine remorse, and firm determination never to repeat it.

topic_en: Repentance of the Companion Ma'iz ibn Malik
arabic_matn: عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: أَنَّ مَاعِزَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ أَتَى النَّبِيَّ ﷺ فَقَالَ: إِنِّي زَنَيْتُ فَطَهِّرْنِي... فَلَمَّا أُقِيمَ عَلَيْهِ الْحَدُّ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«لَقَدْ تَابَ تَوْبَةً لَوْ قُسِمَتْ بَيْنَ أُمَّةٍ لَوَسِعَتْهُمْ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Jabir ibn Samurah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: Jabir ibn Samurah narrated that Ma'iz ibn Malik came to the Prophet ﷺ and confessed, seeking legal purification. After the sentence was carried out, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "He has repented with such a repentance that if it were divided among an entire nation, it would have sufficed them all.
benefits_en: Voluntary self-accountability and unwavering desire for purification completely absolves severe major offenses before the Lord of Creation.

topic_en: The Expiation of Fasting and Prayers During Times of Tribulation
arabic_matn: عَنْ مَعْقِلِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: **«الْعِبَادَةُ فِي الْهَرْجِ كَهِجْرَةٍ إِلَيَّ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Ma'qil ibn Yasar (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Worship (and repentance) during times of turmoil and tribulation (Al-Harj) is like migrating (Hijrah) to me.
benefits_en: Turning to Allah in repentance and steady worship when society is fractured by widespread chaos earns the monumental status of early migration to the Prophet ﷺ.

topic_en: Sincere Repentance from Shirk and Disbelief
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«قَالَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ: أَنَا عِنْدَ ظَنِّ عَبْدِي بِي، وَأَنَا مَعَهُ إِذَا ذَكَرَنِي، فَإِنْ ذَكَرَنِي فِي نَفْسِهِ ذَكَرْتُهُ فِي نَفْسِي، وَإِنْ ذَكَرَنِي فِي مَلَإٍ ذَكَرْتُهُ فِي مَلَإٍ خَيْرٍ مِنْهُمْ، وَإِنْ تَقَرَّبَ إِلَيَّ بِشِبْرٍ تَقَرَّبْتُ إِلَيْهِ ذِرَاعًا، وَإِنْ تَقَرَّبَ إِلَيَّ ذِرَاعًا تَقَرَّبْتُ إِلَيْهِ بَاعًا، وَإِنْ أَتَانِي يَمْشِي أَتَيْتُهُ هَرْوَلَةً»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Allah, Mighty and Majestic, says: 'I am as My servant expects Me to be, and I am with him when he remembers Me. If he remembers Me within himself, I remember him within Myself; and if he remembers Me in a gathering, I remember him in a gathering better than them. If he draws near to Me by a handspan, I draw near to him by an arm's length; if he draws near to Me by an arm's length, I draw near to him by a fathom; and if he comes to Me walking, I come to him with speed!
benefits_en: Taking the first humble step toward Allah in repentance is met with exponentially greater divine welcoming, mercy, and speed.

topic_en: The Broadness of Allah's Forgiveness for the Monotheist
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«يَقُولُ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ: مَنْ جَاءَ بِالْحَسَنَةِ فَلَهُ عَشْرُ أَمْثَالِهَا وَأَزِيدُ، وَمَنْ جَاءَ بِالسَّيِّئَةِ فَجَزَاءُ سَيِّئَةٍ سَيِّئَةٌ مِثْلُهَا أَوْ أَغْفِرُ، وَمَنْ تَقَرَّبَ مِنِّي شِبْرًا تَقَرَّبْتُ مِنْهُ ذِرَاعًا... وَمَنْ لَقِيَنِي بِقُرَابِ الْأَرْضِ خَطِيئَةً لَا يُشْرِكُ بِي شَيْئًا لَقِيتُهُ بِمِثْلِهَا مَغْفِرَةً»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Dharr al-Ghifari (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Allah, Mighty and Majestic, says: 'Whoever brings a good deed will have tenfold its reward and I increase more; and whoever brings an evil deed, its recompense is an evil deed like it, or I forgive. And whoever meets Me with an earth full of sins while not associating any partner with Me, I will meet him with equivalent forgiveness!
benefits_en: Unadulterated Tawhid is the supreme key that unlocks unconditional divine pardon for overwhelming sins.

topic_ar: خَاتِمَةُ السَّعَادَةِ: مَنْ كَانَ آخِرُ كَلَامِهِ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ
topic_en: The Final Word of Salvation: La Ilaha Illallah
arabic_matn: عَنْ مُعَاذِ بْنِ جَبَلٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«مَنْ كَانَ آخِرُ كَلَامِهِ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Mu'adh ibn Jabal (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever's last words (in this world) are 'Lā ilāha illallāh' (There is no true deity except Allah) will enter Paradise.
benefits_en: Living a life of sincere repentance, monotheism, and constant Istighfar facilitates departing this world with the declaration of pure faith on one's dying breath.

topic_en: The Mother Deserves the Highest Companionship
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، مَنْ أَحَقُّ النَّاسِ بِحُسْنِ صَحَابَتِي؟ قَالَ: **«أُمُّكَ»**، قَالَ: ثُمَّ مَنْ؟ قَالَ: **«ثُمَّ أُمُّكَ»**، قَالَ: ثُمَّ مَنْ؟ قَالَ: **«ثُمَّ أُمُّكَ»**، قَالَ: ثُمَّ مَنْ؟ قَالَ: **«ثُمَّ أَبُوكَ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: A man came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and asked: "O Messenger of Allah, who among mankind is most deserving of my good companionship and devotion?" The Prophet ﷺ replied: "Your mother." The man asked: "Then who?" He replied: "Then your mother." The man asked: "Then who?" He replied: "Then your mother." The man asked: "Then who?" He replied: "Then your father.
benefits_en: The mother is accorded threefold priority in kindness, honor, and service due to the unparalleled hardships of pregnancy, labor, and nursing.

topic_en: Devotion to Parents Takes Precedence Over Voluntary Jihad
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا قَالَ: جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ يَسْتَأْذِنُهُ فِي الْجِهَادِ، فَقَالَ: **«أَحَيٌّ وَالِدَاكَ؟»** قَالَ: نَعَمْ، قَالَ: **«فَفِيهِمَا فَجَاهِدْ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn 'Amr (رضي الله عنهما).
english_translation: A man came to the Prophet ﷺ asking permission to participate in Jihad. The Prophet ﷺ asked him: "Are your parents alive?" He replied: "Yes." The Prophet ﷺ said: "Then upon serving them let your striving (Jihad) be!
benefits_en: Caring for elderly parents and comforting their hearts is an exalted, primary form of Jihad that takes priority over voluntary military campaigns.

topic_en: The Lord's Pleasure Lies in the Pleasure of the Parents
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: **«رِضَا الرَّبِّ فِي رِضَا الْوَالِدِ، وَسَخَطُ الرَّبِّ فِي سَخَطِ الْوَالِدِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn 'Amr (رضي الله عنهما).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "The pleasure of the Lord is in the pleasure of the parent, and the wrath of the Lord is in the wrath of the parent.
benefits_en: Attaining divine favor is fundamentally tied to treating parents with honor, obedience, and gentleness.

topic_ar: رَغِمَ أَنْفُ مَنْ أَدْرَكَ وَالِدَيْهِ عِنْدَ الْكِبَرِ فَلَمْ يَدْخُلِ الْجَنَّةَ
topic_en: Humiliation for the One Who Neglects Aging Parents
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: **«رَغِمَ أَنْفُ، ثُمَّ رَغِمَ أَنْفُ، ثُمَّ رَغِمَ أَنْفُ»** قِيلَ: مَنْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ؟ قَالَ: **«مَنْ أَدْرَكَ أَبَوَيْهِ عِنْدَ الْكِبَرِ، أَحَدَهُمَا أَوْ كِلَيْهِمَا، فَلَمْ يَدْخُلِ الْجَنَّةَ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "May he be disgraced, then disgraced, and disgraced!" It was asked: "Who, O Messenger of Allah?" He replied: "The one whose parents—one or both of them—reach old age during his lifetime, and yet he fails to enter Paradise (through serving them).
benefits_en: Caring for elderly parents is an effortless, golden highway leading directly to Paradise; neglecting them is an unforgivable spiritual failure.

topic_en: The Father is the Central Gateway to Paradise
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ: **«الْوَالِدُ أَوْسَطُ أَبْوَابِ الْجَنَّةِ؛ فَإِنْ شِئْتَ فَأَضِعْ ذَلِكَ الْبَابَ، أَوِْ احْفَظْهُ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu al-Darda' (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: Abu al-Darda' reported: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "The father is the middle gate of Paradise; so if you wish, lose that gate or preserve it.
benefits_en: Honoring, obeying, and respecting one's father secures the best and most spacious portal into the eternal gardens of Paradise.

topic_ar: بِرُّ الْوَالِدَيْنِ بَعْدَ الصَّلَاةِ عَلَى وَقْتِهَا
topic_en: Filial Piety Ranks Right After Prayer on Time
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ: أَيُّ الْعَمَلِ أَحَبُّ إِلَى اللَّهِ؟ قَالَ: **«الصَّلَاةُ عَلَى وَقْتِهَا»**، قَالَ: ثُمَّ أَيٌّ؟ قَالَ: **«ثُمَّ بِرُّ الْوَالِدَيْنِ»**، قَالَ: ثُمَّ أَيٌّ؟ قَالَ: **«الْجِهَادُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn Mas'ud (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: Abdullah ibn Mas'ud asked the Prophet ﷺ: "Which deed is most beloved to Allah?" He replied: "Prayer performed at its appointed time." I asked: "Then which?" He said: "Then filial piety towards parents." I asked: "Then which?" He said: "Then Jihad in the path of Allah.
benefits_en: Filial devotion to mother and father stands immediately after the primary pillar of prayer in divine preference.

topic_en: The Maternal Aunt Holds the Station of the Mother
arabic_matn: عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: **«الْخَالَةُ بِمَنْزِلَةِ الْأُمِّ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Al-Bara' ibn 'Azib (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "The maternal aunt is in the position and station of the mother (in kindness, affection, and custody).
benefits_en: Honoring, visiting, and serving one's maternal aunt mirrors the religious obligation and spiritual rewards of filial devotion to the mother.

topic_en: Maintaining Ties with the Friends of One's Father
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ: **«إِنَّ أَبَرَّ الْبِرِّ صِلَةُ الْوَلَدِ أَهْلَ وُدِّ أَبِيهِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn 'Umar (رضي الله عنهما).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Indeed, the highest form of filial piety is for a child to maintain ties with the friends and loved ones of his father after he is gone.
benefits_en: Honoring the close companions and friends of deceased parents is an ongoing manifestation of posthumous filial devotion.

topic_ar: صِلَةُ الرَّحِمِ مَبْسَطَةٌ لِلرِّزْقِ مَنْسَأَةٌ فِي الْأَثَرِ
topic_en: Maintaining Kinship Expands Provision and Extends Lifespan
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ: **«مَنْ أَحَبَّ أَنْ يُبْسَطَ لَهُ فِي رِزْقِهِ، وَيُنْسَأَ لَهُ فِي أَثَرِهِ، فَلْيَصِلْ رَحِمَهُ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Anas ibn Malik (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever loves to have his provision expanded and his lifespan extended (in barakah and legacy), let him uphold the ties of kinship.
benefits_en: Maintaining warm family ties brings tangible divine barakah into financial earnings and bestows a long, fruitful life and enduring legacy.

topic_en: The Sacred Covenant of the Womb (Ar-Rahim) with the Throne
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا قَالَتْ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«الرَّحِمُ مُعَلَّقَةٌ بِالْعَرْشِ تَقُولُ: مَنْ وَصَلَنِي وَصَلَهُ اللَّهُ، وَمَنْ قَطَعَنِي قَطَعَهُ اللَّهُ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'A'ishah (رضي الله عنها).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The womb (kinship) is suspended from the Throne of Allah, proclaiming: 'Whoever maintains me, Allah will maintain him; and whoever severs me, Allah will sever him!
benefits_en: Upholding ties with relatives guarantees divine connection and mercy, while severing them invites spiritual abandonment from Allah.

topic_en: The True Upholder of Kinship Reconnects When Severed
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: **«لَيْسَ الْوَاصِلُ بِالْمُكَافِئِ، وَلَكِنِ الْوَاصِلُ الَّذِي إِذَا قُطِعَتْ رَحِمُهُ وَصَلَهَا»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn 'Amr (رضي الله عنهما).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "The true upholder of kinship is not the one who merely reciprocates (visits only when visited); rather, the true upholder of kinship is the one who, when his family ties are severed, reconnects them.
benefits_en: Genuine spiritual nobility is demonstrated by taking the initiative to forgive, visit, and embrace estranged relatives.

topic_en: Maintaining Ties with Mistreating Relatives
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: أَنَّ رَجُلًا قَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنَّ لِي قَرَابَةً أَصِلُهُمْ وَيَقْطَعُونِي، وَأُحْسِنُ إِلَيْهِمْ وَيُسِيئُونَ إِلَيَّ، وَأَحْلُمُ عَنْهُمْ وَيَجْهَلُونَ عَلَيَّ، فَقَالَ: **«لَئِنْ كُنْتَ كَمَا قُلْتَ، فَكَأَنَّمَا تُسِفُّهُمُ الْمَلَّ، وَلَا يَزَالُ مَعَكَ مِنَ اللَّهِ ظَهِيرٌ عَلَيْهِمْ مَا دُمْتَ عَلَى ذَلِكَ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: A man said: "O Messenger of Allah, I have relatives with whom I try to maintain ties while they sever them; I do good to them while they mistreat me; and I am patient with them while they act harshly against me." The Prophet ﷺ said: "If you are as you say, it is as if you are feeding them hot ashes (while they bear the sin), and you will not cease to have an appointed supporter from Allah against them as long as you remain on that course.
benefits_en: Responding to family hostility with persistent benevolence grants divine protection and places the moral high ground firmly with the peacemaker.

topic_en: Charity to Relatives Yields a Double Reward
arabic_matn: عَنْ سَلْمَانَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ الضَّبِّيِّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: **«الصَّدَقَةُ عَلَى الْمِسْكِينِ صَدَقَةٌ، وَهِيَ عَلَى ذِي الرَّحِمِ ثِنْتَانِ: صَدَقَةٌ وَصِلَةٌ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Salman ibn 'Amir ad-Dabbi (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Charity given to a poor person is counted as charity, while charity given to a relative is counted as two things: charity and maintaining the ties of kinship.
benefits_en: Supporting impoverished family members earns double credit by fulfilling economic relief and cementing sacred kinship bonds.

topic_en: Continuous Exhortation Regarding the Neighbor
arabic_matn: عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ وَعَائِشَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ قَالَا: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«مَا زَالَ جِبْرِيلُ يُوصِينِي بِالْجَارِ، حَتَّى ظَنَنْتُ أَنَّهُ سَيُوَرِّثُهُ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn 'Umar and 'A'ishah (رضي الله عنهم).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Jibril kept advising me so emphatically concerning the rights of the neighbor that I thought he would soon declare him an heir.
benefits_en: Kindness, patience, and honoring the rights of neighbors is a fundamental pillar of Islamic social ethics emphasized by archangel Jibril.

topic_ar: لَا يُؤْمِنُ مَنْ لَا يَأْمَنُ جَارُهُ بَوَائِقَهُ
topic_en: Negating True Faith from the One Whose Neighbor is Unsafe
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ: **«وَاللَّهِ لَا يُؤْمِنُ، وَاللَّهِ لَا يُؤْمِنُ، وَاللَّهِ لَا يُؤْمِنُ»**، قِيلَ: وَمَنْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ؟ قَالَ: **«الَّذِي لَا يَأْمَنُ جَارُهُ بَوَائِقَهُ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ swore: "By Allah, he does not truly believe! By Allah, he does not truly believe! By Allah, he does not truly believe!" It was asked: "Who, O Messenger of Allah?" He replied: "The one whose neighbor is not safe from his harm and malice.
benefits_en: Harming neighbors through noise, property encroachment, or bad character fundamentally undermines the authenticity of one's faith.

topic_ar: لَيْسَ الْمُؤْمِنُ الَّذِي يَشْبَعُ وَجَارُهُ جَائِعٌ
topic_en: Eating One's Fill While the Neighbor Goes Hungry
arabic_matn: عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ: **«لَيْسَ الْمُؤْمِنُ الَّذِي يَشْبَعُ وَجَارُهُ جَائِعٌ إِلَى جَنْبِهِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn 'Abbas (رضي الله عنهما).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "He is not a true believer who eats his fill while his neighbor next door goes hungry.
benefits_en: Islamic brotherhood mandates active social awareness; allowing neighbors to suffer in poverty while living in luxury is incompatible with true faith.

topic_ar: إِذَا طَبَخْتَ مَرَقَةً فَأَكْثِرْ مَاءَهَا وَتَعَاهَدْ جِيرَانَكَ
topic_en: Adding Water to the Broth to Share with Neighbors
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«يَا أَبَا ذَرٍّ، إِذَا طَبَخْتَ مَرَقَةً فَأَكْثِرْ مَاءَهَا، وَتَعَاهَدْ جِيرَانَكَ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Dharr al-Ghifari (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: Abu Dharr reported: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to me: "O Abu Dharr, when you cook broth, add more water to it, and send some of it to your neighbors.
benefits_en: Neighborliness does not require lavish spending; simple, thoughtful gestures of sharing food cultivate community love and harmony.

topic_en: Sponsoring the Orphan in Paradise
arabic_matn: عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«أَنَا وَكَافِلُ الْيَتِيمِ فِي الْجَنَّةِ هَكَذَا»**، وَأَشَارَ بِالسَّبَّابَةِ وَالْوُسْطَى، وَفَرَّجَ بَيْنَهُمَا شَيْئًا.
narrator_en: Narrated by Sahl ibn Sa'd (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "I and the sponsor of an orphan will be in Paradise like this," and he gestured with his index and middle fingers, separating them slightly.
benefits_en: Financially supporting and compassionately mentoring orphans secures direct eternal companionship with the Prophet ﷺ in the highest ranks of Paradise.

topic_en: Striving for the Care of Widows and the Destitute
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ: **«السَّاعِي عَلَى الْأَرْمَلَةِ وَالْمِسْكِينِ، كَالْمُجَاهِدِ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ، أَوِ الْقَائِمِ اللَّيْلَ الصَّائِمِ النَّهَارَ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "The one who strives to support the widow and the destitute is like the warrior striving in the cause of Allah, or like the one who stands praying all night and fasts all day.
benefits_en: Devoting time and resources to community welfare matches the spiritual reward of perpetual fasting and continuous night prayer.

topic_ar: لَيْسَ مِنَّا مَنْ لَمْ يَرْحَمْ صَغِيرَنَا وَيُوَقِّرْ كَبِيرَنَا
topic_en: Showing Mercy to the Young and Respect to the Elderly
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: **«لَيْسَ مِنَّا مَنْ لَمْ يَرْحَمْ صَغِيرَنَا، وَيَعْرِفْ شَرَفَ كَبِيرِنَا»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn 'Amr (رضي الله عنهما).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "He is not one of us who does not show mercy to our young and does not recognize the honor and dignity of our elders.
benefits_en: A healthy Islamic society rests on the dual pillars of tender affection toward youth and reverent deference toward senior members.

topic_en: The Merciful are Shown Mercy by the Most Merciful
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«الرَّاحِمُونَ يَرْحَمُهُمُ الرَّحْمَنُ، ارْحَمُوا مَنْ فِي الْأَرْضِ يَرْحَمْكُمْ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاءِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn 'Amr (رضي الله عنهما).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Those who are merciful will be shown mercy by the Most Merciful. Be merciful to those on earth, and the One in the heavens will be merciful to you.
benefits_en: Showing active compassion to all living beings on earth unlocks the boundless, descending mercy of the Lord of the Universe.

topic_en: Whoever Does Not Show Mercy Will Not Receive Mercy
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَبَّلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ الْحَسَنَ بْنَ عَلِيٍّ وَعِنْدَهُ الْأَقْرَعُ بْنُ حَابِسٍ، فَقَالَ الْأَقْرَعُ: إِنَّ لِي عَشَرَةً مِنَ الْوَلَدِ مَا قَبَّلْتُ مِنْهُمْ أَحَدًا، فَنَظَرَ إِلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ ثُمَّ قَالَ: **«مَنْ لَا يَرْحَمْ لَا يُرْحَمْ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ kissed Al-Hasan ibn 'Ali while Al-Aqra' ibn Habis was sitting with him. Al-Aqra' said: "I have ten children, and I have never kissed a single one of them!" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ looked at him and said: "He who does not show mercy will not be shown mercy.
benefits_en: Expressing physical warmth, affection, and tenderness to young children is an essential sign of a living, merciful heart.

topic_en: Raising and Caring for Daughters
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«مَنْ عَالَ جَارِيَتَيْنِ حَتَّى تَبْلُغَا، جَاءَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ أَنَا وَهُوَ»** وَضَمَّ أَصَابِعَهُ.
narrator_en: Narrated by Anas ibn Malik (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever lovingly raises two daughters until they reach maturity, he and I will come on the Day of Resurrection like this," and he joined his fingers together.
benefits_en: Raising daughters with patience, education, and love shatters pre-Islamic misogyny and earns immediate proximity to the Prophet ﷺ in Paradise.

topic_en: Strict Justice Among Children in Gifting
arabic_matn: عَنِ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا: أَنَّ أَبَاهُ أَتَى بِهِ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ: إِنِّي نَحَلْتُ ابْنِي هَذَا غُلَامًا، فَقَالَ: **«أَكُلَّ وَلَدِكَ نَحَلْتَ مِثْلَهُ؟»** قَالَ: لَا، قَالَ: **«فَارْجِعْهُ»**، وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ: **«فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَاعْدِلُوا بَيْنَ أَوْلَادِكُمْ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by An-Nu'man ibn Bashir (رضي الله عنهما).
english_translation: An-Nu'man ibn Bashir reported that his father took him to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said: "I have given this son of mine a gift." The Prophet ﷺ asked: "Have you given all your children the like of it?" He said: "No." The Prophet ﷺ said: "Take it back." And in another narration: "Fear Allah, and treat your children with strict equality and justice.
benefits_en: Favoritism among children breeds jealousy, hostility, and filial rebellion; strict fairness in financial gifts is an obligatory duty.

topic_ar: الْبِرُّ حُسْنُ الْخُلُقِ وَالْإِثْمُ مَا حَاكَ فِي النَّفْسِ
topic_en: The Definition of True Piety (Al-Birr) and Sin
arabic_matn: عَنِ النَّوَّاسِ بْنِ سَمْعَانَ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنِ الْبِرِّ وَالْإِثْمِ، فَقَالَ: **«الْبِرُّ حُسْنُ الْخُلُقِ، وَالْإِثْمُ مَا حَاكَ فِي صَدْرِكَ، وَكَرِهْتَ أَنْ يَطَّلِعَ عَلَيْهِ النَّاسُ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by An-Nawwas ibn Sam'an (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: An-Nawwas ibn Sam'an reported: I asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about righteousness and sin. He said: "Righteousness (Al-Birr) is good character; and sin is that which wavers within your chest and you hate for people to discover.
benefits_en: Noble moral character is the essence of piety; the innate conscience (Fitrah) naturally recoils from sin and desires to keep it hidden.

topic_en: The Six Mutual Rights of a Muslim
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ: **«حَقُّ الْمُسْلِمِ عَلَى الْمُسْلِمِ سِتٌّ»** قِيلَ: مَا هُنَّ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ؟ قَالَ: **«إِذَا لَقِيتَهُ فَسَلِّمْ عَلَيْهِ، وَإِذَا دَعَاكَ فَأَجِبْهُ، وَإِذَا اسْتَنْصَحَكَ فَانْصَحْ لَهُ، وَإِذَا عَطَسَ فَحَمِدَ اللَّهَ فَشَمِّتْهُ، وَإِذَا مَرِضَ فَعُدْهُ، وَإِذَا مَاتَ فَاتَّبِعْهُ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The rights of a Muslim upon another Muslim are six." It was asked: "What are they, O Messenger of Allah?" He replied: "When you meet him, greet him with peace; when he invites you, accept his invitation; when he seeks your sincere advice, advise him; when he sneezes and praises Allah, pray for mercy for him; when he falls ill, visit him; and when he dies, follow his funeral.
benefits_en: These six social obligations establish communal solidarity, eliminate estrangement, and maintain fraternal love across society.

topic_ar: مَثَلُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ فِي تَوَادِّهِمْ كَمَثَلِ الْجَسَدِ الْوَاحِدِ
topic_en: The Parable of Believers as One Living Body
arabic_matn: عَنِ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«مَثَلُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ فِي تَوَادِّهِمْ، وَتَرَاحُمِهِمْ، وَتَعَاطُفِهِمْ مَثَلُ الْجَسَدِ؛ إِذَا اشْتَكَى مِنْهُ عُضْوٌ تَدَاعَى لَهُ سَائِرُ الْجَسَدِ بِالسَّهَرِ وَالْحُمَّى»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by An-Nu'man ibn Bashir (رضي الله عنهما).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The example of the believers in their mutual love, mercy, and compassion is like that of a single body: if one limb suffers, the entire body responds to it with sleeplessness and fever.
benefits_en: Global Islamic unity demands profound empathy where the pain of any oppressed believer anywhere vibrates across the collective consciousness of the Ummah.

topic_en: Believers are Like a Firm Compact Building
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى الْأَشْعَرِيِّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: **«الْمُؤْمِنُ لِلْمُؤْمِنِ كَالْبُنْيَانِ يَشُدُّ بَعْضُهُ بَعْضًا»**، وَشَبَّكَ بَيْنَ أَصَابِعِهِ.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Musa al-Ash'ari (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "A believer to another believer is like a firm structure, each part supporting and reinforcing the other," and he interlaced his fingers.
benefits_en: Communal strength arises from mutual cooperation, constructive support, and intertwining individual abilities for collective success.

topic_ar: لَا يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى يُحِبَّ لِأَخِيهِ مَا يُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِهِ
topic_en: Loving for One's Brother What One Loves for Oneself
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: **«لَا يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى يُحِبَّ لِأَخِيهِ مَا يُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِهِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Anas ibn Malik (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself of goodness.
benefits_en: Complete faith purges egoistic jealousy and inspires sincere desire to see fellow human beings enjoy the same blessings, success, and guidance one wishes for oneself.

topic_en: Prohibition of Forsaking a Brother Beyond Three Days
