arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ: **«لَا يَحِلُّ لِرَجُلٍ أَنْ يَهْجُرَ أَخَاهُ فَوْقَ ثَلَاثِ لَيَالٍ؛ يَلْتَقِيَانِ فَيُعْرِضُ هَذَا وَيُعْرِضُ هَذَا، وَخَيْرُهُمَا الَّذِي يَبْدَأُ بِالسَّلَامِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Ayyub al-Ansari (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "It is not permissible for a Muslim to boycott his brother for more than three nights, such that when they meet, this one turns away and that one turns away; and the better of the two is the one who initiates the greeting of peace.
benefits_en: Personal disagreements may have a cooling-off period of at most three days; initiating reconciliation through Salam proves superior spiritual maturity.

topic_en: The Superiority of Reconciling Between People
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«أَلَا أُخْبِرُكُمْ بِأَفْضَلَ مِنْ دَرَجَةِ الصِّيَامِ وَالصَّلَاةِ وَالصَّدَقَةِ؟»** قَالُوا: بَلَى، قَالَ: **«صَلَاحُ ذَاتِ الْبَيْنِ؛ فَإِنَّ فَسَادَ ذَاتِ الْبَيْنِ هِيَ الْحَالِقَةُ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu al-Darda' (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Shall I not inform you of something superior in rank to voluntary fasting, prayer, and charity?" They said: "Yes, indeed!" He said: "Reconciling between people; for indeed, discord between people is the razor—I do not say it shaves hair, but it shaves away religion.
benefits_en: Active peacemaking and mending broken relationships preserves the religious and social fabric of the entire community.

topic_en: Walking to Fulfill the Need of a Brother
arabic_matn: عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ: **«أَحَبُّ النَّاسِ إِلَى اللَّهِ أَنْفَعُهُمْ لِلنَّاسِ، وَأَحَبُّ الْأَعْمَالِ إِلَى اللَّهِ سُرُورٌ تُدْخِلُهُ عَلَى مُسْلِمٍ، أَوْ تَكْشِفُ عَنْهُ كُرْبَةً، أَوْ تَقْضِي عَنْهُ دَيْنًا، أَوْ تَطْرُدُ عَنْهُ جُوعًا، وَلَأَنْ أَمْشِيَ مَعَ أَخٍ لِي فِي حَاجَةٍ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِنْ أَنْ أَعْتَكِفَ فِي هَذَا الْمَسْجِدِ - يَعْنِي مَسْجِدَ الْمَدِينَةِ - شَهْرًا»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn 'Umar (رضي الله عنهما).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "The most beloved of people to Allah are those who are most beneficial to people. The most beloved deed to Allah is bringing joy to the heart of a Muslim, relieving his distress, settling his debt, or warding off his hunger. That I should walk with a brother of mine to fulfill a need for him is dearer to me than performing I'tikaf in this mosque of mine (in Madinah) for an entire month!
benefits_en: Serving fellow humans and alleviating societal hardships holds immense spiritual weight that surpasses prolonged solitary seclusion in the Prophet's Mosque.

topic_en: Removing Harmful Obstacles from the Public Path
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«كُلُّ سُلَامَى مِنَ النَّاسِ عَلَيْهِ صَدَقَةٌ، كُلَّ يَوْمٍ تَطْلُعُ فِيهِ الشَّمْسُ... وَتُمِيطُ الْأَذَى عَنِ الطَّرِيقِ صَدَقَةٌ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Upon every joint of the human body there is charity due for every day the sun rises... and removing an obstacle or harmful thing from the path is a charity.
benefits_en: Civil responsibility, environmental cleanliness, and public safety are treated as direct acts of religious worship and physical charity.

topic_ar: غُفِرَ لَهُ بِغُصْنِ شَوْكٍ نَحَّاهُ عَنِ الطَّرِيقِ
topic_en: The Man Forgiven for Removing a Thorny Branch
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ: **«بَيْنَمَا رَجُلٌ يَمْشِي بِطَرِيقٍ وَجَدَ غُصْنَ شَوْكٍ عَلَى الطَّرِيقِ فَأَخَّرَهُ، فَشَكَرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ فَغَفَرَ لَهُ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "While a man was walking along a path, he found a thorny branch in the way and pushed it aside. Allah appreciated his deed and granted him forgiveness.
benefits_en: Never belittle small acts of public kindness; a single sincere deed removing danger for travelers can earn total divine forgiveness.

topic_en: Mercy to Animals Brings Divine Forgiveness
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ: **«بَيْنَمَا رَجُلٌ يَمْشِي بِطَرِيقٍ اشْتَدَّ عَلَيْهِ الْعَطَشُ، فَوَجَدَ بِئْرًا فَنَزَلَ فِيهَا فَشَرِبَ، ثُمَّ خَرَجَ فَإِذَا كَلْبٌ يَلْهَثُ يَأْكُلُ الثَّرَى مِنَ الْعَطَشِ... فَنَزَلَ الْبِئْرَ فَمَلَأَ خُفَّهُ مَاءً، ثُمَّ أَمْسَكَهُ بِفِيهِ حَتَّى رَقِيَ، فَسَقَى الْكَلْبَ، فَشَكَرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ فَغَفَرَ لَهُ»**، قَالُوا: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، وَإِنَّ لَنَا فِي الْبَهَائِمِ لَأَجْرًا؟ فَقَالَ: **«فِي كُلِّ كَبِدٍ رَطْبَةٍ أَجْرٌ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "While a man was walking, he suffered extreme thirst. He found a well, climbed down and drank. Upon emerging, he saw a dog panting and licking the moist earth out of intense thirst... The man climbed down the well, filled his leather sock with water, held it in his teeth, climbed back up, and gave water to the dog. Allah appreciated his deed and forgave him." They asked: "O Messenger of Allah, is there reward for us in serving animals?" He replied: "In every living being (possessing a moist liver) there is reward.
benefits_en: Universal compassion toward all animal creation is a sanctified path to divine pardon and immense eternal reward.

topic_en: Smiling in the Face of Your Brother is Charity
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«تَبَسُّمُكَ فِي وَجْهِ أَخِيكَ لَكَ صَدَقَةٌ، وَأَمْرُكَ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَنَهْيُكَ عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ لَكَ صَدَقَةٌ، وَإِرْشَادُكَ الرَّجُلَ فِي أَرْضِ الضَّلَالِ لَكَ صَدَقَةٌ، وَبَصَرُكَ لِلرَّجُلِ الرَّدِيءِ الْبَصَرِ لَكَ صَدَقَةٌ، وَإِمَاطَتُكَ الْحَجَرَ وَالشَّوْكَةَ وَالْعَظْمَ عَنِ الطَّرِيقِ لَكَ صَدَقَةٌ، وَإِفْرَاغُكَ مِنْ دَلْوِكَ فِي دَلْوِ أَخِيكَ لَكَ صَدَقَةٌ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Dharr al-Ghifari (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Your smiling in the face of your brother is charity for you; your enjoining good and forbidding evil is charity; your guiding a lost man in an unknown land is charity; your aiding a visually impaired person is charity; your removing stones, thorns, and bones from the path is charity; and your pouring from your bucket into the bucket of your brother is charity for you.
benefits_en: Charity in Islam extends far beyond financial wealth to include cheerful demeanor, guiding others, environmental care, and practical everyday assistance.

topic_ar: إِنَّ الرِّفْقَ لَا يَكُونُ فِي شَيْءٍ إِلَّا زَانَهُ
topic_en: Kindness and Softness Adorn Every Action
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: **«إِنَّ الرِّفْقَ لَا يَكُونُ فِي شَيْءٍ إِلَّا زَانَهُ، وَلَا يُنْزَعُ مِنْ شَيْءٍ إِلَّا شَانَهُ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'A'ishah (رضي الله عنها).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Indeed, gentleness/kindness (Ar-Rifq) is never found in anything except that it beautifies it, and it is never removed from anything except that it mars it.
benefits_en: Gentle conduct, diplomacy, and tenderness elevate speech, leadership, family life, and social relations.

topic_ar: يُعْطِي عَلَى الرِّفْقِ مَا لَا يُعْطِي عَلَى الْعُنْفِ
topic_en: Allah Grants to Gentleness What He Never Grants to Harshness
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ: **«يَا عَائِشَةُ، إِنَّ اللَّهَ رَفِيقٌ يُحِبُّ الرِّفْقَ، وَيُعْطِي عَلَى الرِّفْقِ مَا لَا يُعْطِي عَلَى الْعُنْفِ، وَمَا لَا يُعْطِي عَلَى مَا سِوَاهُ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'A'ishah (رضي الله عنها).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "O 'A'ishah, indeed Allah is Gentle and loves gentleness; and He grants to gentleness what He never grants to harshness, and what He does not grant to anything else.
benefits_en: Softness, patience, and empathetic persuasion achieve transformative results that brute force and harshness can never accomplish.

topic_en: Guarding Secrets in Intimate Conversations
arabic_matn: عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«إِذَا حَدَّثَ الرَّجُلُ بِالْحَدِيثِ ثُمَّ الْتَفَتَ فَهِيَ أَمَانَةٌ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Jabir ibn 'Abdullah (رضي الله عنهما).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When a person speaks a word and then looks around (wishing to keep it private), it is a sacred trust (Amanah).
benefits_en: Respecting private conversations as confidential trusts builds social trust and prevents scandalous leaks.

topic_ar: إِذَا كُنْتُمْ ثَلَاثَةً فَلَا يَتَنَاجَى اثْنَانِ دُونَ الْآخَرِ
topic_en: Prohibition of Two Whispering to the Exclusion of a Third
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ: **«إِذَا كُنْتُمْ ثَلَاثَةً، فَلَا يَتَنَاجَى رَجُلَانِ دُونَ الْآخَرِ حَتَّى تَخْتَلِطُوا بِالنَّاسِ؛ مِنْ أَجْلِ أَنْ يُحْزِنَهُ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn Mas'ud (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "When there are three of you, two persons must not converse secretly to the exclusion of the third until you mingle with more people, for that will grieve him.
benefits_en: Exquisite emotional consideration in social etiquette: never make a third companion feel isolated, suspicious, or hurt.

topic_en: Helping the Worker or Doing the Craft for the Inept
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ: أَيُّ الْعَمَلِ أَفْضَلُ؟ قَالَ: **«إِيمَانٌ بِاللَّهِ، وَجِهَادٌ فِي سَبِيلِهِ»**، قُلْتُ: فَإِنْ لَمْ أَفْعَلْ؟ قَالَ: **«تُعِينُ صَانِعًا، أَوْ تَصْنَعُ لِأَخْرَقَ»**، قُلْتُ: أَرَأَيْتَ إِنْ ضَعُفْتُ؟ قَالَ: **«تَكُفُّ شَرَّكَ عَنِ النَّاسِ؛ فَإِنَّهَا صَدَقَةٌ مِنْكَ عَلَى نَفْسِكَ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Dharr al-Ghifari (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: Abu Dharr asked: "O Prophet of Allah, what if I cannot do heroic deeds?" The Prophet ﷺ replied: "You assist a craftsman in his work, or you perform a task for someone who is clumsy/inept." I asked: "What if I am too weak even for that?" He said: "Withhold your harm from people; for that is a charity you give to yourself.
benefits_en: At the very minimum, restraining oneself from harming or offending others is considered an accepted act of charity.

topic_ar: إِطْعَامُ الْخَادِمِ مِمَّا يَأْكُلُ وَإِلْبَاسُهُ مِمَّا يَلْبَسُ
topic_en: Kindness to the Servant and Domestic Worker
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«إِخْوَانُكُمْ خَوَلُكُمْ، جَعَلَهُمُ اللَّهُ تَحْتَ أَيْدِيكُمْ، فَمَنْ كَانَ أَخُوهُ تَحْتَ يَدِهِ، فَلْيُطْعِمْهُ مِمَّا يَأْكُلُ، وَلْيُلْبِسْهُ مِمَّا يَلْبَسُ، وَلَا تُكَلِّفُوهُمْ مَا يَغْلِبُهُمْ، فَإِنْ كَلَّفْتُمُوهُمْ فَأَعِينُوهُمْ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Dharr al-Ghifari (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Your servants and employees are your brothers whom Allah has placed under your authority. Whomever has his brother under his hand, let him feed him from what he himself eats, clothe him with what he himself wears, and do not burden them with work beyond their strength; and if you do burden them, then assist them.
benefits_en: Revolutionary humanitarian standards: treating domestic workers and employees as respected brothers with shared meals, dignified clothing, and fair workloads.

topic_ar: الْعَفْوُ عَنِ الْخَادِمِ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ سَبْعِينَ مَرَّةً
topic_en: Forgiving the Servant Seventy Times a Day
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا قَالَ: جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَقَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، كَمْ نَعْفُو عَنِ الْخَادِمِ؟ فَصَمَتَ، ثُمَّ أَعَادَ عَلَيْهِ الْكَلَامَ فَصَمَتَ، فَلَمَّا كَانَ فِي الثَّالِثَةِ قَالَ: **«اعْفُ عَنْهُ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ سَبْعِينَ مَرَّةً»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn 'Umar (رضي الله عنهما).
english_translation: A man came to the Prophet ﷺ and asked: "O Messenger of Allah, how many times should we forgive a servant?" The Prophet ﷺ remained silent. The man asked again, and he remained silent. On the third time, he said: "Pardon him seventy times every single day!
benefits_en: Exercising limitless patience, forbearance, and forgiveness toward subordinates and employees.

topic_en: Intercession for Goodness and Mediation of Disputes
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى الْأَشْعَرِيِّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِذَا جَاءَهُ السَّائِلُ أَوْ طُلِبَتْ إِلَيْهِ حَاجَةٌ قَالَ: **«اشْفَعُوا تُؤْجَرُوا، وَيَقْضِي اللَّهُ عَلَى لِسَانِ نَبِيِّهِ ﷺ مَا شَاءَ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Musa al-Ash'ari (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: When a petitioner or someone with a need came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, he would turn to his companions and say: "Intercede (for him) and you will be rewarded, and Allah will decree through the tongue of His Prophet what He wills.
benefits_en: Using one's influence and status to advocate for the needy and facilitate good causes is an independently rewarded virtue.

topic_en: Concealing the Faults of a Muslim in This World
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: **«لَا يَسْتُرُ عَبْدٌ عَبْدًا فِي الدُّنْيَا، إِلَّا سَتَرَهُ اللَّهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "No servant conceals the private faults of another servant in this world, except that Allah will conceal his faults on the Day of Resurrection.
benefits_en: Shielding others from public scandal guarantees divine concealment of one's own secret shortcomings on Judgment Day.

topic_en: Relieving Worldly Distresses of Believers
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«مَنْ نَفَّسَ عَنْ مُؤْمِنٍ كُرْبَةً مِنْ كُرَبِ الدُّنْيَا، نَفَّسَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ كُرْبَةً مِنْ كُرَبِ يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ، وَمَنْ يَسَّرَ عَلَى مُعْسِرٍ، يَسَّرَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، وَمَنْ سَتَرَ مُسْلِمًا، سَتَرَهُ اللَّهُ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، وَاللَّهُ فِي عَوْنِ الْعَبْدِ مَا كَانَ الْعَبْدُ فِي عَوْنِ أَخِيهِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever relieves a believer of one of the distresses of this world, Allah will relieve him of one of the distresses of the Day of Resurrection. Whoever eases the hardship of a debtor in difficulty, Allah will ease his hardship in this world and the Hereafter. Whoever conceals the faults of a Muslim, Allah will conceal his faults in this world and the Hereafter. And Allah remains in the aid of His servant as long as the servant remains in the aid of his brother.
benefits_en: Immediate divine assistance, worldly relief, and eternal salvation are directly tied to helping vulnerable fellow human beings.

topic_ar: مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ فَلْيُكْرِمْ ضَيْفَهُ
topic_en: Hospitality to the Guest
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي شُرَيْحٍ الْخُزَاعِيِّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ فَلْيُكْرِمْ ضَيْفَهُ جَائِزَتَهُ»**، قَالُوا: وَمَا جَائِزَتُهُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ؟ قَالَ: **«يَوْمُهُ وَلَيْلَتُهُ، وَالضِّيَافَةُ ثَلَاثَةُ أَيَّامٍ، فَمَا كَانَ وَرَاءَ ذَلِكَ فَهُوَ صَدَقَةٌ عَلَيْهِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Shurayh al-Khuza'i (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him honor his guest with his special hospitality (Ja'izatah)." They asked: "What is his special hospitality, O Messenger of Allah?" He replied: "His first day and night; and general hospitality is for three days. Whatever is beyond that is an act of charity upon him.
benefits_en: Generous hospitality to travelers and visitors is a binding hallmark of faith, with special lavishness for 24 hours and basic care for three days.

topic_en: The Superiority of Kindness to Non-Muslim Parents
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا قَالَتْ: قَدِمَتْ عَلَيَّ أُمِّي وَهِيَ مُشْرِكَةٌ فِي عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ، فَاسْتَفْتَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قُلْتُ: إِنَّ أُمِّي قَدِمَتْ وَهِيَ رَاغِبَةٌ، أَفَأَصِلُ أُمِّي؟ قَالَ: **«نَعَمْ، صِلِي أُمَّكِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Asma' bint Abi Bakr (رضي الله عنهما).
english_translation: Asma' bint Abi Bakr reported: My mother came to visit me while she was still a polytheist during the treaty of the Prophet ﷺ. I asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ for guidance: "My mother has arrived desiring my affection/help; shall I maintain ties with my mother?" He replied: "Yes, maintain ties of kindness with your mother.
benefits_en: Differences in religious faith never abolish the sacred moral duty of maintaining compassionate filial kindness to parents.

topic_ar: إِنْظَارُ الْمُعْسِرِ أَوْ وَضْعُ الدَّيْنِ عَنْهُ
topic_en: Relieving the Debtor by Granting Respite or Debt Forgiveness
arabic_matn: عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«أُتِيَ اللَّهُ بِعَبْدٍ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ آتَاهُ اللَّهُ مَالًا، فَقَالَ لَهُ: مَاذَا عَمِلْتَ فِي الدُّنْيَا؟ قَالَ: يَا رَبِّ، آتَيْتَنِي مَالَكَ، فَكُنْتُ أُبَايِعُ النَّاسَ، وَكَانَ مِنْ خُلُقِي الْجَوَازُ، فَكُنْتُ أَتَيَسَّرُ عَلَى الْمُوسِرِ، وَأُنْظِرُ الْمُعْسِرَ، فَقَالَ اللَّهُ: أَنَا أَحَقُّ بِذَلِكَ مِنْكَ؛ تَجَاوَزُوا عَنْ عَبْدِي»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Hudhayfah ibn al-Yaman (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "A man from among Allah's servants was brought before Allah, to whom Allah had given wealth. Allah asked him: 'What did you do in the world?' He said: 'O Lord, You gave me Your wealth, and I used to trade with people. It was my habit to be lenient: I was easy on the well-off and gave extra time to the insolvent debtor.' Allah said: 'I have more right to leniency than you; overlook and forgive the sins of My servant!
benefits_en: Treating financially burdened borrowers with patience and forgiveness secures absolute divine leniency and pardon on Judgment Day.

topic_en: Sincere Mutual Advice (An-Nasihah) is the Essence of Religion
arabic_matn: عَنْ تَمِيمٍ الدَّارِيِّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ: **«الدِّينُ النَّصِيحَةُ»**، قُلْنَا: لِمَنْ؟ قَالَ: **«لِلَّهِ، وَلِكِتَابِهِ، وَلِرَسُولِهِ، وَلِأَئِمَّةِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ وَعَامَّتِهِمْ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Tamim ad-Dari (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "The Religion is sincere goodwill and advice (An-Nasihah)." We asked: "To whom?" He replied: "To Allah, to His Book, to His Messenger, and to the leaders of the Muslims and their common folk.
benefits_en: Genuine faith expresses itself through sincere devotion to Allah, honoring His revelation, loving His Prophet, and actively working for the well-being of the entire community.

topic_en: Spreading the Greeting of Peace to Foster Mutual Love
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«لَا تَدْخُلُونَ الْجَنَّةَ حَتَّى تُؤْمِنُوا، وَلَا تُؤْمِنُوا حَتَّى تَحَابُّوا، أَوَلَا أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَى شَيْءٍ إِذَا فَعَلْتُمُوهُ تَحَابَبْتُمْ؟ أَفْشُوا السَّلَامَ بَيْنَكُمْ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "You will not enter Paradise until you believe, and you will not believe until you love one another. Shall I not guide you to something which, if you do it, you will love one another? Spread the greeting of peace (As-Salam) among yourselves.
benefits_en: Exchanging the Islamic greeting of Salam dismantles social barriers, dispels malice, and builds the mutual love essential for perfected faith.

topic_en: The Order and Precedence in Giving Salam
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«يُسَلِّمُ الرَّاكِبُ عَلَى الْمَاشِي، وَالْمَاشِي عَلَى الْقَاعِدِ، وَالْقَلِيلُ عَلَى الْكَثِيرِ، وَالصَّغِيرُ عَلَى الْكَبِيرِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The rider should greet the walking person, the walking person should greet the seated person, the smaller group should greet the larger group, and the younger should greet the elder.
benefits_en: Islamic social etiquette prescribes a harmonious hierarchy for initiating greetings, teaching humility and respect.

topic_en: Greet Children to Cultivate Affection
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: **«أَنَّهُ مَرَّ عَلَى صِبْيَانٍ فَسَلَّمَ عَلَيْهِمْ، وَقَالَ: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ يَفْعَلُهُ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Anas ibn Malik (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: Anas ibn Malik passed by some young boys and greeted them with Salam, saying: "The Prophet ﷺ used to do that.
benefits_en: Greeting children with Salam demonstrates prophetic humility, instills Islamic identity, and teaches young minds proper etiquette.

topic_en: Sins Falling Away During Handshakes
arabic_matn: عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«مَا مِنْ مُسْلِمَيْنِ يَلْتَقِيَانِ فَيَتَصَافَحَانِ إِلَّا غُفِرَ لَهُمَا قَبْلَ أَنْ يَفْتَرِقَا»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Al-Bara' ibn 'Azib (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "There are no two Muslims who meet and shake hands except that their sins are forgiven before they part.
benefits_en: Physical handshakes coupled with warm smiles purify interpersonal relations and expiate minor sins between believers.

topic_en: Seeking Permission to Enter (Isti'dhan) Three Times
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى الْأَشْعَرِيِّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«الِاسْتِئْذَانُ ثَلَاثٌ؛ فَإِنْ أُذِنَ لَكَ وَإِلَّا فَارْجِعْ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Musa al-Ash'ari (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Seeking permission to enter is to be done three times; if permission is granted to you, enter; otherwise, depart.
benefits_en: Respecting the privacy of households: knock or ring three times calmly, and leave gracefully without taking offense if no answer is given.

topic_ar: إِنَّمَا جُعِلَ الِاسْتِئْذَانُ مِنْ أَجْلِ الْبَصَرِ
topic_en: Seeking Permission Protects Privacy of the Eyes
arabic_matn: عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«إِنَّمَا جُعِلَ الِاسْتِئْذَانُ مِنْ أَجْلِ الْبَصَرِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Sahl ibn Sa'd (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Seeking permission to enter was instituted solely on account of protecting the sight (from seeing private household affairs).
benefits_en: Stand to the side of doors when knocking rather than directly facing the opening to avoid catching sight of people in informal attire.

topic_en: Stating One's Clear Name When Knocking
arabic_matn: عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا قَالَ: أَتَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ فِي دَيْنٍ كَانَ عَلَى أَبِي، فَدَقَقْتُ الْبَابَ، فَقَالَ: **«مَنْ ذَا؟»** فَقُلْتُ: أَنَا، فَقَالَ: **«أَنَا، أَنَا!»** كَأَنَّهُ كَرِهَهَا.
narrator_en: Narrated by Jabir ibn 'Abdullah (رضي الله عنهما).
english_translation: Jabir reported: I came to the Prophet ﷺ regarding a debt my father owed. I knocked on the door, and he asked: "Who is that?" I said: "It is I." He repeated: "'It is I, it is I!' as if he disliked that response.
benefits_en: When asked "Who is it?", one should state their clear identifying name (e.g. "It is Ahmad") rather than ambiguous words like "Me".

topic_ar: نَهْيُ الرَّجُلِ أَنْ يُقِيمَ أَخَاهُ مِنْ مَجْلِسِهِ
topic_en: Prohibition of Forcing Someone from Their Seat
arabic_matn: عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ: **«أَنَّهُ نَهَى أَنْ يُقِيمَ الرَّجُلُ أَخَاهُ مِنْ مَقْعَدِهِ ثُمَّ يَجْلِسَ فِيهِ، وَلَكِنْ تَفَسَّحُوا وَتَوَسَّعُوا»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn 'Umar (رضي الله عنهما).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ forbade that a man should make his brother stand up from his seat and then sit in it himself; rather, you should make space and accommodate one another.
benefits_en: Islamic assemblies respect equal dignity; none should be displaced for high status, but people should adjust to welcome newcomers.

topic_ar: إِذَا قَامَ أَحَدُكُمْ مِنْ مَجْلِسِهِ ثُمَّ رَجَعَ فَهُوَ أَحَقُّ بِهِ
topic_en: Returning to One's Seat After a Brief Departure
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ: **«إِذَا قَامَ أَحَدُكُمْ مِنْ مَجْلِسِهِ ثُمَّ رَجَعَ إِلَيْهِ فَهُوَ أَحَقُّ بِهِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "If one of you stands up from his seat and then returns to it, he has the greatest right to it.
benefits_en: A person retains ownership of their seat when temporarily stepping away for water, Wudu, or an urgent errand.

topic_ar: آدَابُ الطَّعَامِ: سَمِّ اللَّهَ وَكُلْ بِيَمِينِكَ
topic_en: Fundamental Etiquette of Eating
arabic_matn: عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا قَالَ: كُنْتُ غُلَامًا فِي حَجْرِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ، وَكَانَتْ يَدِي تَطِيشُ فِي الصَّحْفَةِ، فَقَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«يَا غُلَامُ، سَمِّ اللَّهَ، وَكُلْ بِيَمِينِكَ، وَكُلْ مِمَّا يَلِيكَ»**، فَمَا زَالَتْ تِلْكَ طِعْمَتِي بَعْدُ.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Umar ibn Abi Salamah (رضي الله عنهما).
english_translation: Umar ibn Abi Salamah reported: I was a young boy in the care of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and my hand used to wander around the dish. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to me: "O young boy, say Bismillah (In the Name of Allah), eat with your right hand, and eat from what is directly in front of you." That continued to be my manner of eating ever since.
benefits_en: The three golden rules of dining etiquette: invoking Allah's Name, using the right hand exclusively, and taking food from the area nearest to oneself.

topic_en: Strict Prohibition of Eating and Drinking with the Left Hand
arabic_matn: عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ: **«لَا يَأْكُلَنَّ أَحَدُكُمْ بِشِمَالِهِ، وَلَا يَشْرَبَنَّ بِهَا؛ فَإِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ يَأْكُلُ بِشِمَالِهِ، وَيَشْرَبُ بِهَا»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn 'Umar (رضي الله عنهما).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "None of you should eat with his left hand nor drink with it; for indeed, Satan eats with his left hand and drinks with it.
benefits_en: The right hand is reserved for noble activities (eating, drinking, giving gifts), while the left is used for cleaning impurities.

topic_en: Cleaning the Fallen Morsel of Food
arabic_matn: عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«إِذَا سَقَطَتْ لُقْمَةُ أَحَدِكُمْ فَلْيَأْخُذْهَا، فَلْيُمِطْ مَا كَانَ بِهَا مِنْ أَذًى وَلْيَأْكُلْهَا، وَلَا يَدَعْهَا لِلشَّيْطَانِ، وَلَا يَمْسَحْ يَدَهُ بِالْمِنْدِيلِ حَتَّى يَلْعَقَ أَصَابِعَهُ؛ فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَدْرِي فِي أَيِّ طَعَامِهِ الْبَرَكَةُ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Jabir ibn 'Abdullah (رضي الله عنهما).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When a morsel falls from one of you, let him pick it up, remove any dirt from it, and eat it, and not leave it for Satan. And let him not wipe his hand with a napkin until he licks his fingers; for he does not know in which portion of his food the barakah (blessing) lies.
benefits_en: Respecting food, avoiding food waste out of arrogance, and seeking the divine barakah hidden within every provision.

topic_ar: مَا عَابَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ طَعَامًا قَطُّ
topic_en: Never Criticizing Food
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: **«مَا عَابَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ طَعَامًا قَطُّ؛ كَانَ إِذَا اشْتَهَاهُ أَكَلَهُ، وَإِنْ كَرِهَهُ تَرَكَهُ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: Abu Hurairah reported: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ never criticized any food whatsoever. If he desired it, he ate it; and if he disliked it, he simply left it.
benefits_en: Never belittle food prepared by others; eat with gratitude or politely refrain without humiliating the cook.

topic_en: Drinking Water in Three Pauses Outside the Cup
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: **«أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَانَ يَتَنَفَّسُ فِي الشَّرَابِ ثَلَاثًا، وَيَقُولُ: إِنَّهُ أَرْوَى وَأَبْرَأُ وَأَمْرَأُ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Anas ibn Malik (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: Anas ibn Malik reported that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to breathe three times (outside the vessel) while drinking, and he said: "Indeed, it is more thirst-quenching, healthier, and more wholesome.
benefits_en: Drinking water in measured, calm sips with pauses away from the cup promotes optimal hydration and prevents respiratory choking.

topic_ar: النَّهْيُ عَنِ التَّنَفُّسِ فِي الْإِنَاءِ أَوِ النَّفْخِ فِيهِ
topic_en: Prohibition of Breathing or Blowing Directly into the Vessel
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: **«إِذَا شَرِبَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلَا يَتَنَفَّسْ فِي الْإِنَاءِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Qatadah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "When one of you drinks, let him not breathe into the drinking vessel.
benefits_en: High hygienic standard avoiding contamination of drinks with oral microbes or odors.

topic_en: The Server of People is the Last to Drink
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: **«إِنَّ سَاقِيَ الْقَوْمِ آخِرُهُمْ شُرْبًا»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Qatadah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Indeed, the one who serves drinks to the people should be the last of them to drink.
benefits_en: True leadership is servant leadership; a host ensures all guests are fully satisfied before attending to his own thirst.

topic_en: Serving Drinks Starting from the Right-Hand Side
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ أُتِيَ بِلَبَنٍ قَدْ شِيبَ بِمَاءٍ، وَعَنْ يَمِينِهِ أَعْرَابِيٌّ، وَعَنْ يَسَارِهِ أَبُو بَكْرٍ، فَشَرِبَ ثُمَّ أَعْطَى الْأَعْرَابِيَّ وَقَالَ: **«الْأَيْمَنَ فَالْأَيْمَنَ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Anas ibn Malik (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was brought milk mixed with water. On his right was a bedouin, and on his left was Abu Bakr. The Prophet ﷺ drank and then passed it to the bedouin on his right, saying: "The right first, then the right.
benefits_en: Circular distribution of food, drinks, and gifts should always progress counter-clockwise starting from the person on the host's right.

topic_en: Etiquette of Putting on Shoes: Right Foot First
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ: **«إِذَا انْتَعَلَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيَبْدَأْ بِالْيَمِينِ، وَإِذَا نَزَعَ فَلْيَبْدَأْ بِالشِّمَالِ، لِيَكُنِ الْيُمْنَى أَوَّلَهُمَا تُنْعَلُ، وَآخِرَهُمَا تُنْزَعُ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When one of you puts on his sandals/shoes, let him begin with the right foot; and when he takes them off, let him begin with the left foot. Let the right foot be the first to be shoed and the last to be unshoed.
benefits_en: Honoring the right side in adornment and the left side when divesting fosters mindfulness in minor daily routines.

topic_ar: النَّهْيُ عَنِ الْمَشْيِ فِي نَعْلٍ وَاحِدَةٍ
topic_en: Prohibition of Walking in a Single Shoe
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ: **«لَا يَمْشِ أَحَدُكُمْ فِي نَعْلٍ وَاحِدَةٍ؛ لِيُنْعِلْهُمَا جَمِيعًا، أَوْ لِيَخْلَعْهُمَا جَمِيعًا»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "None of you should walk wearing a single shoe; let him wear both of them together or take off both of them together.
benefits_en: Maintaining balanced posture, preventing awkward gait, and avoiding comical or deformed appearances.

topic_ar: تَحْرِيمُ الذَّهَبِ وَالْحَرِيرِ عَلَى ذُكُورِ الْأُمَّةِ
topic_en: Prohibition of Men Wearing Gold and Pure Silk
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ أَخَذَ حَرِيرًا فَجَعَلَهُ فِي يَمِينِهِ، وَأَخَذَ ذَهَبًا فَجَعَلَهُ فِي شِمَالِهِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: **«إِنَّ هَذَيْنِ حَرَامٌ عَلَى ذُكُورِ أُمَّتِي، حِلٌّ لِإِنَاثِهِمْ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Ali ibn Abi Talib (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ took silk in his right hand and gold in his left hand, and said: "Indeed, these two are forbidden for the males of my Ummah, and lawful for their females.
benefits_en: Preserving masculine fortitude and avoiding effeminate luxury for Muslim men, while permitting adornment for women.

topic_en: Prohibition of Cross-Gender Imitation
arabic_matn: عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا قَالَ: **«لَعَنَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ الْمُتَشَبِّهِينَ مِنَ الرِّجَالِ بِالنِّسَاءِ، وَالْمُتَشَبِّهَاتِ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ بِالرِّجَالِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn 'Abbas (رضي الله عنهما).
english_translation: Ibn 'Abbas reported: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ cursed men who imitate women, and women who imitate men (in dress, behavior, and distinct gender roles).
benefits_en: Preserving the distinct natural biological and social identities ordained by Allah for men and women.

topic_en: The Five Natural Fitrah Hygiene Practices
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: **«الْفِطْرَةُ خَمْسٌ: الْخِتَانُ، وَالِاسْتِحْدَادُ، وَقَصُّ الشَّارِبِ، وَتَقْلِيمُ الْأَظْفَارِ، وَنَتْفُ الْآبَاطِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "The innate hygiene practices (Sunan al-Fitrah) are five: circumcision, shaving pubic hair, trimming the mustache, clipping the nails, and plucking the armpit hair.
benefits_en: Islam commands meticulous bodily grooming and cleanliness to preserve human dignity and prevent bacterial build-up.

topic_ar: التَّوْقِيتُ فِي قَصِّ الشَّارِبِ وَتَقْلِيمِ الْأَظْفَارِ
topic_en: Time Limit for Fitrah Grooming
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: **«وُقِّتَ لَنَا فِي قَصِّ الشَّارِبِ، وَتَقْلِيمِ الْأَظْفَارِ، وَنَتْفِ الْإِبِطِ، وَحَلْقِ الْعَانَةِ: أَنْ لَا نَتْرُكَ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ أَرْبَعِينَ لَيْلَةً»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Anas ibn Malik (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: Anas ibn Malik reported: "A time limit was set for us concerning trimming the mustache, clipping the nails, plucking armpit hair, and shaving pubic hair: that we should not leave them for more than forty nights.
benefits_en: Personal hygiene grooming must be maintained regularly, never exceeding a maximum interval of forty days.

topic_en: The Miswak: Purification for the Mouth and Pleasure for the Lord
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: **«السِّوَاكُ مَطْهَرَةٌ لِلْفَمِ، مَرْضَاةٌ لِلرَّبِّ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'A'ishah (رضي الله عنها).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "The tooth-stick (Siwak) is a purification for the mouth and a means of attaining the pleasure of the Lord.
benefits_en: Oral hygiene is elevated to an act of divine worship bringing physical cleanliness and divine pleasure.

topic_en: Etiquette of Sneezing: Covering the Mouth and Lowering the Voice
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: **«أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ كَانَ إِذَا عَطَسَ وَضَعَ يَدَهُ أَوْ ثَوْبَهُ عَلَى فِيهِ، وَغَضَّ بِهَا صَوْتَهُ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: Abu Hurairah narrated: "When the Prophet ﷺ sneezed, he would cover his mouth with his hand or garment, and muffle his voice with it.
benefits_en: Covering the mouth and suppressing noise when sneezing prevents airborne droplet infection and maintains refined manners.

topic_en: Etiquette of Yawning: Suppressing and Covering
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: **«التَّثَاؤُبُ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ، فَإِذَا تَثَاءَبَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيَرُدَّهُ مَا اسْتَطَاعَ؛ فَإِنَّ أَحَدَكُمْ إِذَا قَالَ: هَا، ضَحِكَ الشَّيْطَانُ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Yawning is from Satan. When one of you yawns, let him suppress it as much as he can; for if one of you says 'Haaa' (making noise), Satan laughs at him.
benefits_en: Suppressing yawns and covering the mouth with the back of the hand preserves dignity and wards off demonic ridicule.

topic_en: Sleeping Upon the Right Side
arabic_matn: عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«إِذَا أَتَيْتَ مَضْجَعَكَ فَتَوَضَّأْ وُضُوءَكَ لِلصَّلَاةِ، ثُمَّ اضْطَجِعْ عَلَى شِقِّكَ الْأَيْمَنِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Al-Bara' ibn 'Azib (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to me: "When you go to bed, perform ablution as you do for prayer, then lie down on your right side.
benefits_en: Retiring to bed in a state of ritual purity and resting on the right side facilitates peaceful, healthy sleep and continuous dhikr.

topic_en: Extinguishing Fires and Securing Utensils at Night
arabic_matn: عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«أَطْفِئُوا الْمَصَابِيحَ إِذَا رَقَدْتُمْ، وَغَلِّقُوا الْأَبْوَابَ، وَأَوْكُوا الْأَسْقِيَةَ، وَخَمِّرُوا الطَّعَامَ وَالشَّرَابَ - وَلَوْ أَنْ تَعْرُضُوا عَلَيْهِ عُودًا -»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Jabir ibn 'Abdullah (رضي الله عنهما).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Extinguish your lamps/open flames when you go to sleep, lock your doors, tie your waterskins, and cover your food and drink—even if you merely place a stick across the vessel.
benefits_en: Essential safety guidelines preventing domestic fires, contamination by insects or rodents, and demonic intrusion.

topic_en: Bringing Children Indoors at Sunset
arabic_matn: عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«إِذَا كَانَ جُنْحُ اللَّيْلِ - أَوْ أَمْسَيْتُمْ - فَكُفُّوا صِبْيَانَكُمْ؛ فَإِنَّ الشَّيَاطِينَ تَنْتَشِرُ حِينَئِذٍ، فَإِذَا ذَهَبَ سَاعَةٌ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَخَلُّوهُمْ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Jabir ibn 'Abdullah (رضي الله عنهما).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When the dusk of night falls—or when evening approaches—keep your children indoors, for the devils spread out at that time. When an hour of the night has passed, you may let them go.
benefits_en: Keeping young children safe inside homes during the initial transition of twilight when spiritual agitation and devils roam freely.

topic_ar: أَحَبُّ الْأَسْمَاءِ إِلَى اللَّهِ: عَبْدُ اللَّهِ وَعَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ
topic_en: The Most Beloved Names to Allah
arabic_matn: عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«إِنَّ أَحَبَّ أَسْمَائِكُمْ إِلَى اللَّهِ: عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، وَعَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn 'Umar (رضي الله عنهما).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Indeed, the most beloved of your names to Allah are 'Abdullah (Servant of Allah) and 'Abdur-Rahman (Servant of the Most Merciful).
benefits_en: Choosing names expressing humble servitude to Allah and celebrating His sublime divine attributes of mercy and lordship.

topic_ar: تَغْيِيرُ الِاسْمِ الْقَبِيحِ إِلَى اسْمٍ حَسَنٍ
topic_en: Changing Bad Names to Good Ones
arabic_matn: عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا: **«أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ غَيَّرَ اسْمَ عَاصِيَةَ، وَقَالَ: أَنْتِ جَمِيلَةُ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn 'Umar (رضي الله عنهما).
english_translation: Ibn 'Umar reported that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ changed the name of a woman named 'Asiyah (meaning Disobedient) and said: "You are Jamilah (meaning Beautiful).
benefits_en: Transforming names associated with sin, pessimism, or ugly meanings into positive, uplifting identities.

topic_ar: أَخْنَعُ اسْمٍ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ: مَلِكُ الْأَمْلَاكِ
topic_en: Prohibition of Titles of Absolute Sovereignty (King of Kings)
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: **«إِنَّ أَخْنَعَ اسْمٍ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ رَجُلٌ تَسَمَّى مَلِكَ الْأَمْلَاكِ، لَا مَالِكَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Indeed, the most vile and despised name in the sight of Allah is a man who calls himself 'King of kings' (Malik al-Amlak / Shahanshah); for there is no true Sovereign except Allah.
benefits_en: Titles claiming ultimate supreme kingship or divine infallibility are strictly forbidden, as sovereign dominion belongs exclusively to Allah.

topic_ar: مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ فَلْيَقُلْ خَيْرًا أَوْ لِيَصْمُتْ
topic_en: Speaking Good or Remaining Silent
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ فَلْيَقُلْ خَيْرًا أَوْ لِيَصْمُتْ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him speak good or remain silent.
benefits_en: Guarding the tongue is the fortress of faith; speech should either convey beneficial truth or be preserved in dignified silence.

topic_en: Listening Attentively When Addressed
arabic_matn: عَنْ جَرِيرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: **«أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ لَهُ فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ: اسْتَنْصِتِ النَّاسَ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Jarir ibn 'Abdullah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: During the Farewell Pilgrimage, the Prophet ﷺ said to Jarir ibn 'Abdullah: "Ask the people to listen attentively in silence.
benefits_en: Active, quiet listening during educational lectures and sermons demonstrates respect and facilitates complete comprehension.

topic_en: Exchanging Gifts to Promote Love and Harmony
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: **«تَهَادُوا تَحَابُّوا»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Exchange gifts with one another; you will foster love for one another.
benefits_en: Giving tokens of appreciation—no matter how modest—removes grudges from hearts and cements deep communal affection.

topic_en: Walking with Humility and Avoiding Arrogance
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ: **«بَيْنَمَا رَجُلٌ يَمْشِي فِي حُلَّةٍ تُعْجِبُهُ نَفْسُهُ، مُرَجِّلٌ رَأْسَهُ، يَخْتَالُ فِي مِشْيَتِهِ، إِذْ خَسَفَ اللَّهُ بِهِ، فَهُوَ يَتَجَلْجَلُ فِي الْأَرْضِ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "While a man was strutting in a fine cloak, admiring himself, with his hair combed, swaggering arrogantly in his gait, Allah caused the earth to swallow him, and he continues sinking into it until the Day of Resurrection.
benefits_en: Arrogant vanity in posture and clothing invites swift divine retribution; believers are commanded to walk with gentle dignity (25:63).

topic_en: Etiquette of Sitting: Avoiding Disruption of Circles
arabic_matn: عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ بْنِ الْيَمَانِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: **«أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ لَعَنَ مَنْ جَلَسَ وَسَطَ الْحَلْقَةِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Hudhayfah ibn al-Yaman (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: Hudhayfah reported that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ cursed the one who sits in the middle of a seated study circle (blocking others' view and disrupting the assembly).
benefits_en: Latecomers should sit politely at the perimeter of gatherings without stepping over necks or occupying the center of the circle.

topic_en: Etiquette of Hospitality: Presenting Food Generously
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: **«مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ فَلَا يُؤْذِ جَارَهُ، وَمَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ فَلْيُكْرِمْ ضَيْفَهُ، وَمَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ فَلْيَقُلْ خَيْرًا أَوْ لِيَصْمُتْ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day must not harm his neighbor; whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day must honor his guest; and whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day must speak good or remain silent.
benefits_en: The triad of social excellence: absolute safety for neighbors, warm generosity to guests, and disciplined speech.

topic_en: Using Kunyas (Honorific Technonyms) in Address
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ أَحْسَنَ النَّاسِ خُلُقًا، وَكَانَ لِي أَخٌ يُقَالُ لَهُ أَبُو عُمَيْرٍ... فَكَانَ إِذَا جَاءَ قَالَ: **«يَا أَبَا عُمَيْرٍ، مَا فَعَلَ النُّغَيْرُ؟»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Anas ibn Malik (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: Anas ibn Malik reported: The Prophet ﷺ had the most sublime character. I had a young brother who was nicknamed Abu 'Umayr... Whenever the Prophet ﷺ visited us, he would joke gently with him, saying: "O Abu 'Umayr, what happened to the little bird (Nughayr)?
benefits_en: Beautiful Prophetic warmth: addressing children with respectful Kunyas, joking gently, and showing concern for their small joys.

topic_en: The Superiority of Modesty (Al-Haya')
arabic_matn: عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ حُصَيْنٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ: **«الْحَيَاءُ لَا يَأْتِي إِلَّا بِخَيْرٍ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Imran ibn Husayn (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Modesty/shyness (Al-Haya') brings nothing but pure goodness.
benefits_en: True modesty is the crown of Islamic character, shielding the soul from vulgarity and restraining it from shameful actions.

topic_en: Modesty is a Branch of Faith
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: **«الْإِيمَانُ بِضْعٌ وَسَبْعُونَ - أَوْ بِضْعٌ وَسِتُّونَ - شُعْبَةً؛ فَأَفْضَلُهَا قَوْلُ: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَأَدْنَاهَا إِمَاطَةُ الْأَذَى عَنِ الطَّرِيقِ، وَالْحَيَاءُ شُعْبَةٌ مِنَ الْإِيمَانِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Faith (Iman) has seventy-odd—or sixty-odd—branches: the highest is saying 'La ilaha illallah', the lowest is removing a harmful object from the road, and modesty (Al-Haya') is a vital branch of faith.
benefits_en: Faith spans intellectual conviction (Tawhid), civil social responsibility (road clearance), and moral sensitivity (modesty).

topic_en: Etiquette of Consultation and Mutual Deliberation
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«الْمُسْتَشَارُ مُؤْتَمَنٌ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The person who is consulted for advice is entrusted with a sacred trust.
benefits_en: When someone seeks your advice, it is a binding moral obligation to provide honest, beneficial counsel without ulterior motives or betrayal.

topic_en: Avoiding Excessive Argumentation and Debating
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«أَنَا زَعِيمٌ بِبَيْتٍ فِي رَبَضِ الْجَنَّةِ لِمَنْ تَرَكَ الْمِرَاءَ وَإِنْ كَانَ مُحِقًّا، وَبِبَيْتٍ فِي وَسَطِ الْجَنَّةِ لِمَنْ تَرَكَ الْكَذِبَ وَإِنْ كَانَ مَازِحًا، وَبِبَيْتٍ فِي أَعْلَى الْجَنَّةِ لِمَنْ حَسَّنَ خُلُقَهُ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Umamah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "I guarantee a palace in the outskirts of Paradise for one who abandons argumentation even if he is in the right, a palace in the middle of Paradise for one who abandons lying even in jest, and a palace in the highest rank of Paradise for one who perfects his moral character.
benefits_en: Restraining the ego from contentious debates, preserving honesty even in humor, and beautifying character earns prime dwellings in Paradise.

topic_en: Etiquette of Walking with Friends
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: **«أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ كَانَ إِذَا مَشَى مَعَ أَصْحَابِهِ جَعَلَهُمْ أَمَامَهُ، وَقَالَ: خَلُّوا ظَهْرِي لِلْمَلَائِكَةِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: Abu Hurairah narrated that when the Prophet ﷺ walked with his companions, he would have them walk in front of him, saying: "Leave my back for the angels.
benefits_en: The Prophet's extreme humility: avoiding the pomp of having followers trail behind him like emperors.

topic_en: Maintaining Cleanliness of Public Shaded Areas
arabic_matn: عَنْ مُعَاذِ بْنِ جَبَلٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«اتَّقُوا الْمَلَاعِنَ الثَّلَاثَةَ: الْبَرَازَ فِي الْمَوَارِدِ، وَقَارِعَةِ الطَّرِيقِ، وَالظِّلِّ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Mu'adh ibn Jabal (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Beware of the three acts that attract curses: defecating in water sources, on walkways, and in shaded rest areas.
benefits_en: Environmental public health: preserving water reservoirs, pathways, and parks from sanitary pollution and health hazards.

topic_en: Forbidding Sitting in Open Thoroughfares Without Fulfilling Its Rights
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: **«إِيَّاكُمْ وَالْجُلُوسَ عَلَى الطُّرُقَاتِ»**، فَقَالُوا: مَا لَنَا بُدٌّ، إِنَّمَا هِيَ مَجَالِسُنَا نَتَحَدَّثُ فِيهَا، قَالَ: **«فَإِذَا أَبَيْتُمْ إِلَّا الْمَجَالِسَ فَأَعْطُوا الطَّرِيقَ حَقَّهُ»**، قَالُوا: وَمَا حَقُّ الطَّرِيقِ؟ قَالَ: **«غَضُّ الْبَصَرِ، وَكَفُّ الْأَذَى، وَرَدُّ السَّلَامِ، وَأَمْرٌ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ، وَنَهْيٌ عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Beware of sitting in the thoroughfares/streets." They said: "We have no alternative; they are our gathering places where we converse." He said: "If you insist on gathering there, then give the street its due right." They asked: "What is the right of the street?" He replied: "Lowering the gaze, restraining harm, returning the greeting of peace, enjoining good, and forbidding evil.
benefits_en: Public thoroughfares must be safe, comfortable zones where women and passersby are protected from staring, loitering, and intimidation.

topic_en: Etiquette of Giving Counsel and Reproach Privately
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«الْمُؤْمِنُ مِرْآةُ أَخِيهِ، إِذَا رَأَى فِيهَا عَيْبًا أَصْلَحَهُ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The believer is the mirror of his brother: when he sees a flaw in him, he gently helps him correct it.
benefits_en: A true friend reflects shortcomings privately and honestly without distortion, scandal, or public humiliation.

topic_en: Gentleness in Addressing People
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا: أَنَّ يَهُودَ أَتَوُا النَّبِيَّ ﷺ فَقَالُوا: السَّامُ عَلَيْكُمْ، فَقَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ: عَلَيْكُمُ السَّامُ وَاللَّعْنَةُ! فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«مَهْلًا يَا عَائِشَةُ، إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الرِّفْقَ فِي الْأَمْرِ كُلِّهِ»**، قَالَتْ: أَلَمْ تَسْمَعْ مَا قَالُوا؟ قَالَ: **«قَدْ قُلْتُ: وَعَلَيْكُمْ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'A'ishah (رضي الله عنها).
english_translation: Some Jews came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: "As-Samu 'alaykum" (Death be upon you). 'A'ishah angrily responded: "Upon you be death and curse!" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Gently, O 'A'ishah! Indeed, Allah loves gentleness in all matters." She said: "Did you not hear what they said?" He replied: "I have already replied: 'And upon you.
benefits_en: Maintaining composure and refined speech even in the face of deliberate provocation and insult.

topic_en: Preserving Modesty and Dignity in Attire
arabic_matn: عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا قَالَ: أَتَانَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَرَأَى رَجُلًا شَعِثًا قَدْ تَفَرَّقَ شَعْرُهُ، فَقَالَ: **«أَمَا كَانَ يَجِدُ هَذَا مَا يُسَكِّنُ بِهِ شَعْرَهُ؟»**، وَرَأَى رَجُلًا آخَرَ وَعَلَيْهِ ثِيَابٌ وَسِخَةٌ، فَقَالَ: **«أَمَا كَانَ هَذَا يَجِدُ مَاءً يَغْسِلُ بِهِ ثَوْبَهُ؟»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Jabir ibn 'Abdullah (رضي الله عنهما).
english_translation: Jabir reported: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ visited us and saw a disheveled man whose hair was untidy. He said: "Could this man not find something to tidy his hair with?" And he saw another man wearing filthy clothes, and said: "Could this man not find water to wash his clothes with?
benefits_en: Islam promotes clean garments, groomed hair, and neat appearances as reflections of aesthetic beauty and self-respect.

topic_en: The Prophet's Mission to Perfect Noble Moral Character
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«إِنَّمَا بُعِثْتُ لِأُتَمِّمَ صَالِحَ الْأَخْلَاقِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "I was only sent to perfect the highest standards of noble moral character (Makarim al-Akhlaq).
benefits_en: The ultimate culmination of the Islamic message is the perfection of human character, integrity, compassion, and refined manners.

topic_ar: أَثْقَلُ شَيْءٍ فِي الْمِيزَانِ حُسْنُ الْخُلُقِ
topic_en: Good Character is the Heaviest Deed on the Scale
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: **«مَا مِنْ شَيْءٍ أَثْقَلُ فِي مِيزَانِ الْمُؤْمِنِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مِنْ حُسْنِ الْخُلُقِ، وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَيُبْغِضُ الْفَاحِشَ الْبَذِيءَ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu al-Darda' (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "There is nothing heavier on the Scale of the believer on the Day of Resurrection than good moral character; and indeed, Allah detests the vulgar, foul-mouthed person.
benefits_en: Noble character, forbearance, and courteous speech outweigh countless voluntary rituals on the ultimate Day of Judgment.

topic_ar: أَقْرَبُكُمْ مِنِّي مَجْلِسًا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ أَحَاسِنُكُمْ أَخْلَاقًا
topic_en: The Closest to the Prophet ﷺ on the Day of Judgment
arabic_matn: عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ: **«إِنَّ مِنْ أَحَبِّكُمْ إِلَيَّ وَأَقْرَبِكُمْ مِنِّي مَجْلِسًا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ أَحَاسِنَكُمْ أَخْلَاقًا، وَإِنَّ أَبْغَضَكُمْ إِلَيَّ وَأَبْعَدَكُمْ مِنِّي مَجْلِسًا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ الثَّرْثَارُونَ وَالْمُتَشَدِّقُونَ وَالْمُتَفَيْهِقُونَ»**، قَالُوا: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، قَدْ عَلِمْنَا الثَّرْثَارُونَ وَالْمُتَشَدِّقُونَ، فَمَا الْمُتَفَيْهِقُونَ؟ قَالَ: **«الْمُتَكَبِّرُونَ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Jabir ibn 'Abdullah (رضي الله عنهما).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Indeed, the most beloved of you to me and the closest of you to me in sitting on the Day of Resurrection are those of you with the best character. And indeed, the most detested of you to me and the farthest of you from me on the Day of Resurrection are the boastful prattlers (Thartharun), the pompous blowhards (Mutashaddiqun), and the Mutafayhiqun." They asked: "O Messenger of Allah, we know the prattlers and the pompous, but who are the Mutafayhiqun?" He replied: "The arrogant ones.
benefits_en: Eternal proximity to the Prophet ﷺ in Paradise is reserved for the humble, refined, and gentle, while pompous arrogance pushes the soul far away.

topic_en: Reaching the Rank of Perpetual Fasting and Night Prayer Through Character
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا قَالَتْ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ: **«إِنَّ الْمُؤْمِنَ لَيُدْرِكُ بِحُسْنِ خُلُقِهِ دَرَجَةَ الصَّائِمِ الْقَائِمِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'A'ishah (رضي الله عنها).
english_translation: A'ishah narrated: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "Indeed, by virtue of his noble character, a believer surely attains the spiritual rank of the one who constantly fasts and spends the nights in prayer.
benefits_en: Enduring interpersonal difficulties with forbearance and grace elevates a person to the heavenly heights achieved by ascetic worshipers.

topic_en: The Real Strong Man Controls Himself When Angry
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ: **«لَيْسَ الشَّدِيدُ بِالصُّرَعَةِ، إِنَّمَا الشَّدِيدُ الَّذِي يَمْلِكُ نَفْسَهُ عِنْدَ الْغَضَبِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The strong person is not the one who overpowers rivals in wrestling; rather, the truly strong person is the one who controls himself in moments of anger.
benefits_en: True heroism is psychological and spiritual mastery over wrath, impulses, and retaliatory pride.

topic_en: The Two Beloved Qualities: Forbearance and Deliberation
arabic_matn: عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ لِأَشَجِّ عَبْدِ الْقَيْسِ: **«إِنَّ فِيكَ خَصْلَتَيْنِ يُحِبُّهُمَا اللَّهُ: الْحِلْمُ، وَالْأَنَاةُ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn 'Abbas (رضي الله عنهما).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to Ashajj 'Abd al-Qays: "Indeed, you possess two distinct qualities which Allah loves: forbearance (Al-Hilm) and calm deliberation (Al-Anah).
benefits_en: Forbearance in swallowing provocation and patience in avoiding hasty judgments represent two of the most beloved character traits to Allah.

topic_en: The Master Advice: "Do Not Become Angry"
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ جَاءَهُ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ: أَوْصِنِي، قَالَ: **«لَا تَغْضَبْ»**، فَرَدَّدَ مِرَارًا، قَالَ: **«لَا تَغْضَبْ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: A man came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said: "Advise me." The Prophet ﷺ said: "Do not become angry." The man repeated his request several times, and each time the Prophet ﷺ said: "Do not become angry.
benefits_en: Restraining anger preserves physical health, mental sanity, familial relationships, and spiritual salvation from all avenues of ruin.

topic_en: The Celestial Reward for Suppressing Anger
arabic_matn: عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ مُعَاذِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ: **«مَنْ كَظَمَ غَيْظًا وَهُوَ قَادِرٌ عَلَى أَنْ يُنْفِذَهُ، دَعَاهُ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ عَلَى رُءُوسِ الْخَلَائِقِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ حَتَّى يُخَيِّرَهُ مِنَ الْحُورِ الْعِينِ مَا شَاءَ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Mu'adh ibn Anas (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever suppresses his rage while possessing the power to execute it, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, will summon him before the heads of all creation on the Day of Resurrection and allow him to choose whichever of the wide-eyed maidens of Paradise (Al-Hoor al-'Iyn) he desires.
benefits_en: Choosing gracious restraint over revenge when holding absolute power to strike back earns the highest public honors before all assembled creation on Judgment Day.

topic_en: Practical De-escalation Techniques for Anger
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ لَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«إِذَا غَضِبَ أَحَدُكُمْ وَهُوَ قَائِمٌ فَلْيَجْلِسْ، فَإِنْ ذَهَبَ عَنْهُ الْغَضَبُ وَإِلَّا فَلْيَضْطَجِعْ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Dharr al-Ghifari (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to us: "When one of you becomes angry while standing, let him sit down. If his anger departs from him, well and good; otherwise, let him lie down.
benefits_en: Changing physical posture from standing to sitting and lying down lowers blood pressure, reduces aggressive impulse, and prevents rash physical retaliation.

topic_ar: مَا زَادَ اللَّهُ عَبْدًا بِعَفْوٍ إِلَّا عِزًّا
topic_en: Pardoning Others Only Increases Honor
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ: **«مَا نَقَصَتْ صَدَقَةٌ مِنْ مَالٍ، وَمَا زَادَ اللَّهُ عَبْدًا بِعَفْوٍ إِلَّا عِزًّا، وَمَا تَوَاضَعَ أَحَدٌ لِلَّهِ إِلَّا رَفَعَهُ اللَّهُ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Charity never diminishes wealth; and Allah never increases a servant who pardons except in honor; and no one humbles himself for the sake of Allah except that Allah elevates him.
benefits_en: Forgiving wrongdoers is not weakness; Allah crowns the forgiving soul with enduring prestige, respect, and elevation in both worlds.

topic_ar: مَا انْتَقَمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ لِنَفْسِهِ قَطُّ
topic_en: The Prophet Never Took Personal Revenge
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا قَالَتْ: **«مَا خُيِّرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ بَيْنَ أَمْرَيْنِ إِلَّا أَخَذَ أَيْسَرَهُمَا، مَا لَمْ يَكُنْ إِثْمًا، فَإِنْ كَانَ إِثْمًا كَانَ أَبْعَدَ النَّاسِ مِنْهُ، وَمَا انْتَقَمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ لِنَفْسِهِ، إِلَّا أَنْ تُنْتَهَكَ حُرْمَةُ اللَّهِ فَيَنْتَقِمَ لِلَّهِ بِهَا»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'A'ishah (رضي الله عنها).
english_translation: A'ishah narrated: "Never was the Messenger of Allah ﷺ given the choice between two matters except that he chose the easier of the two, as long as it was not a sin; if it was a sin, he was the farthest of all people from it. And never did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ take revenge for himself in anything, unless the sacred boundaries of Allah were violated, whereupon he would avenge for the sake of Allah.
benefits_en: Complete transcendence over personal grievances: adopting ease, overlooking insults, and reserving indignation solely for defending divine laws.

topic_ar: حِلْمُ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ مَعَ جَفَاءِ الْأَعْرَابِيِّ
topic_en: Forbearing the Harshness of the Bedouin
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: كُنْتُ أَمْشِي مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَعَلَيْهِ بُرْدٌ نَجْرَانِيٌّ غَلِيظُ الْحَاشِيَةِ، فَأَدْرَكَهُ أَعْرَابِيٌّ فَجَبَذَهُ بِرِدَائِهِ جَبْذَةً شَدِيدَةً، حَتَّى نَظَرْتُ إِلَى صَفْحَةِ عَاتِقِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَدْ أَثَّرَتْ بِهَا حَاشِيَةُ الْبُرْدِ مِنْ شِدَّةِ جَبْذَتِهِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: يَا مُحَمَّدُ، مُرْ لِي مِنْ مَالِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي عِنْدَكَ، فَالْتَفَتَ إِلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَضَحِكَ، ثُمَّ أَمَرَ لَهُ بِعَطَاءٍ.
narrator_en: Narrated by Anas ibn Malik (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: Anas ibn Malik reported: I was walking with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ who was wearing a thick-bordered Najrani cloak. A bedouin caught up with him and violently jerked his cloak so hard that I looked at the side of the Prophet's neck and saw the border of the cloak had left a red mark. The bedouin demanded: "O Muhammad! Order that I be given from Allah's wealth which you possess!" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ turned to him, smiled, and then ordered that a gift of provision be given to him.
benefits_en: Unmatched magnanimity: greeting physical rudeness and coarse demands with a warm smile and spontaneous generosity.

topic_en: Truthfulness Leads to Righteousness and Paradise
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: **«إِنَّ الصِّدْقَ يَهْدِي إِلَى الْبِرِّ، وَإِنَّ الْبِرَّ يَهْدِي إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ، وَإِنَّ الرَّجُلَ لَيَصْدُقُ حَتَّى يَكُونَ صِدِّيقًا، وَإِنَّ الْكَذِبَ يَهْدِي إِلَى الْفُجُورِ، وَإِنَّ الْفُجُورَ يَهْدِي إِلَى النَّارِ، وَإِنَّ الرَّجُلَ لَيَكْذِبُ حَتَّى يُكْتَبَ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ كَذَّابًا»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn Mas'ud (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Truthfulness leads to righteousness, and righteousness leads to Paradise; and a man continues to speak the truth until he is recorded with Allah as a champion of truth (Siddiq). And falsehood leads to wickedness, and wickedness leads to Hellfire; and a man continues to tell lies until he is recorded with Allah as an inveterate liar.
benefits_en: Truthfulness in words and deeds shapes righteous destiny culminating in Paradise, while casual dishonesty corrupts character toward destruction.

topic_ar: أَرْبَعُ خِلَالٍ مَنْ كُنَّ فِيهِ كَانَ مُنَافِقًا
topic_en: Four Core Signs of Hypocrisy in Moral Conduct
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ: **«أَرْبَعٌ مَنْ كُنَّ فِيهِ كَانَ مُنَافِقًا خَالِصًا، وَمَنْ كَانَتْ فِيهِ خَصْلَةٌ مِنْهُنَّ كَانَتْ فِيهِ خَصْلَةٌ مِنَ النِّفَاقِ حَتَّى يَدَعَهَا: إِذَا اؤْتُمِنَ خَانَ، وَإِذَا حَدَّثَ كَذَبَ، وَإِذَا عَاهَدَ غَدَرَ، وَإِذَا خَاصَمَ فَجَرَ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn 'Amr (رضي الله عنهما).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Four traits, whoever possesses them is a pure hypocrite, and whoever possesses one of them has a trait of hypocrisy until he abandons it: when he is entrusted, he betrays; when he speaks, he lies; when he makes a covenant, he acts treacherously; and when he disputes, he resorts to foulness and insolence.
benefits_en: Hypocrisy is manifested in behavioral degradation: dishonesty, betrayal of trusts, breaking treaties, and obscene conduct during arguments.

topic_ar: كُلُّ هَيِّنٍ لَيِّنٍ سَهْلٍ قَرِيبٍ مِنَ النَّاسِ
topic_en: Softness and Accessibility Forbids Hellfire
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«أَلَا أُخْبِرُكُمْ بِمَنْ يَحْرُمُ عَلَى النَّارِ - أَوْ بِمَنْ تَحْرُمُ عَلَيْهِ النَّارُ -؟ عَلَى كُلِّ قَرِيبٍ، هَيِّنٍ، سَهْلٍ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn Mas'ud (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Shall I not inform you of whom the Fire is forbidden to touch—or upon whom the Fire is forbidden? It is forbidden for every person who is approachable, gentle, easy-going, and close to people.
benefits_en: An accessible, flexible, warm demeanor shields the servant from the flames of Hellfire.

topic_en: True Patience Occurs at the Initial Shock
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: مَرَّ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ بِامْرَأَةٍ تَبْكِي عِنْدَ قَبْرٍ، فَقَالَ: **«اتَّقِي اللَّهَ وَاصْبِرِي»**، قَالَتْ: إِلَيْكَ عَنِّي، فَإِنَّكَ لَمْ تُصَبْ بِمُصِيبَتِي، وَلَمْ تَعْرِفْهُ، فَقِيلَ لَهَا: إِنَّهُ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ، فَأَتَتْ بَابَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَلَمْ تَجِدْ عِنْدَهُ بَوَّابِينَ، فَقَالَتْ: لَمْ أَعْرِفْكَ، فَقَالَ: **«إِنَّمَا الصَّبْرُ عِنْدَ الصَّدْمَةِ الْأُولَى»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Anas ibn Malik (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ passed by a woman weeping at a grave and said: "Fear Allah and be patient." She replied: "Leave me alone! You have not been stricken with my calamity," not recognizing him. When told it was the Prophet ﷺ, she went to his door—finding no doorkeepers—and said: "I did not recognize you!" The Prophet ﷺ said: "True patience is only at the very first stroke of calamity.
benefits_en: The genuine test of spiritual endurance is maintaining emotional composure and faith during the very first moments of shock and tragedy.

topic_ar: مَا أُعْطِيَ أَحَدٌ عَطَاءً خَيْرًا وَأَوْسَعَ مِنَ الصَّبْرِ
topic_en: Patience is the Most Comprehensive Divine Blessing
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: أَنَّ نَاسًا مِنَ الْأَنْصَارِ سَأَلُوا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَأَعْطَاهُمْ... ثُمَّ قَالَ: **«مَا يَكُونُ عِنْدِي مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَلَنْ أَدَّخِرَهُ عَنْكُمْ، وَمَنْ يَسْتَعْفِفْ يُعِفَّهُ اللَّهُ، وَمَنْ يَسْتَغْنِ يُغْنِهِ اللَّهُ، وَمَنْ يَتَصَبَّرْ يُصَبِّرْهُ اللَّهُ، وَمَا أُعْطِيَ أَحَدٌ عَطَاءً خَيْرًا وَأَوْسَعَ مِنَ الصَّبْرِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whatever good I have, I will never withhold from you. Whoever seeks chastity/modesty, Allah will keep him chaste; whoever seeks self-sufficiency, Allah will make him self-sufficient; and whoever strives to be patient, Allah will grant him patience. And no one has ever been given a gift that is better and more vast than patience.
benefits_en: Patience (Sabr) is the master key to resilience, spiritual dignity, emotional stability, and ultimate victory in life.

topic_ar: فَضْلُ مُخَالَطَةِ النَّاسِ وَالصَّبْرِ عَلَى أَذَاهُمْ
topic_en: Mingling with People and Enduring Their Shortcomings
arabic_matn: عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: **«الْمُسْلِمُ إِذَا كَانَ يُخَالِطُ النَّاسَ وَيَصْبِرُ عَلَى أَذَاهُمْ، خَيْرٌ مِنَ الَّذِي لَا يُخَالِطُ النَّاسَ وَلَا يَصْبِرُ عَلَى أَذَاهُمْ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn 'Umar (رضي الله عنهما).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "The Muslim who mingles with people and patiently endures their harm is better than the one who does not mingle with people and does not endure their harm.
benefits_en: Active social engagement, community service, and enduring public friction with patience is spiritually superior to passive isolation.

topic_en: True Wealth is Contentment of the Soul
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: **«لَيْسَ الْغِنَى عَنْ كَثْرَةِ الْعَرَضِ، وَلَكِنَّ الْغِنَى غِنَى النَّفْسِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Richness is not in the abundance of worldly goods; rather, true richness is the richness of the soul (contentment).
benefits_en: Material accumulation without inner contentment leaves a person perpetually poor; serenity and independence reside solely in a grateful heart.

topic_ar: مَنْ لَا يَشْكُرِ النَّاسَ لَا يَشْكُرِ اللَّهَ
topic_en: Gratitude to People is Gratitude to Allah
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: **«لَا يَشْكُرُ اللَّهَ مَنْ لَا يَشْكُرُ النَّاسَ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "He does not truly thank Allah who does not thank people (for their kindness).
benefits_en: Acknowledging and reciprocating human benevolence is an integral part of fulfilling gratitude to the Creator.

topic_en: The Love of Optimism and Positive Outlook (Al-Fa'l)
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ: **«لَا طِيَرَةَ، وَخَيْرُهَا الْفَأْلُ»**، قَالُوا: وَمَا الْفَأْلُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ؟ قَالَ: **«الْكَلِمَةُ الصَّالِحَةُ يَسْمَعُهَا أَحَدُكُمْ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "There is no superstition or bad omen (Tiyarah), and the best of it is optimism (Al-Fa'l)." They asked: "What is Al-Fa'l, O Messenger of Allah?" He replied: "A wholesome, good word that one of you hears.
benefits_en: Rejecting superstitious pessimism and maintaining a joyful, hopeful attitude rooted in positive expectations of Allah.

topic_en: Guarding the Tongue and Private Parts Guarantees Paradise
arabic_matn: عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ: **«مَنْ يَضْمَنْ لِي مَا بَيْنَ لَحْيَيْهِ وَمَا بَيْنَ رِجْلَيْهِ أَضْمَنْ لَهُ الْجَنَّةَ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Sahl ibn Sa'd (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever guarantees for me (safeguarding) what is between his jaws (his tongue) and what is between his legs (his chastity), I guarantee for him Paradise.
benefits_en: Disciplining speech and preserving sexual chastity protects the servant from life's two most destructive temptations, securing eternal salvation.

topic_en: The Weight of a Single Word in Divine Pleasure or Wrath
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: **«إِنَّ الْعَبْدَ لَيَتَكَلَّمُ بِالْكَلِمَةِ مِنْ رِضْوَانِ اللَّهِ لَا يُلْقِي لَهَا بَالًا، يَرْفَعُهُ اللَّهُ بِهَا دَرَجَاتٍ، وَإِنَّ الْعَبْدَ لَيَتَكَلَّمُ بِالْكَلِمَةِ مِنْ سَخَطِ اللَّهِ لَا يُلْقِي لَهَا بَالًا، يَهْوِي بِهَا فِي جَهَنَّمَ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Indeed, a servant may utter a word pleasing to Allah without giving it much weight, by which Allah elevates him many ranks. And indeed, a servant may utter a word displeasing to Allah without giving it much weight, by which he plunges into Hell.
benefits_en: Utmost vigilance in spoken and written words: a single sentence of encouragement or slander can dramatically alter one's eternal fate.

topic_en: The Precise Definition of Backbiting (Ghibah)
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ: **«أَتَدْرُونَ مَا الْغِيبَةُ؟»** قَالُوا: اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ، قَالَ: **«ذِكْرُكَ أَخَاكَ بِمَا يَكْرَهُ»**، قِيلَ: أَفَرَأَيْتَ إِنْ كَانَ فِي أَخِي مَا أَقُولُ؟ قَالَ: **«إِنْ كَانَ فِيهِ مَا تَقُولُ فَقَدِ اغْتَبْتَهُ، وَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ فِيهِ فَقَدْ بَهَتَّهُ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ asked: "Do you know what backbiting is?" They said: "Allah and His Messenger know best." He said: "Mentioning your brother with that which he dislikes." It was asked: "What if my brother actually has what I say?" He replied: "If he has what you say, you have backbitten him; and if he does not have it, then you have slandered him (Buhtan).
benefits_en: Backbiting is mentioning real negative traits of someone in their absence; fabricating false claims against them is the even worse crime of slander.

topic_en: Tale-Bearers (Namim) Barred from Paradise
arabic_matn: عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ بْنِ الْيَمَانِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ يَقُولُ: **«لَا يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ قَتَّاتٌ»** (أَيْ: نَمَّامٌ).
narrator_en: Narrated by Hudhayfah ibn al-Yaman (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: Hudhayfah reported: I heard the Prophet ﷺ say: "The tale-bearer (Namman / Qattat - who carries gossip between people to cause discord) will not enter Paradise.
benefits_en: Carrying malicious stories between individuals or groups to destroy relationships is a major sin blocking entry into Paradise.

topic_en: Defending the Honor of an Absent Brother
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: **«مَنْ رَدَّ عَنْ عِرْضِ أَخِيهِ، رَدَّ اللَّهُ عَنْ وَجْهِهِ النَّارَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu al-Darda' (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Whoever defends the honor of his brother in his absence, Allah will shield his face from the Fire on the Day of Resurrection.
benefits_en: Bravely speaking up to stop gossip and defend absent companions earns personal divine protection from Hellfire.

topic_ar: رَحِمَ اللَّهُ رَجُلًا سَمْحًا إِذَا بَاعَ وَإِذَا اشْتَرَى
topic_en: Leniency in Commercial Buying, Selling, and Repayment
arabic_matn: عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ: **«رَحِمَ اللَّهُ رَجُلًا سَمْحًا إِذَا بَاعَ، وَإِذَا اشْتَرَى، وَإِذَا اقْتَضَى»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Jabir ibn 'Abdullah (رضي الله عنهما).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "May Allah have mercy on a person who is easy-going and generous when he sells, when he buys, and when he demands repayment of his debt.
benefits_en: Gentleness, flexibility, and graciousness in financial bargaining and debt collection attract divine mercy into all aspects of life.

topic_en: The Prophet's Sublime Character with Family
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا قَالَتْ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«خَيْرُكُمْ خَيْرُكُمْ لِأَهْلِهِ، وَأَنَا خَيْرُكُمْ لِأَهْلِي»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'A'ishah (رضي الله عنها).
english_translation: A'ishah reported: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The best among you are those who are best to their families, and I am the best among you to my family.
benefits_en: The genuine litmus test of good character is not public diplomacy, but private tenderness, patience, and honor shown behind closed doors to one's spouse and household.

topic_en: The Prophet's Character was the Living Embodiment of the Qur'an
arabic_matn: عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ هِشَامِ بْنِ عَامِرٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِعَائِشَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا: يَا أُمَّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، أَنْبِئِينِي عَنْ خُلُقِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ، قَالَتْ: أَلَسْتَ تَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ؟ قُلْتُ: بَلَى، قَالَتْ: **«فَإِنَّ خُلُقَ نَبِيِّ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَانَ الْقُرْآنَ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'A'ishah (رضي الله عنها).
english_translation: Sa'd ibn Hisham asked 'A'ishah: "O Mother of the Believers, inform me about the character of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ." She asked: "Do you not recite the Qur'an?" He said: "Yes." She said: "Indeed, the character of the Prophet of Allah ﷺ was the Qur'an (in action).
benefits_en: The Prophet ﷺ was the living, breathing manifestation of all Qur'anic values—pleased with what pleased the Qur'an and displeased by what it forbade.

topic_ar: عَشْرُ سِنِينَ فِي خِدْمَةِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ
topic_en: Ten Years of Service Without a Single Word of Rebuke
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: **«خَدَمْتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ عَشْرَ سِنِينَ، فَمَا قَالَ لِي: أُفٍّ، وَلَا: لِمَ صَنَعْتَ؟ وَلَا: أَلَّا صَنَعْتَ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Anas ibn Malik (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: Anas ibn Malik reported: "I served the Prophet ﷺ for ten full years, and he never once said to me 'Uff' (an expression of annoyance), nor did he ever say concerning something I did: 'Why did you do that?' nor concerning something I omitted: 'Why did you not do that?
benefits_en: The pinnacle of forbearance and emotional maturity: treating domestic assistants and subordinates with unconditional gentleness, patience, and dignity.

topic_ar: صِلْ مَنْ قَطَعَكَ وَأَعْطِ مَنْ حَرَمَكَ وَاعْفُ عَمَّنْ ظَلَمَكَ
topic_en: Forgiving the One Who Sinned Against You
arabic_matn: عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: لَقِيتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ... فَقَالَ لِي: **«يَا عُقْبَةَ بْنَ عَامِرٍ، صِلْ مَنْ قَطَعَكَ، وَأَعْطِ مَنْ حَرَمَكَ، وَاعْفُ عَمَّنْ ظَلَمَكَ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Uqbah ibn 'Amir (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: Uqbah ibn 'Amir reported that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to him: "O 'Uqbah ibn 'Amir, reconnect with the one who severs ties with you, give to the one who deprives you, and pardon the one who wrongs you.
benefits_en: The highest standard of heroic morality: conquering personal resentment by meeting isolation with connection, deprivation with giving, and injustice with forgiveness.

topic_ar: عَفْوُ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ عَنِ الْمَرْأَةِ الَّتِي سَمَّتْهُ
topic_en: The Prophet's Forgiveness Toward the Poison-Bearer at Khaybar
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: **«أَنَّ امْرَأَةً يَهُودِيَّةً أَتَتْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِشَاةٍ مَسْمُومَةٍ، فَأَكَلَ مِنْهَا، فَجِيءَ بِهَا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ، فَسَأَلَهَا عَنْ ذَلِكَ، فَقَالَتْ: أَرَدْتُ لِأَقْتُلَكَ، قَالَ: مَا كَانَ اللَّهُ لِيُسَلِّطَكِ عَلَى ذَاكِ، فَقَالُوا: أَلَا نَقْتُلُهَا؟ قَالَ: لَا»**، قَالَ فَمَا زِلْتُ أَعْرِفُهَا فِي لَهَوَاتِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ.
narrator_en: Narrated by Anas ibn Malik (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: A Jewish woman brought a poisoned roasted sheep to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and he ate from it. She was brought before him and asked about it. She said: "I wanted to kill you." The Prophet ﷺ said: "Allah would never grant you power over that." The Companions asked: "Shall we execute her?" He said: "No." Anas added: "I continuously recognized the effect of that poison in the palate of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.
benefits_en: Transcendent prophetic mercy: pardoning an assassin who attempted to poison him directly.

topic_ar: عَفْوُ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ عَنْ غَوْرَثِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ
topic_en: Pardoning the Enemy Who Drew Sword Above His Head
