english_translation: A'ishah reported that while on a journey with the Prophet ﷺ: "I raced him on foot and I won. Later, when I had gained weight, I raced him again and he won. He smiled and said: 'This victory makes up for that earlier race!
benefits_en: Cultivating romance, cheerful playfulness, and athletic fun between spouses strengthens emotional bonding.

topic_en: Four Acts Leading a Woman to Enter Any Gate of Paradise
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«إِذَا صَلَّتِ الْمَرْأَةُ خَمْسَهَا، وَصَامَتْ شَهْرَهَا، وَحَصَّنَتْ فَرْجَهَا، وَأَطَاعَتْ بَعْلَهَا، دَخَلَتْ مِنْ أَيِّ أَبْوَابِ الْجَنَّةِ شَاءَتْ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When a woman prays her five daily prayers, fasts her month of Ramadan, guards her chastity, and obeys her husband (in goodness), she will enter Paradise through whichever of its gates she desires.
benefits_en: The concise, beautiful pathway to Paradise for a Muslim woman: fulfilling core worship, guarding chastity, and fostering marital harmony.

topic_en: Strict Prohibition of Injustice Between Co-Wives
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: **«مَنْ كَانَتْ لَهُ امْرَأَتَانِ فَمَالَ إِلَى إِحْدَاهُمَا، جَاءَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَشِقُّهُ مَائِلٌ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Whoever has two wives and tilts unjustly in favor of one of them over the other, will come on the Day of Resurrection with half of his body drooping/paralyzed.
benefits_en: Severe warning against favoritism in polygynous marriages; strict material equality in time, lodging, and maintenance is an absolute obligation.

topic_en: Prohibition of Temporary Contract Marriage (Nikah al-Mut'ah)
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: **«أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ نَهَى عَنْ مُتْعَةِ النِّسَاءِ يَوْمَ خَيْبَرَ، وَعَنْ أَكْلِ لُحُومِ الْحُمُرِ الْإِنْسِيَّةِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Ali ibn Abi Talib (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: Ali ibn Abi Talib reported that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ permanently forbade temporary marriage (Mut'ah) on the Day of Khaybar, and he forbade eating the meat of domestic donkeys.
benefits_en: Marriage in Islam must be entered with permanent, honorable intention; temporary contract unions are strictly prohibited.

topic_en: The Legality of Dissolution by Wife (Khul')
arabic_matn: عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا: أَنَّ امْرَأَةَ ثَابِتِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ أَتَتِ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ فَقَالَتْ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، ثَابِتُ بْنُ قَيْسٍ، مَا أَعْتِبُ عَلَيْهِ فِي خُلُقٍ وَلَا دِينٍ، وَلَكِنِّي أَكْرَهُ الْكُفْرَ فِي الْإِسْلَامِ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«أَتَرُدِّينَ عَلَيْهِ حَدِيقَتَهُ؟»** قَالَتْ: نَعَمْ، قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«اقْبَلِ الْحَدِيقَةَ وَطَلِّقْهَا تَطْلِيقَةً»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn 'Abbas (رضي الله عنهما).
english_translation: The wife of Thabit ibn Qays came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: "O Messenger of Allah, I do not find fault with Thabit concerning his character or religious commitment, but I fear ungratefulness/disobedience in Islam (inability to fulfill marital duties due to lack of attraction)." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ asked: "Will you return to him the garden he gave you as a dowry?" She said: "Yes." The Prophet ﷺ said to Thabit: "Accept the garden and grant her a divorce.
benefits_en: Islam grants women the legal right to seek marital release (Khul') through mutual financial settlement when emotional incompatibility makes life together untenable.

topic_en: The Child Belongs to the Marital Bed
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا قَالَتْ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«الْوَلَدُ لِلْفِرَاشِ، وَلِلْعَاهِرِ الْحَجَرُ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'A'ishah (رضي الله عنها).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The child belongs to the lawful marital bed, and for the adulterer is the stone (deprivation and punishment).
benefits_en: Islamic jurisprudence fiercely protects the legitimacy of lineage, attributing any child born within a valid marriage to the lawful husband.

topic_ar: يَحْرُمُ مِنَ الرَّضَاعِ مَا يَحْرُمُ مِنَ النَّسَبِ
topic_en: Milk Relations Establish the Same Prohibitions as Blood Relations
arabic_matn: عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا قَالَ: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ فِي بِنْتِ حَمْزَةَ: **«لَا تَحِلُّ لِي؛ يَحْرُمُ مِنَ الرَّضَاعِ مَا يَحْرُمُ مِنَ النَّسَبِ، هِيَ بِنْتُ أَخِي مِنَ الرَّضَاعَةِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn 'Abbas (رضي الله عنهما).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said concerning the daughter of Hamzah: "She is not lawful for me to marry; for whatever is prohibited through blood relations is likewise prohibited through suckling (Rada'ah); she is the daughter of my foster-brother.
benefits_en: Breastfeeding during infancy establishes sacred foster-kinship, creating permanent marital prohibitions identical to blood relations.

topic_en: Teaching Children Prayer at Seven Years of Age
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«مُرُوا أَوْلَادَكُمْ بِالصَّلَاةِ وَهُمْ أَبْنَاءُ سَبْعِ سِنِينَ، وَاضْرِبُوهُمْ عَلَيْهَا وَهُمْ أَبْنَاءُ عَشْرٍ، وَفَرِّقُوا بَيْنَهُمْ فِي الْمَضَاجِعِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn 'Amr (رضي الله عنهما).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Command your children to pray when they reach seven years of age; discipline them (firmly without injury) concerning it when they reach ten; and separate their sleeping beds.
benefits_en: Gradual pedagogical training in religious discipline from age seven establishes lifelong devotional habits and preserves modesty at home.

topic_en: Sponsoring Three Daughters Ensures Paradise
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا قَالَتْ: دَخَلَتِ امْرَأَةٌ مَعَهَا ابْنَتَانِ لَهَا تَسْأَلُ، فَلَمْ تَجِدْ عِنْدِي شَيْئًا غَيْرَ تَمْرَةٍ وَاحِدَةٍ، فَأَعْطَيْتُهَا إِيَّاهَا، فَقَسَمَتْهَا بَيْنَ ابْنَتَيْهَا وَلَمْ تَأْكُلْ مِنْهَا، ثُمَّ قَامَتْ فَخَرَجَتْ، فَدَخَلَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ عَلَيْنَا فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ فَقَالَ: **«مَنِ ابْتُلِيَ مِنْ هَذِهِ الْبَنَاتِ بِشَيْءٍ كُنَّ لَهُ سِتْرًا مِنَ النَّارِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'A'ishah (رضي الله عنها).
english_translation: A'ishah reported: A poor mother entered with her two daughters begging for food. I found nothing except a single date, which I gave her. She divided it between her two daughters and ate none of it herself, then stood and left. When the Prophet ﷺ entered, I told him, and he said: "Whoever is tested with daughters and treats them with loving kindness, they will be a shield for him from the Fire.
benefits_en: Loving, self-sacrificing care for daughters erects an impenetrable barrier between parents and the Hellfire.

topic_en: The Best Charity is Spending on One's Family
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ الْبَدْرِيِّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: **«إِذَا أَنْفَقَ الرَّجُلُ عَلَى أَهْلِهِ يَحْتَسِبُهَا، فَهِيَ لَهُ صَدَقَةٌ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Mas'ud al-Badri (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "When a man spends upon his family seeking Allah's reward, it is recorded for him as an act of charity.
benefits_en: Providing groceries, housing, and comforts for one's wife and children with righteous intention is an ongoing, highly rewarded form of worship.

topic_en: Even the Morsel Placed in Your Wife's Mouth is Rewarded
arabic_matn: عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ لَهُ: **«...وَإِنَّكَ لَنْ تُنْفِقَ نَفَقَةً تَبْتَغِي بِهَا وَجْهَ اللَّهِ إِلَّا أُجِرْتَ عَلَيْهَا، حَتَّى مَا تَجْعَلُ فِي فَمِ امْرَأَتِكَ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "...And you will never spend any expenditure seeking thereby the Countenance of Allah except that you will be rewarded for it, even the single morsel of food that you place in the mouth of your wife.
benefits_en: Marital affection and feeding one's spouse with love and playfulness is directly rewarded by the Lord of the Worlds.

topic_en: Custody of the Child Belongs to the Mother
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا: أَنَّ امْرَأَةً قَالَتْ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنَّ ابْنِي هَذَا كَانَ بَطْنِي لَهُ وِعَاءً، وَثَدْيِي لَهُ سِقَاءً، وَحِجْرِي لَهُ حِوَاءً، وَإِنَّ أَبَاهُ طَلَّقَنِي، وَأَرَادَ أَنْ يَنْتَزِعَهُ مِنِّي، فَقَالَ لَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«أَنْتِ أَحَقُّ بِهِ مَا لَمْ تَنْكِحِي»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn 'Amr (رضي الله عنهما).
english_translation: A woman came and said: "O Messenger of Allah, my womb was a vessel for this son of mine, my breast was his drink, and my lap was his home; now his father has divorced me and wants to snatch him away from me!" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to her: "You have greater right to custody of him as long as you do not remarry.
benefits_en: Primary child custody after divorce is assigned to the mother due to her innate maternal tenderness and nurturing capability.

topic_en: The Solemnity of the Marriage Contract (Mithaqan Ghalidha)
arabic_matn: عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا، فِي خُطْبَةِ حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ: **«فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ فِي النِّسَاءِ؛ فَإِنَّكُمْ أَخَذْتُمُوهُنَّ بِأَمَانِ اللَّهِ، وَاسْتَحْلَلْتُمْ فُرُوجَهُنَّ بِكَلِمَةِ اللَّهِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Jabir ibn 'Abdullah (رضي الله عنهما).
english_translation: In his historic Farewell Sermon, the Prophet ﷺ declared: "Fear Allah concerning women! For you have taken them into your custody by the sacred trust of Allah, and you have made intimacy with them lawful through the Word of Allah.
benefits_en: Marriage is a sacred covenant backed by the guarantee of Allah; abusing or betraying a spouse is a direct violation of divine trust.

topic_en: Consulting Women Regarding Their Marriage
arabic_matn: عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«الْأَيِّمُ أَحَقُّ بِنَفْسِهَا مِنْ وَلِيِّهَا، وَالْبِكْرُ تُسْتَأْذَنُ فِي نَفْسِهَا، وَإِذْنُهَا صُمَاتُهَا»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn 'Abbas (رضي الله عنهما).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The matron has greater right to decide concerning herself than her guardian, and the virgin must be consulted regarding herself, and her consent is her silence.
benefits_en: Complete respect for female autonomy in marital choices, prohibiting forced matrimonial arrangements.

topic_ar: التَّحْذِيرُ مِنْ طَلَبِ الطَّلَاقِ بِغَيْرِ بَأْسٍ
topic_en: Prohibition of Arbitrary Divorce Demands Without Severe Harm
arabic_matn: عَنْ ثَوْبَانَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«أَيُّمَا امْرَأَةٍ سَأَلَتْ زَوْجَهَا طَلَاقًا فِي غَيْرِ مَا بَأْسٍ، فَحَرَامٌ عَلَيْهَا رَائِحَةُ الْجَنَّةِ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Thawban (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Any woman who asks her husband for a divorce without any legitimate harm or severe necessity, the fragrance of Paradise is forbidden for her.
benefits_en: Preserving family stability by forbidding frivolous divorce demands, while preserving legal recourse when genuine harm exists.

topic_en: The Devil's Greatest Triumph is Destroying a Marriage
arabic_matn: عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«إِنَّ إِبْلِيسَ يَضَعُ عَرْشَهُ عَلَى الْمَاءِ، ثُمَّ يَبْعَثُ سَرَايَاهُ... فَيَجِيءُ أَحَدُهُمْ فَيَقُولُ: مَا تَرَكْتُهُ حَتَّى فَرَّقْتُ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ امْرَأَتِهِ، قَالَ: فَيُدْنِيهِ مِنْهُ وَيَقُولُ: نِعْمَ أَنْتَ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Jabir ibn 'Abdullah (رضي الله عنهما).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Indeed, Iblis places his throne upon the waters and sends out his detachments... One of them comes and says: 'I did not leave him until I caused separation between him and his wife!' Iblis draws him close and says: 'How excellent you are!' and crowns him.
benefits_en: Spousal breakdown and divorce are Satan's greatest strategic victories; protecting marital harmony is an act of spiritual warfare against demonic schemes.

topic_en: Equitability and Tenderness in Nightly Turns
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا: **«أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَانَ يَقْسِمُ بَيْنَ نِسَائِهِ فَيَعْدِلُ، وَيَقُولُ: اللَّهُمَّ هَذَا قَسْمِي فِيمَا أَمْلِكُ، فَلَا تَلُمْنِي فِيمَا تَمْلِكُ وَلَا أَمْلِكُ»** (يَعْنِي مَيْلَ الْقَلْبِ).
narrator_en: Narrated by 'A'ishah (رضي الله عنها).
english_translation: A'ishah reported that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to distribute his time equally among his wives with strict justice, and he would pray: "O Allah, this is my division in what I possess (time, maintenance, housing); so do not blame me for that which You possess and I do not possess (the involuntary inclination of the heart).
benefits_en: Strict external fairness in material distribution is legally required, while uncontrollable emotional feelings of the heart are excused by Allah.

topic_ar: النَّهْيُ عَنِ الْجَمْعِ بَيْنَ الْمَرْأَةِ وَعَمَّتِهَا أَوْ خَالَتِهَا
topic_en: Prohibition of Marrying a Woman Along with Her Paternal or Maternal Aunt
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: **«أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ نَهَى أَنْ تُنْكَحَ الْمَرْأَةُ عَلَى عَمَّتِهَا، أَوْ عَلَى خَالَتِهَا»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: Abu Hurairah reported that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade that a woman be married concurrently with her paternal aunt or her maternal aunt.
benefits_en: Islamic family law strictly prevents co-wives from being close blood relatives (sisters, aunts) to prevent co-wife jealousy from destroying sacred family ties.

topic_en: The Inherent Dignity and Care of the Nursing Mother
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْأَحْوَصِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ: **«أَلَا وَاسْتَوْصُوا بِالنِّسَاءِ خَيْرًا؛ فَإِنَّمَا هُنَّ عَوَانٌ عِنْدَكُمْ، لَيْسَ تَمْلِكُونَ مِنْهُنَّ شَيْئًا غَيْرَ ذَلِكَ... أَلَا وَإِنَّ لَكُمْ عَلَى نِسَائِكُمْ حَقًّا، وَلِنِسَائِكُمْ عَلَيْكُمْ حَقًّا»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Amr ibn al-Ahwas (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said in his Farewell Address: "Beware! Treat women with the utmost kindness; for they are partners entrusted to your care... Indeed, you have rights over your wives, and your wives have rights over you.
benefits_en: Marriage is a mutually balanced partnership of reciprocal rights, requiring perpetual justice, respect, and compassionate protection.

topic_en: The Sacred Status of the Mother in Raising Righteous Generations
arabic_matn: عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ جَاهِمَةَ السَّلَمِيِّ: أَنَّ جَاهِمَةَ جَاءَ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَقَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَرَدْتُ أَنْ أَغْزُوَ، وَقَدْ جِئْتُ أَسْتَشِيرُكَ، فَقَالَ: **«هَلْ لَكَ مِنْ أُمٍّ؟»** قَالَ: نَعَمْ، قَالَ: **«فَالْزَمْهَا؛ فَإِنَّ الْجَنَّةَ تَحْتَ رِجْلَيْهَا»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Mu'awiyah ibn Jahimah as-Salami (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: Jahimah came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: "O Messenger of Allah, I intend to join the military expedition and have come to consult you." The Prophet ﷺ asked: "Do you have a living mother?" He replied: "Yes." The Prophet ﷺ said: "Then stay devoted to her feet; for indeed, Paradise lies beneath her feet!
benefits_en: Devoted filial submission and humble service to one's mother is the direct gateway to entering Paradise.

topic_en: Honoring the Marital Conditions
arabic_matn: عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«أَحَقُّ الشُّرُوطِ أَنْ تُوفُوا بِهِ، مَا اسْتَحْلَلْتُمْ بِهِ الْفُرُوجَ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Uqbah ibn 'Amir (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The most binding conditions that you are obligated to fulfill are those by which you have made marital intimacy lawful (stipulations in the marriage contract).
benefits_en: Special contractual stipulations agreed upon during the marriage contract (e.g. housing conditions, non-relocation) are religiously binding upon the husband.

topic_en: Forbidding Shighar (Exchange Marriage Without Dowries)
arabic_matn: عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا: **«أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ نَهَى عَنِ الشِّغَارِ»**، وَالشِّغَارُ: أَنْ يُزَوِّجَ الرَّجُلُ ابْنَتَهُ عَلَى أَنْ يُزَوِّجَهُ الْآخَرُ ابْنَتَهُ، وَلَيْسَ بَيْنَهُمَا صَدَاقٌ.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn 'Umar (رضي الله عنهما).
english_translation: Ibn 'Umar reported: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade Shighar." Shighar is when a man marries his daughter to another man on condition that the other marries his daughter to him, with neither of them paying a dowry.
benefits_en: Islamic law outlaws transactional bartering of women without independent consent and individual dowries.

topic_en: Prohibition of Tahleel (Fraudulent Intermediary Marriage)
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: **«لَعَنَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ الْمُحَلِّلَ وَالْمُحَلَّلَ لَهُ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn Mas'ud (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: Abdullah ibn Mas'ud reported: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ cursed the Muhallil (the man who enters a sham marriage with a thrice-divorced woman to make her lawful for her ex-husband) and the Muhallal lahu (the ex-husband who arranges it).
benefits_en: Fake, temporary sham marriages arranged to circumvent three irrevocable divorces are cursed abominations in Islamic law.

topic_en: Financial Responsibility for the Household Rests on the Husband
arabic_matn: عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: **«كُلُّكُمْ رَاعٍ وَكُلُّكُمْ مَسْئُولٌ عَنْ رَعِيَّتِهِ: الْإِمَامُ رَاعٍ وَمَسْئُولٌ عَنْ رَعِيَّتِهِ، وَالرَّجُلُ رَاعٍ فِي أَهْلِهِ وَهُوَ مَسْئُولٌ عَنْ رَعِيَّتِهِ، وَالْمَرْأَةُ رَاعِيَةٌ فِي بَيْتِ زَوْجِهَا وَمَسْئُولَةٌ عَنْ رَعِيَّتِهَا»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn 'Umar (رضي الله عنهما).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Every one of you is a shepherd and every one of you is responsible for his flock: the ruler is a shepherd and responsible for his subjects; the man is a shepherd over his household and responsible for his flock; and the woman is a shepherdess in the home of her husband and responsible for her flock.
benefits_en: Domestic leadership is founded on shared, defined responsibilities where both spouses are held accountable before Allah for nurturing the family.

topic_en: Supporting and Caring for Orphaned Girls in the Family
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«مَنْ كَانَ لَهُ ثَلَاثُ بَنَاتٍ، أَوْ ثَلَاثُ أَخَوَاتٍ، أَوِ ابْنَتَانِ، أَوْ أُخْتَانِ، فَأَحْسَنَ صُحْبَتَهُنَّ، وَاتَّقَى اللَّهَ فِيهِنَّ، فَلَهُ الْجَنَّةُ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (رضي الله عنه).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever has three daughters, or three sisters, or two daughters, or two sisters, and treats them with loving kindness and fears Allah concerning them, will enter Paradise.
benefits_en: Supporting, educating, and honoring female dependents (daughters or sisters) is an immediate passport to Paradise.

topic_en: Compassion Toward Young Children in the Household
arabic_matn: عَنْ أُمِّ خَالِدٍ بِنْتِ خَالِدٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا قَالَتْ: أُتِيَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ بِثِيَابٍ فِيهَا خَمِيصَةٌ سَوْدَاءُ صَغِيرَةٌ... فَقَالَ: **«ائْتُونِي بِأُمِّ خَالِدٍ»** فَأُتِيَ بِي، فَأَلْبَسَهَا بِيَدِهِ وَقَالَ: **«أَبْلِي وَأَخْلِقِي»** مَرَّتَيْنِ، وَجَعَلَ يَنْظُرُ إِلَى عَلَمِ الْخَمِيصَةِ، وَيُشِيرُ بِيَدِهِ إِلَيَّ وَيَقُولُ: **«يَا أُمَّ خَالِدٍ، هَذَا سَنَاهْ»**، وَسَنَاهْ بِالْحَبَشِيَّةِ: حَسَنٌ.
narrator_en: Narrated by Umm Khalid bint Khalid (رضي الله عنها).
english_translation: Umm Khalid reported: Clothes were brought to the Prophet ﷺ including a small black silk cloak with embroidered borders... He said: "Bring me Umm Khalid." I was brought as a small girl, and he dressed me with his own hands, saying: "May you wear it out and replace it with new garments!" He looked at the colorful patterns and said to me in the Abyssinian language: "O Umm Khalid, this is Sanah!"—and 'Sanah' in Abyssinian means beautiful.
benefits_en: Exquisite Prophetic tenderness: dressing young children with affection, praying for their long life, and speaking to them in their familiar tongue to delight them.

topic_en: Kindness to the In-Laws and Relatives of the Spouse
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا قَالَتْ: **«مَا غِرْتُ عَلَى امْرَأَةٍ لِلنَّبِيِّ ﷺ مَا غِرْتُ عَلَى خَدِيجَةَ؛ لِكَثْرَةِ ذِكْرِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِيَّاهَا، وَلَقَدْ كَانَ يَذْبَحُ الشَّاةَ ثُمَّ يُقَطِّعُهَا أَعْضَاءً، ثُمَّ يَبْعَثُهَا فِي صَدَائِقِ خَدِيجَةَ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'A'ishah (رضي الله عنها).
english_translation: A'ishah narrated: "I never felt jealous of any wife of the Prophet ﷺ as I felt jealous of Khadijah, due to the frequency with which the Messenger of Allah ﷺ mentioned her. Whenever he slaughtered a sheep, he would cut it into pieces and send them to the female friends of Khadijah.
benefits_en: Unshakable loyalty: honoring the memory, family, and lifelong companions of a deceased spouse.

topic_en: Preserving the Right of the Wife in Inheritance and Estate
arabic_matn: عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا قَالَ: جَاءَتِ امْرَأَةُ سَعْدِ بْنِ الرَّبِيعِ بِابْنَتَيْهَا مِنْ سَعْدٍ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ... فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ لِعَمِّهِمَا: **«أَعْطِ ابْنَتَيْ سَعْدٍ الثُّلُثَيْنِ، وَأَعْطِ أُمَّهُمَا الثُّمُنَ، وَمَا بَقِيَ فَهُوَ لَكَ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by Jabir ibn 'Abdullah (رضي الله عنهما).
english_translation: The widow of Sa'd ibn ar-Rabi' brought her two daughters to the Prophet ﷺ seeking their inheritance rights. The Prophet ﷺ commanded the uncle: "Give the two daughters of Sa'd two-thirds, give their mother one-eighth, and whatever remains is for you.
benefits_en: Revolutionary Islamic inheritance legislation securing independent property rights and guaranteed financial estates for widows and orphaned daughters.

topic_en: The Sacredness of the Family Unit
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«كَفَى بِالْمَرْءِ إِثْمًا أَنْ يُضَيِّعَ مَنْ يَقُوتُ»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn 'Umar (رضي الله عنهما).
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "It is sufficient sin for a person that he neglects and abandons those whom he is obligated to sustain.
benefits_en: Willful financial or emotional neglect of one's children and family dependents is a grave mortal sin.

topic_en: Reconciliation and Patience in Marital Disputes
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا قَالَتْ: قَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: **«إِنِّي لَأَعْلَمُ إِذَا كُنْتِ عَنِّي رَاضِيَةً، وَإِذَا كُنْتِ عَلَيَّ غَضْبَى»**، قَالَتْ: فَقُلْتُ: مِنْ أَيْنَ تَعْرِفُ ذَلِكَ؟ فَقَالَ: **«أَمَّا إِذَا كُنْتِ عَنِّي رَاضِيَةً، فَإِنَّكِ تَقُولِينَ: لَا وَرَبِّ مُحَمَّدٍ، وَإِذَا كُنْتِ عَلَيَّ غَضْبَى، قُلْتِ: لَا وَرَبِّ إِبْرَاهِيمَ»**، قَالَتْ: قُلْتُ: أَجَلْ وَاللَّهِ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، مَا أَهْجُرُ إِلَّا اسْمَكَ.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'A'ishah (رضي الله عنها).
english_translation: A'ishah reported that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to her: "I know when you are pleased with me and when you are upset with me." She asked: "From where do you know that?" He said: "When you are pleased with me, you swear: 'No, by the Lord of Muhammad!' And when you are upset with me, you swear: 'No, by the Lord of Ibrahim!'" She said: "Yes, by Allah, O Messenger of Allah! I only leave your name (while love for you remains firmly in my heart).
benefits_en: Emotional sensitivity and sweet psychological insight into spousal moods, responding to subtle annoyance with gentle understanding.

topic_en: The Highest Honor: The Best to One's Family
arabic_matn: عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: **«خَيْرُكُمْ خَيْرُكُمْ لِأَهْلِهِ، وَأَنَا خَيْرُكُمْ لِأَهْلِي»**.
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn 'Abbas (رضي الله عنهما).
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "The best among you are those who are the best to their families, and I am the best among you to my family.
benefits_en: True Islamic nobility, piety, and honor are proven within the privacy of family life through patience, generosity, affection, and exemplary leadership.

topic_ar: كِتَابُ الْمُعَامَلَاتِ وَالْبُيُوعِ وَالْكَسْبِ الْحَلَالِ — التَّاجِرُ الصَّدُوقُ الأَمِينُ
topic_en: Book of Transactions & Halal Earning — The Honest and Trustworthy Merchant
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «التَّاجِرُ الصَّدُوقُ الأَمِينُ مَعَ النَّبِيِّينَ وَالصِّدِّيقِينَ وَالشُّهَدَاءِ».
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (may Allah be pleased with him)
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "The truthful and trustworthy merchant will be associated with the Prophets, the upright (Siddiqin), and the martyrs on the Day of Judgment.
takhrij: Sunan at-Tirmidhi (1209), Sunan ad-Darimi (2539) — Maktaba Shamela. Grading: Sahih li-Ghayrihi (Al-Albani).
grading: Sunan at-Tirmidhi (1209), Sunan ad-Darimi (2539) — Maktaba Shamela. Grading: Sahih li-Ghayrihi (Al-Albani).
benefits_en: Engaging in trade with scrupulous honesty, truthfulness, and transparency elevates commercial enterprise into high worship, ranking the ethical merchant alongside the spiritual elite of humanity.

topic_ar: كِتَابُ الْمُعَامَلَاتِ وَالْبُيُوعِ وَالْكَسْبِ الْحَلَالِ — أَطْيَبُ الْكَسْبِ
topic_en: Book of Transactions & Halal Earning — The Best and Purest Forms of Earning
arabic_matn: عَنْ رَافِعِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قِيلَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أَيُّ الْكَسْبِ أَطْيَبُ؟ قَالَ: «عَمَلُ الرَّجُلِ بِيَدِهِ، وَكُلُّ بَيْعٍ مَبْرُورٍ».
narrator_en: Narrated by Rafi' ibn Khadij (may Allah be pleased with him)
english_translation: It was asked: "O Messenger of Allah, which earning is the best and purest?" He ﷺ replied: "A man's work with his own hands, and every honest, accepted business transaction (free of fraud, deceit, and interest).
takhrij: Musnad Ahmad (17265), Al-Mustadrak 'ala al-Sahihayn by al-Hakim (2160) — Maktaba Shamela. Grading: Sahih (Al-Albani, Sahih at-Targhib 1691).
grading: Musnad Ahmad (17265), Al-Mustadrak 'ala al-Sahihayn by al-Hakim (2160) — Maktaba Shamela. Grading: Sahih (Al-Albani, Sahih at-Targhib 1691).
benefits_en: Islam honors productive physical labor, trade craftsmanship, and ethical commerce that avoids deception and unlawful exploitation.

topic_ar: كِتَابُ الْمُعَامَلَاتِ وَالْبُيُوعِ وَالْكَسْبِ الْحَلَالِ — السَّمَاحَةُ فِي الْبَيْعِ وَالشِّرَاءِ
topic_en: Book of Transactions & Halal Earning — Divine Mercy for Leniency in Buying, Selling, and Demanding Rights
arabic_matn: عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «رَحِمَ اللَّهُ رَجُلًا سَمْحًا إِذَا بَاعَ، وَإِذَا اشْتَرَى، وَإِذَا اقْتَضَى».
narrator_en: Narrated by Jabir ibn 'Abdullah (may Allah be pleased with them both)
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "May Allah show mercy to a person who is lenient and easygoing when he sells, when he buys, and when he demands back his rights (or debts).
takhrij: Sahih al-Bukhari (2076) — Maktaba Shamela. Grading: Sahih (صحيح).
grading: Sahih al-Bukhari (2076) — Maktaba Shamela. Grading: Sahih (صحيح).
benefits_en: Generosity, kindness, and flexibility in financial transactions invite special divine mercy and ease in this life and the Hereafter.

topic_ar: كِتَابُ الْمُعَامَلَاتِ وَالْبُيُوعِ وَالْكَسْبِ الْحَلَالِ — خِيَارُ الْمَجْلِسِ وَالْبَرَكَةُ فِي الصِّدْقِ
topic_en: Book of Transactions & Halal Earning — The Right of Option (Khiyar al-Majlis) and Blessing in Truthfulness
arabic_matn: عَنْ حَكِيمِ بْنِ حِزَامٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «الْبَيِّعَانِ بِالْخِيَارِ مَا لَمْ يَتَفَرَّقَا - أَوْ قَالَ: حَتَّى يَتَفَرَّقَا - فَإِنْ صَدَقَا وَبَيَّنَا بُورِكَ لَهُمَا فِي بَيْعِهِمَا، وَإِنْ كَتَمَا وَكَذَبَا مُحِقَتْ بَرَكَةُ بَيْعِهِمَا».
narrator_en: Narrated by Hakim ibn Hizam (may Allah be pleased with him)
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "The buyer and the seller have the option to cancel or confirm the deal as long as they have not parted. If both speak the truth and disclose all defects, their transaction will be blessed; but if they conceal defects and tell lies, the blessing of their transaction will be wiped out.
takhrij: Sahih al-Bukhari (2079), Sahih Muslim (1532) — Muttafaqun 'Alayh (متفق عليه).
grading: Sahih al-Bukhari (2079), Sahih Muslim (1532) — Muttafaqun 'Alayh (متفق عليه).
benefits_en: Barakah in commercial wealth is tied directly to radical transparency and truthfulness; concealing product flaws drains the divine blessing out of any monetary profit.

topic_ar: كِتَابُ الْمُعَامَلَاتِ وَالْبُيُوعِ وَالْكَسْبِ الْحَلَالِ — الْحَلَالُ بَيِّنٌ وَالْحَرَامُ بَيِّنٌ
topic_en: Book of Transactions & Halal Earning — The Clear Boundaries of Halal, Haram, and Doubtful Matters
arabic_matn: عَنِ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ: «إِنَّ الْحَلَالَ بَيِّنٌ، وَإِنَّ الْحَرَامَ بَيِّنٌ، وَبَيْنَهُمَا مُشْتَبِهَاتٌ لَا يَعْلَمُهُنَّ كَثِيرٌ مِنَ النَّاسِ، فَمَنِ اتَّقَى الشُّبُهَاتِ اسْتَبْرَأَ لِدِينِهِ وَعِرْضِهِ، وَمَنْ وَقَعَ فِي الشُّبُهَاتِ وَقَعَ فِي الْحَرَامِ، كَالرَّاعِي يَرْعَى حَوْلَ الْحِمَى يُوشِكُ أَنْ يَرْتَعَ فِيهِ...».
narrator_en: Narrated by An-Nu'man ibn Bashir (may Allah be pleased with them both)
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The lawful is clear and the unlawful is clear, and between them are doubtful matters about which many people do not know. Thus, whoever avoids doubtful matters clears himself in regard to his religion and his honor, but whoever falls into doubtful matters falls into the unlawful, like a shepherd who grazes around a private sanctuary, bordering on grazing within it...
takhrij: Sahih al-Bukhari (52), Sahih Muslim (1599) — Muttafaqun 'Alayh (متفق عليه).
grading: Sahih al-Bukhari (52), Sahih Muslim (1599) — Muttafaqun 'Alayh (متفق عليه).
benefits_en: A Muslim avoids questionable contracts, ambiguous financial schemes, and borderline earnings to preserve spiritual purity and reputation.

topic_ar: كِتَابُ الْمُعَامَلَاتِ وَالْبُيُوعِ وَالْكَسْبِ الْحَلَالِ — تَرْكُ الشُّبُهَاتِ
topic_en: Book of Transactions & Halal Earning — Leaving Doubt for Certainty in Financial Conduct
arabic_matn: عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا قَالَ: حَفِظْتُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «دَعْ مَا يَرِيبُكَ إِلَى مَا لَا يَرِيبُكَ، فَإِنَّ الصِّدْقَ طُمَأْنِينَةٌ، وَإِنَّ الْكَذِبَ رِيبَةٌ».
narrator_en: Narrated by Al-Hasan ibn 'Ali (may Allah be pleased with them both)
english_translation: I memorized from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: "Leave that which makes you doubt for that which does not cause you doubt; for truthfulness brings inner tranquility, and falsehood brings doubt and unease.
takhrij: Sunan at-Tirmidhi (2518), Sunan an-Nasa'i (5711) — Maktaba Shamela. Grading: Sahih (Al-Albani).
grading: Sunan at-Tirmidhi (2518), Sunan an-Nasa'i (5711) — Maktaba Shamela. Grading: Sahih (Al-Albani).
benefits_en: Conscientiousness (Wara') requires relinquishing suspicious transactions or gray-area contracts in favor of unambiguous, unblemished halal income.

topic_ar: كِتَابُ الْمُعَامَلَاتِ وَالْبُيُوعِ وَالْكَسْبِ الْحَلَالِ — التَّحْذِيرُ مِنَ الْغِشِّ
topic_en: Book of Transactions & Halal Earning — Absolute Prohibition of Fraud and Deception
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَرَّ عَلَى صُبْرَةِ طَعَامٍ، فَأَدْخَلَ يَدَهُ فِيهَا فَنَالَتْ أَصَابِعُهُ بَلَلًا، فَقَالَ: «مَا هَذَا يَا صَاحِبَ الطَّعَامِ؟» قَالَ: أَصَابَتْهُ السَّمَاءُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ. قَالَ: «أَفَلَا جَعَلْتَهُ فَوْقَ الطَّعَامِ كَيْ يَرَاهُ النَّاسُ؟ مَنْ غَشَّ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّي».
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (may Allah be pleased with him)
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ passed by a pile of grain and inserted his hand into it, and his fingers felt moisture. He said: "What is this, O owner of the food?" The man said: "Rain fell upon it, O Messenger of Allah." He ﷺ said: "Why did you not put it on top of the food so that people could see it? Whoever deceives (cheats) is not of me (does not follow my way).
takhrij: Sahih Muslim (102) — Maktaba Shamela. Grading: Sahih (صحيح).
grading: Sahih Muslim (102) — Maktaba Shamela. Grading: Sahih (صحيح).
benefits_en: Concealing damaged goods, manipulating packaging, or misleading consumers violates Islamic ethics and removes one from the Prophetic standard of conduct.

topic_ar: كِتَابُ الْمُعَامَلَاتِ وَالْبُيُوعِ وَالْكَسْبِ الْحَلَالِ — اسْتِحْلَالُ الْمَالِ الْحَرَامِ فِي آخِرِ الزَّمَانِ
topic_en: Book of Transactions & Halal Earning — Indifference Toward the Source of Wealth as an End-Times Corrupter
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «يَأْتِي عَلَى النَّاسِ زَمَانٌ، لَا يُبَالِي الْمَرْءُ مَا أَخَذَ مِنْهُ، أَمِنَ الْحَلَالِ أَمْ مِنَ الْحَرَامِ».
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (may Allah be pleased with him)
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "A time will surely come upon the people when a person will not care how he acquires his wealth, whether from halal (lawful) or haram (unlawful) sources.
takhrij: Sahih al-Bukhari (2059) — Maktaba Shamela. Grading: Sahih (صحيح).
grading: Sahih al-Bukhari (2059) — Maktaba Shamela. Grading: Sahih (صحيح).
benefits_en: A warning against material greed overcoming moral boundaries; a true believer constantly audits their revenue streams regardless of prevailing societal corruption.

topic_ar: كِتَابُ الْمُعَامَلَاتِ وَالْبُيُوعِ وَالْكَسْبِ الْحَلَالِ — لَعْنُ آكِلِ الرِّبَا وَمُؤْكِلِهِ وَكَاتِبِهِ وَشَاهِدَيْهِ
topic_en: Book of Transactions & Halal Earning — Strict Curse upon All Parties to Usury (Riba)
arabic_matn: عَنْ جَابِرٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: «لَعَنَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم آكِلَ الرِّبَا، وَمُؤْكِلَهُ، وَكَاتِبَهُ، وَشَاهِدَيْهِ»، وَقَالَ: «هُمْ سَوَاءٌ».
narrator_en: Narrated by Jabir (may Allah be pleased with him)
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ cursed the one who consumes usury (interest), the one who pays it, the one who records it, and the two witnesses to it, and he said: "They are all equal in sin.
takhrij: Sahih Muslim (1598) — Maktaba Shamela. Grading: Sahih (صحيح).
grading: Sahih Muslim (1598) — Maktaba Shamela. Grading: Sahih (صحيح).
benefits_en: Riba is among the most destructive sins; culpability extends beyond the primary beneficiary to facilitators, underwriters, and contract scribes.

topic_ar: كِتَابُ الْمُعَامَلَاتِ وَالْبُيُوعِ وَالْكَسْبِ الْحَلَالِ — الْأَصْنَافُ الرِّبَوِيَّةُ
topic_en: Book of Transactions & Halal Earning — The Core Rules of Exchange in Ribawi Commodities
arabic_matn: عَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «الذَّهَبُ بِالذَّهَبِ، وَالْفِضَّةُ بِالْفِضَّةِ، وَالْبُرُّ بِالْبُرِّ، وَالشَّعِيرُ بِالشَّعِيرِ، وَالتَّمْرُ بِالتَّمْرِ، وَالْمِلْحُ بِالْمِلْحِ، مِثْلًا بِمِثْلٍ، سَوَاءً بِسَوَاءٍ، يَدًا بِيَدٍ، فَإِذَا اخْتَلَفَتْ هَذِهِ الْأَصْنَافُ فَبِيعُوا كَيْفَ شِئْتُمْ إِذَا كَانَ يَدًا بِيَدٍ».
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Ubadah ibn as-Samit (may Allah be pleased with him)
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Gold for gold, silver for silver, wheat for wheat, barley for barley, dates for dates, and salt for salt—like for like, equal for equal, hand to hand (immediate exchange). But if these categories differ, sell as you wish, provided it is hand to hand.
takhrij: Sahih Muslim (1587) — Maktaba Shamela. Grading: Sahih (صحيح).
grading: Sahih Muslim (1587) — Maktaba Shamela. Grading: Sahih (صحيح).
benefits_en: Establishing the foundational economic jurisprudence against interest by requiring exact equivalence and prompt spot settlement in primary commodities and currencies.

topic_ar: كِتَابُ الْمُعَامَلَاتِ وَالْبُيُوعِ وَالْكَسْبِ الْحَلَالِ — النَّهْيُ عَنْ بَيْعِ الْغَرَرِ
topic_en: Book of Transactions & Halal Earning — Prohibition of Ambiguous, Speculative, and Deceptive Sales (Gharar)
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: «نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ بَيْعِ الْحَصَاةِ، وَعَنْ بَيْعِ الْغَرَرِ».
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (may Allah be pleased with him)
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited transactions determined by throwing stones (a gamble-based ancient trade method) and transactions involving excessive uncertainty/ambiguity (Gharar).
takhrij: Sahih Muslim (1513) — Maktaba Shamela. Grading: Sahih (صحيح).
grading: Sahih Muslim (1513) — Maktaba Shamela. Grading: Sahih (صحيح).
benefits_en: Contracts must have transparent specifications of price, quantity, quality, and deliverability, completely void of speculation or deceptive gambles.

topic_ar: كِتَابُ الْمُعَامَلَاتِ وَالْبُيُوعِ وَالْكَسْبِ الْحَلَالِ — النَّهْيُ عَنِ النَّجْشِ
topic_en: Book of Transactions & Halal Earning — Prohibition of Artificial Bidding to Inflate Prices (Najsh)
arabic_matn: عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا قَالَ: «نَهَى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ النَّجْشِ».
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn 'Umar (may Allah be pleased with them both)
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ forbade *Najsh* (bidding on a commodity without the intention to buy, merely to artificially inflate its price for others).
takhrij: Sahih al-Bukhari (2142), Sahih Muslim (1516) — Muttafaqun 'Alayh (متفق عليه).
grading: Sahih al-Bukhari (2142), Sahih Muslim (1516) — Muttafaqun 'Alayh (متفق عليه).
benefits_en: Shilling, fake online reviews, deceptive price gouging, and collusive bidding are strictly unlawful in Islamic commercial jurisprudence.

topic_ar: كِتَابُ الْمُعَامَلَاتِ وَالْبُيُوعِ وَالْكَسْبِ الْحَلَالِ — النَّهْيُ عَنْ تَلَقِّي الرُّكْبَانِ
topic_en: Book of Transactions & Halal Earning — Prohibition of Intercepting Goods Before Reaching Open Markets
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «لَا تَلَقَّوُا الرُّكْبَانَ لِلْبَيْعِ، وَلَا يَبِعْ بَعْضُكُمْ عَلَى بَيْعِ بَعْضٍ، وَلَا تَنَاجَشُوا، وَلَا يَبِعْ حَاضِرٌ لِبَادٍ...».
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (may Allah be pleased with him)
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Do not intercept trade caravans (outside the city) to buy their goods before they know market prices, do not undersell or undercut one another's deals, do not practice artificial bidding (Najsh), and a city resident must not act as a broker to hoard for a desert dweller...
takhrij: Sahih al-Bukhari (2150), Sahih Muslim (1515) — Muttafaqun 'Alayh (متفق عليه).
grading: Sahih al-Bukhari (2150), Sahih Muslim (1515) — Muttafaqun 'Alayh (متفق عليه).
benefits_en: Protecting market participants from information asymmetry ensures fair price discovery and prevents middlemen from exploiting unaware producers.

topic_ar: كِتَابُ الْمُعَامَلَاتِ وَالْبُيُوعِ وَالْكَسْبِ الْحَلَالِ — النَّهْيُ عَنِ السَّوْمِ عَلَى سَوْمِ الْأَخِ
topic_en: Book of Transactions & Halal Earning — Respecting Ongoing Negotiations and Transactions
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «لَا يَبِعِ الرَّجُلُ عَلَى بَيْعِ أَخِيهِ، وَلَا يَخْطُبْ عَلَى خِطْبَةِ أَخِيهِ، إِلَّا أَنْ يَأْذَنَ لَهُ».
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn 'Umar (may Allah be pleased with them both)
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "A man must not make an offer over the sale offer of his Muslim brother (to break their agreement), nor propose marriage over the proposal of his brother, unless he grants him permission.
takhrij: Sahih al-Bukhari (2139), Sahih Muslim (1412) — Muttafaqun 'Alayh (متفق عليه).
grading: Sahih al-Bukhari (2139), Sahih Muslim (1412) — Muttafaqun 'Alayh (متفق عليه).
benefits_en: Commercial ethics require fraternal goodwill; poaching customers or sabotaging finalized negotiations fosters malice and social enmity.

topic_ar: كِتَابُ الْمُعَامَلَاتِ وَالْبُيُوعِ وَالْكَسْبِ الْحَلَالِ — التَّسْعِيرُ وَرِزْقُ اللَّهِ
topic_en: Book of Transactions & Halal Earning — Natural Market Balance and Prohibition of Unjust Price Controls
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: غَلَا السِّعْرُ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالُوا: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، سَعِّرْ لَنَا. فَقَالَ: «إِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْمُسَعِّرُ، الْقَابِضُ الْبَاسِطُ الرَّازِقُ، وَإِنِّي لَأَرْجُو أَنْ أَلْقَى رَبِّي وَلَيْسَ أَحَدٌ مِنْكُمْ يَطْلُبُنِي بِمَظْلَمَةٍ فِي دَمٍ وَلَا مَالٍ».
narrator_en: Narrated by Anas ibn Malik (may Allah be pleased with him)
english_translation: Prices rose during the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, so people said: "O Messenger of Allah, fix prices for us." He ﷺ said: "Indeed, Allah is the Price-Setter, the Withholder, the Extender, the Provider. I truly hope to meet my Lord without anyone of you claiming against me an injustice concerning blood or wealth.
takhrij: Sunan Abi Dawud (3451), Sunan at-Tirmidhi (1314) — Maktaba Shamela. Grading: Sahih (Al-Albani).
grading: Sunan Abi Dawud (3451), Sunan at-Tirmidhi (1314) — Maktaba Shamela. Grading: Sahih (Al-Albani).
benefits_en: Arbitrary price fixing without necessity inflicts injustice on suppliers; fair market supply and demand should operate organically without coercive interference.

topic_ar: كِتَابُ الْمُعَامَلَاتِ وَالْبُيُوعِ وَالْكَسْبِ الْحَلَالِ — تَحْرِيمُ الِاحْتِكَارِ
topic_en: Book of Transactions & Halal Earning — Severe Condemnation of Hoarding Essential Goods (Ihtikar)
arabic_matn: عَنْ مَعْمَرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «لَا يَحْتَكِرُ إِلَّا خَاطِئٌ».
narrator_en: Narrated by Ma'mar ibn 'Abdullah (may Allah be pleased with him)
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "No one hoards (withholding necessities to artificially cause scarcity and drive up prices) except a deliberate sinner.
takhrij: Sahih Muslim (1605) — Maktaba Shamela. Grading: Sahih (صحيح).
grading: Sahih Muslim (1605) — Maktaba Shamela. Grading: Sahih (صحيح).
benefits_en: Hoarding essential foods, medicines, and life staples to exploit public desperation is a grave transgression in Islamic law.

topic_ar: كِتَابُ الْمُعَامَلَاتِ وَالْبُيُوعِ وَالْكَسْبِ الْحَالَالِ — بَيْعُ مَا لَا يَمْلِكُ
topic_en: Book of Transactions & Halal Earning — Prohibition of Selling Goods One Does Not Possess or Own
arabic_matn: عَنْ حَكِيمِ بْنِ حِزَامٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، يَأْتِينِي الرَّجُلُ فَيُرِيدُ مِنِّي الْبَيْعَ لَيْسَ عِنْدِي، أَفَأَبْتَاعُهُ لَهُ مِنَ السُّوقِ؟ قَالَ: «لَا تَبِعْ مَا لَيْسَ عِنْدَكَ».
narrator_en: Narrated by Hakim ibn Hizam (may Allah be pleased with him)
english_translation: Hakim ibn Hizam said: "O Messenger of Allah, a man comes asking to buy something that I do not possess; may I buy it for him from the market (after agreeing the sale)?" The Prophet ﷺ said: "Do not sell what you do not possess.
takhrij: Sunan Abi Dawud (3503), Sunan at-Tirmidhi (1232), Sunan an-Nasa'i (4613) — Maktaba Shamela. Grading: Sahih (Al-Albani).
grading: Sunan Abi Dawud (3503), Sunan at-Tirmidhi (1232), Sunan an-Nasa'i (4613) — Maktaba Shamela. Grading: Sahih (Al-Albani).
benefits_en: It is impermissible to finalize a binding sale of a specific commodity before owning and taking legal constructive possession of it, preventing risk and non-delivery disputes.

topic_ar: كِتَابُ الْمُعَامَلَاتِ وَالْبُيُوعِ وَالْكَسْبِ الْحَلَالِ — النَّهْيُ عَنْ بَيْعِ الثِّمَارِ قَبْلَ بُدُوِّ صَلَاحِهَا
topic_en: Book of Transactions & Halal Earning — Prohibition of Selling Fruit Before Its Wholesomeness Appears
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم «نَهَى عَنْ بَيْعِ الثِّمَارِ حَتَّى يَبْدُوَ صَلَاحُهَا، نَهَى الْبَائِعَ وَالْمُبْتَاعَ».
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn 'Umar (may Allah be pleased with them both)
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the sale of fruits on trees until their ripeness and freedom from blight become evident; he forbade both the seller and the buyer from doing so.
takhrij: Sahih al-Bukhari (2194), Sahih Muslim (1534) — Muttafaqun 'Alayh (متفق عليه).
grading: Sahih al-Bukhari (2194), Sahih Muslim (1534) — Muttafaqun 'Alayh (متفق عليه).
benefits_en: Eliminating agricultural risks and crop failures before maturity protects capital and eliminates unnecessary commercial litigation.

topic_ar: كِتَابُ الْمُعَامَلَاتِ وَالْبُيُوعِ وَالْكَسْبِ الْحَلَالِ — As-Salaf) / بَيْعُ السَّلَمِ الْمُنْضَبِطِ
topic_en: Book of Transactions & Halal Earning — Rules Governing Forward Contracts (As-Salam
arabic_matn: عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا قَالَ: قَدِمَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْمَدِينَةَ وَهُمْ يُسْلِفُونَ بِالتَّمْرِ السَّنَتَيْنِ وَالثَّلَاثَ، فَقَالَ: «مَنْ أَسْلَفَ فِي شَيْءٍ فَفِي كَيْلٍ مَعْلُومٍ، وَوَزْنٍ مَعْلُومٍ، إِلَى أَجَلٍ مَعْلُومٍ».
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn 'Abbas (may Allah be pleased with them both)
english_translation: When the Prophet ﷺ came to Madinah, the people used to pay in advance for dates to be delivered in two or three years. He ﷺ said: "Whoever pays in advance for something must do so for a known measure, a known weight, and for a known fixed term of delivery.
takhrij: Sahih al-Bukhari (2240), Sahih Muslim (1604) — Muttafaqun 'Alayh (متفق عليه).
grading: Sahih al-Bukhari (2240), Sahih Muslim (1604) — Muttafaqun 'Alayh (متفق عليه).
benefits_en: Forward financing (Salam) is permissible provided the specifications, quantity, and exact date of delivery are unambiguously defined at the inception of the contract.

topic_ar: كِتَابُ الْمُعَامَلَاتِ وَالْبُيُوعِ وَالْكَسْبِ الْحَلَالِ — إِيفَاءُ الْكَيْلِ وَالْوَزْنِ
topic_en: Book of Transactions & Halal Earning — Strict Duty of Honest Weights and Full Measures
arabic_matn: عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِأَصْحَابِ الْكَيْلِ وَالْوَزْنِ: «إِنَّكُمْ قَدْ وُلِّيتُمْ أَمْرَيْنِ هَلَكَتْ فِيهِمَا الْأُمَمُ السَّالِفَةُ قَبْلَكُمْ».
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn 'Abbas (may Allah be pleased with them both)
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to those who measure and weigh: "You have been entrusted with two matters regarding which past nations before you were destroyed (for defrauding in them).
takhrij: Sunan at-Tirmidhi (1217), Sunan Ibn Majah (2223) — Maktaba Shamela. Grading: Sahih (Al-Albani, Sahih al-Jami' 2062).
grading: Sunan at-Tirmidhi (1217), Sunan Ibn Majah (2223) — Maktaba Shamela. Grading: Sahih (Al-Albani, Sahih al-Jami' 2062).
benefits_en: Defrauding in weights and metrics undermines civil trust and invites divine retribution; honesty in measuring is an inviolable duty.

topic_ar: كِتَابُ الْمُعَامَلَاتِ وَالْبُيُوعِ وَالْكَسْبِ الْحَلَالِ — إِقَالَةُ النَّادِمِ فِي الْبَيْعِ
topic_en: Book of Transactions & Halal Earning — Great Reward for Rescinding a Sale with a Regretful Buyer
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «مَنْ أَقَالَ مُسْلِمًا أَقَالَهُ اللَّهُ عَثْرَتَهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ».
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (may Allah be pleased with him)
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever cancels a sale with a Muslim who regrets it, Allah will forgive his lapses and pardon his faults on the Day of Resurrection.
takhrij: Sunan Abi Dawud (3460), Sunan Ibn Majah (2199) — Maktaba Shamela. Grading: Sahih (Al-Albani).
grading: Sunan Abi Dawud (3460), Sunan Ibn Majah (2199) — Maktaba Shamela. Grading: Sahih (Al-Albani).
benefits_en: Magnanimity in accepting merchandise returns from remorseful customers brings divine pardon on the Day of Judgment.

topic_ar: كِتَابُ الْمُعَامَلَاتِ وَالْبُيُوعِ وَالْكَسْبِ الْحَلَالِ — النَّهْيُ عَنِ الْحَلِفِ فِي الْبَيْعِ
topic_en: Book of Transactions & Halal Earning — Warning Against Taking Oaths to Promote Goods
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ: «الْحَلِفُ مُنَفِّقَةٌ لِلسِّلْعَةِ، مُمْحِقَةٌ لِلْبَرَكَةِ».
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (may Allah be pleased with him)
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Swearing oaths may sell the commodity quickly, but it wipes out the blessing (Barakah) of the earning.
takhrij: Sahih al-Bukhari (2087), Sahih Muslim (1606) — Muttafaqun 'Alayh (متفق عليه).
grading: Sahih al-Bukhari (2087), Sahih Muslim (1606) — Muttafaqun 'Alayh (متفق عليه).
benefits_en: Using solemn oaths in marketing to coax customers into buying destroys divine favor in the business, even if it yields immediate profits.

topic_ar: كِتَابُ الْمُعَامَلَاتِ وَالْبُيُوعِ وَالْكَسْبِ الْحَلَالِ — الْيَمِينُ الْكَاذِبَةُ فِي التِّجَارَةِ
topic_en: Book of Transactions & Halal Earning — Three People Allah Will Not Look at on the Day of Judgment: The False Swearing Merchant
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «ثَلَاثَةٌ لَا يُكَلِّمُهُمُ اللَّهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ، وَلَا يَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهِمْ، وَلَا يُزَكِّيهِمْ، وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ... وَالْمُنَفِّقُ سِلْعَتَهُ بِالْحَلِفِ الْكَاذِبِ».
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Dharr (may Allah be pleased with him)
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "There are three people whom Allah will not speak to on the Day of Resurrection, nor look at them, nor purify them, and theirs will be a painful punishment... and the one who sells his merchandise by means of false oaths.
takhrij: Sahih Muslim (106) — Maktaba Shamela. Grading: Sahih (صحيح).
grading: Sahih Muslim (106) — Maktaba Shamela. Grading: Sahih (صحيح).
benefits_en: False swearing about cost price, quality, or manufacturing origin is an unforgivable betrayal punishable by complete deprivation of divine grace.

topic_ar: كِتَابُ الْمُعَامَلَاتِ وَالْبُيُوعِ وَالْكَسْبِ الْحَلَالِ — إِعْطَاءُ الْأَجِيرِ حَقَّهُ
topic_en: Book of Transactions & Halal Earning — Prompt Payment of Wages to Workers
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «أَعْطُوا الْأَجِيرَ أَجْرَهُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَجِفَّ عَرَقُهُ».
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn 'Umar (may Allah be pleased with them both)
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Give the employee/laborer his wages before his sweat dries.
takhrij: Sunan Ibn Majah (2443), Shu'ab al-Iman by al-Bayhaqi (4928) — Maktaba Shamela. Grading: Sahih (Al-Albani, Sahih al-Jami' 1055).
grading: Sunan Ibn Majah (2443), Shu'ab al-Iman by al-Bayhaqi (4928) — Maktaba Shamela. Grading: Sahih (Al-Albani, Sahih al-Jami' 1055).
benefits_en: Prompt compensation of workers is a primary Islamic duty; withholding or delaying employee wages is an egregious abuse of power.

topic_ar: كِتَابُ الْمُعَامَلَاتِ وَالْبُيُوعِ وَالْكَسْبِ الْحَلَالِ — خَصِيمُ مَنْ مَنَعَ أَجْرَ الْأَجِيرِ
topic_en: Book of Transactions & Halal Earning — Allah as the Divine Adversary of the Employer Who Usurps Wages
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «قَالَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى: ثَلَاثَةٌ أَنَا خَصْمُهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ: رَجُلٌ أَعْطَى بِي ثُمَّ غَدَرَ، وَرَجُلٌ بَاعَ حُرًّا فَأَكَلَ ثَمَنَهُ، وَرَجُلٌ اسْتَأْجَرَ أَجِيرًا فَاسْتَوْفَى مِنْهُ وَلَمْ يُعْطِهِ أَجْرَهُ».
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (may Allah be pleased with him)
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Allah Almighty says: 'I will be the adversary of three persons on the Day of Resurrection: a man who gave his word in My Name and then was treacherous, a man who sold a free person and consumed his price, and a man who hired a laborer, took full work from him, and did not pay him his wages.
takhrij: Sahih al-Bukhari (2227) — Maktaba Shamela. Grading: Sahih (صحيح).
grading: Sahih al-Bukhari (2227) — Maktaba Shamela. Grading: Sahih (صحيح).
benefits_en: Denying contracted workers their rightful pay positions the employer as a direct enemy of Allah the Almighty on Judgment Day.

topic_ar: كِتَابُ الْمُعَامَلَاتِ وَالْبُيُوعِ وَالْكَسْبِ الْحَلَالِ — فَضْلُ كَسْبِ يَدِ الْإِنْسَانِ
topic_en: Book of Transactions & Halal Earning — Honor of Manual Labor Exemplified by the Prophets
arabic_matn: عَنِ الْمِقْدَامِ بْنِ مَعْدِيكَرِبَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «مَا أَكَلَ أَحَدٌ طَعَامًا قَطُّ خَيْرًا مِنْ أَنْ يَأْكُلَ مِنْ عَمَلِ يَدِهِ، وَإِنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ دَاوُدَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ كَانَ يَأْكُلُ مِنْ عَمَلِ يَدِهِ».
narrator_en: Narrated by Al-Miqdam ibn Ma'dikarib (may Allah be pleased with him)
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "No one has ever eaten better food than that obtained by the labor of his own hands; and indeed the Prophet of Allah, David (Dawud, peace be upon him), used to eat from the labor of his own hands.
takhrij: Sahih al-Bukhari (2072) — Maktaba Shamela. Grading: Sahih (صحيح).
grading: Sahih al-Bukhari (2072) — Maktaba Shamela. Grading: Sahih (صحيح).
benefits_en: Earning an independent livelihood through honest toil is an honorable prophetic virtue that safeguards personal dignity and spiritual independence.

topic_ar: كِتَابُ الْمُعَامَلَاتِ وَالْبُيُوعِ وَالْكَسْبِ الْحَلَالِ — الْعَفَافُ عَنِ الْمَسْأَلَةِ بِالْعَمَلِ
topic_en: Book of Transactions & Halal Earning — Hard Work is Superior to Begging
arabic_matn: عَنِ الزُّبَيْرِ بْنِ الْعَوَّامِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «لَأَنْ يَأْخُذَ أَحَدُكُمْ حَبْلَهُ فَيَأْتِيَ بِحُزْمَةِ حَطَبٍ عَلَى ظَهْرِهِ فَيَبِيعَهَا، فَيَكُفَّ اللَّهُ بِهَا وَجْهَهُ، خَيْرٌ لَهُ مِنْ أَنْ يَسْأَلَ النَّاسَ، أَعْطَوْهُ أَوْ مَنَعُوهُ».
narrator_en: Narrated by Az-Zubayr ibn al-'Awwam (may Allah be pleased with him)
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "That one of you takes his rope, gathers a bundle of firewood on his back, and sells it so that Allah protects his dignity thereby, is far better for him than begging from people, whether they give him or refuse him.
takhrij: Sahih al-Bukhari (1471) — Maktaba Shamela. Grading: Sahih (صحيح).
grading: Sahih al-Bukhari (1471) — Maktaba Shamela. Grading: Sahih (صحيح).
benefits_en: Any lawful manual work, regardless of how humble it may appear, is infinitely nobler than soliciting handouts and relying on charity.

topic_ar: كِتَابُ الْمُعَامَلَاتِ وَالْبُيُوعِ وَالْكَسْبِ الْحَلَالِ — اللَّهُ طَيِّبٌ لَا يَقْبَلُ إِلَّا طَيِّبًا
topic_en: Book of Transactions & Halal Earning — The Divine Requirement of Pure Halal Consumption
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ، إِنَّ اللَّهَ طَيِّبٌ لَا يَقْبَلُ إِلَّا طَيِّبًا، وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ أَمَرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ بِمَا أَمَرَ بِهِ الْمُرْسَلِينَ... ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ الرَّجُلَ يُطِيلُ السَّفَرَ أَشْعَثَ أَغْبَرَ يَمُدُّ يَدَيْهِ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ: يَا رَبِّ يَا رَبِّ، وَمَطْعَمُهُ حَرَامٌ، وَمَشْرَبُهُ حَرَامٌ، وَمَلْبَسُهُ حَرَامٌ، وَغُذِيَ بِالْحَرَامِ، فَأَنَّى يُسْتَجَابُ لِذَلِكَ!».
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (may Allah be pleased with him)
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "O people! Indeed, Allah is Pure and accepts only that which is pure. And Allah commands the believers with that which He commanded the Messengers... Then he mentioned a man who travels far, disheveled and dusty, raising his hands to the sky supplicating: 'O Lord! O Lord!' while his food is haram, his drink is haram, his clothing is haram, and he is nourished with haram—how then could his prayer be answered?!
takhrij: Sahih Muslim (1015) — Maktaba Shamela. Grading: Sahih (صحيح).
grading: Sahih Muslim (1015) — Maktaba Shamela. Grading: Sahih (صحيح).
benefits_en: Consuming unlawfully earned income erects an impenetrable barrier against the acceptance of du'a and righteous deeds.

topic_ar: كِتَابُ الْمُعَامَلَاتِ وَالْبُيُوعِ وَالْكَسْبِ الْحَلَالِ — مَطْلُ الْغَنِيِّ ظُلْمٌ
topic_en: Book of Transactions & Halal Earning — Procrastination in Repaying Debt by the Solvent is an Injustice (Dhulm)
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «مَطْلُ الْغَنِيِّ ظُلْمٌ، وَإِذَا أُتْبِعَ أَحَدُكُمْ عَلَى مَلِيءٍ فَلْيَتَّبِعْ».
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (may Allah be pleased with him)
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Procrastination in debt repayment by a wealthy (capable) person is an injustice (Dhulm); and if one of you is referred to a solvent person (to collect debt), let him agree to the transfer (Hawalah).
takhrij: Sahih al-Bukhari (2287), Sahih Muslim (1564) — Muttafaqun 'Alayh (متفق عليه).
grading: Sahih al-Bukhari (2287), Sahih Muslim (1564) — Muttafaqun 'Alayh (متفق عليه).
benefits_en: Delaying the settlement of debts when one has the financial capacity to pay is a form of oppression against the creditor.

topic_ar: كِتَابُ الْمُعَامَلَاتِ وَالْبُيُوعِ وَالْكَسْبِ الْحَلَالِ — خِيَارُكُمْ أَحْسَنُكُمْ قَضَاءً
topic_en: Book of Transactions & Halal Earning — The Best of People are Those Who Settle Debts in the Most Generous Manner
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، أَنَّ رَجُلًا أَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَتَقَاضَاهُ بَعِيرًا، فَأَعْطَاهُ سِنًّا فَوْقَ سِنِّهِ، وَقَالَ: «خِيَارُكُمْ أَحْسَنُكُمْ قَضَاءً».
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (may Allah be pleased with him)
english_translation: A man came to the Prophet ﷺ demanding repayment of a camel, so he ﷺ gave him a camel of superior age and quality, saying: "The best among you are those who are best in discharging and repaying their debts.
takhrij: Sahih al-Bukhari (2305), Sahih Muslim (1601) — Muttafaqun 'Alayh (متفق عليه).
grading: Sahih al-Bukhari (2305), Sahih Muslim (1601) — Muttafaqun 'Alayh (متفق عليه).
benefits_en: Voluntarily repaying a debt with something better or with added courtesy—without prior condition—is a noble Islamic mark of integrity.

topic_ar: كِتَابُ الْمُعَامَلَاتِ وَالْبُيُوعِ وَالْكَسْبِ الْحَلَالِ — نِيَّةُ أَدَاءِ الدَّيْنِ
topic_en: Book of Transactions & Halal Earning — Divine Aid for the Borrower with Sincere Intent to Repay
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «مَنْ أَخَذَ أَمْوَالَ النَّاسِ يُرِيدُ أَدَاءَهَا أَدَّى اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، وَمَنْ أَخَذَ يُرِيدُ إِتْلَافَهَا أَتْلَفَهُ اللَّهُ».
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (may Allah be pleased with him)
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Whoever takes people's wealth (as a loan or trust) with the intention to repay it, Allah will facilitate its repayment on his behalf; but whoever takes it intending to destroy/squander it, Allah will destroy him.
takhrij: Sahih al-Bukhari (2387) — Maktaba Shamela. Grading: Sahih (صحيح).
grading: Sahih al-Bukhari (2387) — Maktaba Shamela. Grading: Sahih (صحيح).
benefits_en: Sincerity of intention in borrowing invites divine financial assistance, whereas fraudulent default brings ruin in both worlds.

topic_ar: كِتَابُ الْمُعَامَلَاتِ وَالْبُيُوعِ وَالْكَسْبِ الْحَلَالِ — إِنْظَارُ الْمُعْسِرِ
topic_en: Book of Transactions & Halal Earning — Massive Reward for Granting Respite to or Relieving a Debtor
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ: «مَنْ سَرَّهُ أَنْ يُنْجِيَهُ اللَّهُ مِنْ كُرَبِ يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ، فَلْيُنَفِّسْ عَنْ مُعْسِرٍ، أَوْ يَضَعْ عَنْهُ».
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Qatadah (may Allah be pleased with him)
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever is pleased that Allah save him from the agonies of the Day of Resurrection, let him give respite to a debtor in financial distress or forgive part or all of his debt.
takhrij: Sahih Muslim (1563) — Maktaba Shamela. Grading: Sahih (صحيح).
grading: Sahih Muslim (1563) — Maktaba Shamela. Grading: Sahih (صحيح).
benefits_en: Granting payment extensions or debt waivers to insolvent debtors secures deliverance from the terror and hardship of Judgment Day.

topic_ar: كِتَابُ الْمُعَامَلَاتِ وَالْبُيُوعِ وَالْكَسْبِ الْحَلَالِ — التَّجَاوُزُ عَنِ الْمُعْسِرِينَ
topic_en: Book of Transactions & Halal Earning — The Divine Forgiveness Granted to the Compassionate Lender
arabic_matn: عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «أَنَّ رَجُلًا مَاتَ فَدَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ، فَقِيلَ لَهُ: مَا كُنْتَ تَعْمَلُ؟ قَالَ: إِنِّي كُنْتُ أُبَايِعُ النَّاسَ، فَكُنْتُ أُنْظِرُ الْمُعْسِرَ، وَأَتَجَاوَزُ فِي السِّكَّةِ - أَوِ النَّقْدِ - فَغَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ».
narrator_en: Narrated by Hudhayfah (may Allah be pleased with him)
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "A man died and entered Paradise. It was said to him: 'What good deed did you do?' He replied: 'I used to engage in business with people and I would grant respite to the debtor in hardship and overlook minor deficiencies in payment.' So Allah forgave him.
takhrij: Sahih al-Bukhari (2077), Sahih Muslim (1560) — Muttafaqun 'Alayh (متفق عليه).
grading: Sahih al-Bukhari (2077), Sahih Muslim (1560) — Muttafaqun 'Alayh (متفق عليه).
benefits_en: Compassion and flexibility towards struggling customers and debtors earn the ultimate reward of divine forgiveness.

topic_ar: كِتَابُ الْمُعَامَلَاتِ وَالْبُيُوعِ وَالْكَسْبِ الْحَلَالِ — فَضْلُ إِنْظَارِ الْمُعْسِرِ
topic_en: Book of Transactions & Halal Earning — Daily Charity for Every Day of Respite Granted to a Debtor
arabic_matn: عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ: «مَنْ أَنْظَرَ مُعْسِرًا فَلَهُ بِكُلِّ يَوْمٍ مِثْلِهِ صَدَقَةٌ»، ثُمَّ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ: «مَنْ أَنْظَرَ مُعْسِرًا فَلَهُ بِكُلِّ يَوْمٍ مِثْلَيْهِ صَدَقَةٌ»، قُلْتُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، سَمِعْتُكَ تَقُولُ كَذَا ثُمَّ كَذَا! قَالَ: «لَهُ بِكُلِّ يَوْمٍ مِثْلِهِ صَدَقَةٌ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَحِلَّ الدَّيْنُ، فَإِذَا حَلَّ الدَّيْنُ فَأَنْظَرَهُ فَلَهُ بِكُلِّ يَوْمٍ مِثْلَيْهِ صَدَقَةٌ».
narrator_en: Narrated by Buraydah ibn al-Hasib (may Allah be pleased with him)
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever gives respite to an insolvent debtor will receive the reward of giving charity equal to the amount of the debt for every day before it is due; and once the debt becomes due and he gives him further respite, he will receive the reward of giving double that amount in charity for every day.
takhrij: Musnad Ahmad (23046), Sunan Ibn Majah (2418) — Maktaba Shamela. Grading: Sahih (Al-Albani, Sahih al-Jami' 6187).
grading: Musnad Ahmad (23046), Sunan Ibn Majah (2418) — Maktaba Shamela. Grading: Sahih (Al-Albani, Sahih al-Jami' 6187).
benefits_en: Showing patience to struggling borrowers generates compounding spiritual rewards equivalent to massive daily charitable donations.

topic_ar: كِتَابُ الْمُعَامَلَاتِ وَالْبُيُوعِ وَالْكَسْبِ الْحَلَالِ — شِدَّةُ أَمْرِ الدَّيْنِ
topic_en: Book of Transactions & Halal Earning — The Grave Gravity of Unsettled Debt Even for the Martyr
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «يُغْفَرُ لِلشَّهِيدِ كُلُّ ذَنْبٍ إِلَّا الدَّيْنَ».
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn 'Amr ibn al-'As (may Allah be pleased with them both)
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Every single sin of the martyr is forgiven except unpaid debt.
takhrij: Sahih Muslim (1886) — Maktaba Shamela. Grading: Sahih (صحيح).
grading: Sahih Muslim (1886) — Maktaba Shamela. Grading: Sahih (صحيح).
benefits_en: Financial liabilities owed to fellow humans are not automatically expunged even by the ultimate sacrifice of martyrdom; restitution of people's rights is mandatory.

topic_ar: كِتَابُ الْمُعَامَلَاتِ وَالْبُيُوعِ وَالْكَسْبِ الْحَلَالِ — تَعَلُّقُ نَفْسِ الْمَيِّتِ بِدَيْنِهِ
topic_en: Book of Transactions & Halal Earning — The Soul of the Believer is Suspended by His Unpaid Debt
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «نَفْسُ الْمُؤْمِنِ مُعَلَّقَةٌ بِدَيْنِهِ حَتَّى يُقْضَى عَنْهُ».
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (may Allah be pleased with him)
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "The soul of the believer remains suspended by his debt until it is fully settled on his behalf.
takhrij: Sunan at-Tirmidhi (1078), Sunan Ibn Majah (2413) — Maktaba Shamela. Grading: Sahih (Al-Albani).
grading: Sunan at-Tirmidhi (1078), Sunan Ibn Majah (2413) — Maktaba Shamela. Grading: Sahih (Al-Albani).
benefits_en: Heirs and executors must prioritize discharging the deceased's debts before distributing inheritances, freeing their soul for divine bliss.

topic_ar: كِتَابُ الْمُعَامَلَاتِ وَالْبُيُوعِ وَالْكَسْبِ الْحَلَالِ — النَّهْيُ عَنْ بَيْعَتَيْنِ فِي بَيْعَةٍ
topic_en: Book of Transactions & Halal Earning — Prohibition of Two Interdependent Contracts in One Sale
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: «نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ بَيْعَتَيْنِ فِي بَيْعَةٍ».
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (may Allah be pleased with him)
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited two transactions in one single sale (which leads to ambiguity or disguised interest).
takhrij: Sunan at-Tirmidhi (1231), Sunan Abi Dawud (3502), Sunan an-Nasa'i (4632) — Maktaba Shamela. Grading: Sahih (Al-Albani).
grading: Sunan at-Tirmidhi (1231), Sunan Abi Dawud (3502), Sunan an-Nasa'i (4632) — Maktaba Shamela. Grading: Sahih (Al-Albani).
benefits_en: Contracts must have clearly settled single terms without ambiguous conditional pricing that conceals usury or causes uncertainty.

topic_ar: كِتَابُ الْمُعَامَلَاتِ وَالْبُيُوعِ وَالْكَسْبِ الْحَلَالِ — تَحْرِيمُ خَبَائِثِ الْكَسْبِ
topic_en: Book of Transactions & Halal Earning — Unlawful Professions and Earnings (Price of Dogs, Immorality, and Soothsaying)
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنْ ثَمَنِ الْكَلْبِ، وَمَهْرِ الْبَغِيِّ، وَحُلْوَانِ الْكَاهِنِ».
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Mas'ud al-Ansari (may Allah be pleased with him)
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the price of a dog, the earnings of a prostitute, and the gratuity/payment given to a fortune-teller/soothsayer.
takhrij: Sahih al-Bukhari (2237), Sahih Muslim (1561) — Muttafaqun 'Alayh (متفق عليه).
grading: Sahih al-Bukhari (2237), Sahih Muslim (1561) — Muttafaqun 'Alayh (متفق عليه).
benefits_en: Revenue generated from immoral services, superstitious deception, or impure commodities is intrinsically filth (Khabith) and strictly unlawful.

topic_ar: كِتَابُ الْمُعَامَلَاتِ وَالْبُيُوعِ وَالْكَسْبِ الْحَلَالِ — تَحْرِيمُ بَيْعِ الْخَمْرِ وَالْمَيْتَةِ وَالْخِنْزِيرِ وَالْأَصْنَامِ
topic_en: Book of Transactions & Halal Earning — Prohibition of the Sale of Intoxicants, Carrion, Swine, and Idols
arabic_matn: عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ عَامَ الْفَتْحِ وَهُوَ بِمَكَّةَ: «إِنَّ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ حَرَّمَ بَيْعَ الْخَمْرِ، وَالْمَيْتَةِ، وَالْخِنْزِيرِ، وَالْأَصْنَامِ...».
narrator_en: Narrated by Jabir ibn 'Abdullah (may Allah be pleased with them both)
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said in the Year of Conquest while in Makkah: "Indeed, Allah and His Messenger have prohibited the sale of wine (intoxicants), carrion (unslaughtered dead animals), swine (pork), and idols...
takhrij: Sahih al-Bukhari (2236), Sahih Muslim (1581) — Muttafaqun 'Alayh (متفق عليه).
grading: Sahih al-Bukhari (2236), Sahih Muslim (1581) — Muttafaqun 'Alayh (متفق عليه).
benefits_en: Any substance or object that is fundamentally prohibited for use or consumption is also strictly forbidden to commercialize, sell, or trade.

topic_ar: كِتَابُ الْمُعَامَلَاتِ وَالْبُيُوعِ وَالْكَسْبِ الْحَلَالِ — تَحْرِيمُ ثَمَنِ الْمُحَرَّمَاتِ
topic_en: Book of Transactions & Halal Earning — When Allah Forbids Something, He Forbids Its Monetary Value
arabic_matn: عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «إِنَّ اللَّهَ إِذَا حَرَّمَ عَلَى قَوْمٍ أَكْلَ شَيْءٍ حَرَّمَ عَلَيْهِمْ ثَمَنَهُ».
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn 'Abbas (may Allah be pleased with them both)
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When Allah forbids a people from eating or consuming something, He also forbids for them its price (its sale and profits).
takhrij: Sunan Abi Dawud (3488), Musnad Ahmad (2673) — Maktaba Shamela. Grading: Sahih (Al-Albani).
grading: Sunan Abi Dawud (3488), Musnad Ahmad (2673) — Maktaba Shamela. Grading: Sahih (Al-Albani).
benefits_en: A foundational legal maxim in Islamic finance: it is impermissible to profit financially from what the Lawgiver has declared intrinsically harmful and prohibited.

topic_ar: كِتَابُ الْمُعَامَلَاتِ وَالْبُيُوعِ وَالْكَسْبِ الْحَلَالِ — Pledging in Debt Transactions (Ar-Rahn) / مَشْرُوعِيَّةُ الرَّهْنِ
topic_en: Book of Transactions & Halal Earning — Permissibility of Collateral
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا: «أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم اشْتَرَى طَعَامًا مِنْ يَهُودِيٍّ إِلَى أَجَلٍ، وَرَهَنَهُ دِرْعًا مِنْ حَدِيدٍ».
narrator_en: Narrated by 'A'ishah (may Allah be pleased with her)
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ purchased food supplies from a Jewish merchant on deferred payment, and he pledged his iron coat of armor with him as collateral (Rahn).
takhrij: Sahih al-Bukhari (2068), Sahih Muslim (1603) — Muttafaqun 'Alayh (متفق عليه).
grading: Sahih al-Bukhari (2068), Sahih Muslim (1603) — Muttafaqun 'Alayh (متفق عليه).
benefits_en: Securing loans with physical collateral is permissible in Islamic transactions, as is dealing fairly in business with non-Muslims.

topic_ar: كِتَابُ الْمُعَامَلَاتِ وَالْبُيُوعِ وَالْكَسْبِ الْحَلَالِ — النَّاسُ شُرَكَاءُ فِي ثَلَاثٍ
topic_en: Book of Transactions & Halal Earning — Communal Shared Resources Must Not Be Monopolized
arabic_matn: عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «الْمُسْلِمُونَ شُرَكَاءُ فِي ثَلَاثٍ: فِي الْمَاءِ، وَالْكَلَإِ، وَالنَّارِ، وَثَمَنُهُ حَرَامٌ».
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn 'Abbas (may Allah be pleased with them both)
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Muslims are equal partners in three essential public goods: water, pasture, and fire (energy/fuel); and trading or monopolizing their common source is unlawful.
takhrij: Sunan Abi Dawud (3477), Sunan Ibn Majah (2472) — Maktaba Shamela. Grading: Sahih (Al-Albani, Sahih al-Jami' 6701).
grading: Sunan Abi Dawud (3477), Sunan Ibn Majah (2472) — Maktaba Shamela. Grading: Sahih (Al-Albani, Sahih al-Jami' 6701).
benefits_en: Basic life essentials and natural common resources belong communally to society and must never be private-monopolized to deprive the vulnerable.

topic_ar: كِتَابُ الْمُعَامَلَاتِ وَالْبُيُوعِ وَالْكَسْبِ الْحَلَالِ — التَّحْذِيرُ مِنْ بَيْعِ الْعِينَةِ
topic_en: Book of Transactions & Halal Earning — Warning Against Hidden Usurious Buyback Schemes (Al-'Inah)
arabic_matn: عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ: «إِذَا تَبَايَعْتُمْ بِالْعِينَةِ، وَأَخَذْتُمْ أَذْنَابَ الْبَقَرِ، وَرَضِيتُمْ بِالزَّرْعِ، وَتَرَكْتُمُ الْجِهَادَ، سَلَّطَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْكُمْ ذُلًّا لَا يَنْزِعُهُ حَتَّى تَرْجِعُوا إِلَى دِينِكُمْ».
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn 'Umar (may Allah be pleased with them both)
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When you engage in 'Inah sales (disguised usury buyback schemes), pursue the tails of cattle, become content with agriculture alone, and abandon striving in the cause of Allah, Allah will inflict upon you a humiliation that He will not remove until you return to your religion.
takhrij: Sunan Abi Dawud (3462), Musnad Ahmad (5562) — Maktaba Shamela. Grading: Sahih (Al-Albani).
grading: Sunan Abi Dawud (3462), Musnad Ahmad (5562) — Maktaba Shamela. Grading: Sahih (Al-Albani).
benefits_en: Resorting to legal subterfuges (Hiyal) to legitimize interest contracts and prioritizing material comfort over religious defense invites communal weakness and disgrace.

topic_ar: كِتَابُ الْمُعَامَلَاتِ وَالْبُيُوعِ وَالْكَسْبِ الْحَلَالِ — شِرَاءُ الْمَالِ الْمَغْصُوبِ
topic_en: Book of Transactions & Halal Earning — Prohibition of Selling Stolen Goods
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «مَنِ اشْتَرَى سَرِقَةً وَهُوَ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّهَا سَرِقَةٌ، فَقَدِ اشْتَرَكَ فِي عَارِهَا وَإِثْمِهَا».
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Hurairah (may Allah be pleased with him)
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Whoever purchases stolen property knowing that it is stolen has shared in its shame and its sin.
takhrij: Al-Mustadrak 'ala al-Sahihayn by al-Hakim (2253), Sunan al-Bayhaqi (10834) — Maktaba Shamela. Grading: Sahih (Al-Albani, Sahih al-Jami' 6185).
grading: Al-Mustadrak 'ala al-Sahihayn by al-Hakim (2253), Sunan al-Bayhaqi (10834) — Maktaba Shamela. Grading: Sahih (Al-Albani, Sahih al-Jami' 6185).
benefits_en: Knowingly buying stolen, illicit, or unlawfully confiscated goods makes the buyer an active accessory to theft and corruption.

topic_ar: كِتَابُ الْمُعَامَلَاتِ وَالْبُيُوعِ وَالْكَسْبِ الْحَلَالِ — لَعْنُ الرَّاشِي وَالْمُرْتَشِي
topic_en: Book of Transactions & Halal Earning — Prohibition of Fraudulent Claims and Bribery (Rishwah)
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا قَالَ: «لَعَنَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الرَّاشِيَ وَالْمُرْتَشِيَ».
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Abdullah ibn 'Amr (may Allah be pleased with them both)
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ cursed the one who offers a bribe and the one who accepts it.
takhrij: Sunan Abi Dawud (3580), Sunan at-Tirmidhi (1337), Sunan Ibn Majah (2313) — Maktaba Shamela. Grading: Sahih (Al-Albani).
grading: Sunan Abi Dawud (3580), Sunan at-Tirmidhi (1337), Sunan Ibn Majah (2313) — Maktaba Shamela. Grading: Sahih (Al-Albani).
benefits_en: Bribery corrupts judicial and administrative systems, robs deserving citizens of their rights, and incurs direct expulsion from divine mercy.

topic_ar: كِتَابُ الْمُعَامَلَاتِ وَالْبُيُوعِ وَالْكَسْبِ الْحَلَالِ — ثُبُوتُ حَقِّ الشُّفْعَةِ
topic_en: Book of Transactions & Halal Earning — The Right of Pre-emption (Shuf'ah) to Prevent Harm Between Partners
arabic_matn: عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا قَالَ: «قَضَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالشُّفْعَةِ فِي كُلِّ مَا لَمْ يُقْسَمْ، فَإِذَا وَقَعَتِ الْحُدُودُ وَصُرِّفَتِ الطُّرُقُ فَلَا شُفْعَةَ».
narrator_en: Narrated by Jabir ibn 'Abdullah (may Allah be pleased with them both)
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ decreed the right of pre-emption (*Shuf'ah*) in all joint undivided property; but once boundaries are demarcated and roads are paved, pre-emption no longer applies.
takhrij: Sahih al-Bukhari (2213), Sahih Muslim (1608) — Muttafaqun 'Alayh (متفق عليه).
grading: Sahih al-Bukhari (2213), Sahih Muslim (1608) — Muttafaqun 'Alayh (متفق عليه).
benefits_en: Pre-emption safeguards existing co-owners from suffering harm or undesirable partners in joint real estate.

topic_ar: كِتَابُ الْمُعَامَلَاتِ وَالْبُيُوعِ وَالْكَسْبِ الْحَلَالِ — حُكْمُ اللُّقَطَةِ وَأَمَانَتُهَا
topic_en: Book of Transactions & Halal Earning — Returning Lost or Misplaced Items (Luqatah) with Full Announcement
arabic_matn: عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ الْجُهَنِيِّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: سُئِلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ لُقَطَةِ الذَّهَبِ أَوِ الْوَرِقِ، فَقَالَ: «اعْرِفْ وِكَاءَهَا وَعِفَاصَهَا، ثُمَّ عَرِّفْهَا سَنَةً، فَإِنْ لَمْ تُعْرَفْ فَاسْتَنْفِقْهَا، وَلْتَكُنْ وَدِيعَةً عِنْدَكَ، فَإِنْ جَاءَ طَالِبُهَا يَوْمًا مِنَ الدَّهْرِ فَأَدِّهَا إِلَيْهِ».
narrator_en: Narrated by Zayd ibn Khalid al-Juhani (may Allah be pleased with him)
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was asked about finding lost gold or silver. He said: "Recognize its strap and its container, then announce it publicly for one full year. If its owner is not identified, you may spend it as a trust; if the seeker arrives any day in the future, pay it back to him.
takhrij: Sahih al-Bukhari (2426), Sahih Muslim (1722) — Muttafaqun 'Alayh (متفق عليه).
grading: Sahih al-Bukhari (2426), Sahih Muslim (1722) — Muttafaqun 'Alayh (متفق عليه).
benefits_en: Preserving lost property with meticulous care and public announcement demonstrates the sanctity of private property in Islam.

topic_ar: كِتَابُ الْمُعَامَلَاتِ وَالْبُيُوعِ وَالْكَسْبِ الْحَلَالِ — هَدَايَا الْعُمَّالِ غُلُولٌ
topic_en: Book of Transactions & Halal Earning — Prohibition of Taking Official Gifts as Concealed Bribery (Ghulul)
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَبِي حُمَيْدٍ السَّاعِدِيِّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم اسْتَعْمَلَ ابْنَ اللُّتْبِيَّةِ عَلَى الصَّدَقَةِ، فَلَمَّا قَدِمَ قَالَ: هَذَا لَكُمْ وَهَذَا أُهْدِيَ لِي. فَقَامَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَحَمِدَ اللَّهَ وَأَثْنَى عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ: «مَا بَالُ عَامِلٍ أَبْعَثُهُ فَيَقُولُ: هَذَا لَكُمْ وَهَذَا أُهْدِيَ لِي! أَفَلَا قَعَدَ فِي بَيْتِ أَبِيهِ أَوْ فِي بَيْتِ أُمِّهِ حَتَّى يَنْظُرَ أَيُهْدَى إِلَيْهِ أَمْ لَا؟!».
narrator_en: Narrated by Abu Humayd as-Sa'idi (may Allah be pleased with him)
english_translation: The Prophet ﷺ appointed a man named Ibn al-Lutbiyyah to collect zakah. When he returned, he said: "This is for you (the treasury), and this was gifted to me personally." The Prophet ﷺ stood up, praised Allah, and said: "What is wrong with an official whom I send and he says: 'This is for you and this is gifted to me!' Why did he not sit in the house of his father or mother to see if gifts would be presented to him or not?!
takhrij: Sahih al-Bukhari (7174), Sahih Muslim (1832) — Muttafaqun 'Alayh (متفق عليه).
grading: Sahih al-Bukhari (7174), Sahih Muslim (1832) — Muttafaqun 'Alayh (متفق عليه).
benefits_en: Public servants, corporate procurement agents, and auditors are forbidden from accepting gifts associated with their official position, as it constitutes corrupt breach of trust (Ghulul).

topic_ar: كِتَابُ الْمُعَامَلَاتِ وَالْبُيُوعِ وَالْكَسْبِ الْحَلَالِ — الْمُسْلِمُونَ عِنْدَ شُرُوطِهِمْ
topic_en: Book of Transactions & Halal Earning — Fulfilling All Contractual Agreements and Covenants
arabic_matn: عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ عَوْفٍ الْمُزَنِيِّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «الصُّلْحُ جَائِزٌ بَيْنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ، إِلَّا صُلْحًا حَرَّمَ حَلَالًا، أَوْ أَحَلَّ حَرَامًا، وَالْمُسْلِمُونَ عَلَى شُرُوطِهِمْ، إِلَّا شَرْطًا حَرَّمَ حَلَالًا، أَوْ أَحَلَّ حَرَامًا».
narrator_en: Narrated by 'Amr ibn 'Awf al-Muzani (may Allah be pleased with him)
english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Reconciliation is permissible between Muslims, except a settlement that makes lawful what is forbidden or forbids what is lawful. And Muslims are strictly bound by their conditions (and covenants), except a condition that makes lawful the forbidden or forbids the lawful.
takhrij: Sunan at-Tirmidhi (1352), Sunan Abi Dawud (3594) — Maktaba Shamela. Grading: Sahih (Al-Albani).
grading: Sunan at-Tirmidhi (1352), Sunan Abi Dawud (3594) — Maktaba Shamela. Grading: Sahih (Al-Albani).
